EID_a02100_1080g_00100_02100_1: The captain just mutters and shakes his head at the pair\nbefore ordering them to clean the storage room as punishment.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1080g_00200_02100_1:
The senior who was responsible for instructing the pair is also
ordered to pitch in, and his irritation is clear.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_1090g_00100_02100_1: When they reach the storage room, they find it\nin a state of extreme disarray.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1090g_00200_02100_1:
"Can't believe the damn captain is making me do this," 
grumbles the young man.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1090g_00300_02100_1: \n"I mean, this is grunt work! What's even the point!?":<TAP>
EID_a02100_1090g_00400_02100_1: \n\n"Move your hands, not your mouth," responds the instructor.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1090g_00500_02100_1: \n"Accepting punishment is part of being a soldier.":<TAP>
EID_a02100_1090g_00600_02100_1:
The silence of his fellow squadmates as they clean
only spurs the young man's irritation further.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_1100g_00100_02100_1: "This is stupid. I have things I have to accomplish.\nI need to fight! I need to win a medal of honor!":<TAP>
EID_a02100_1100g_00300_02100_1: \nIt is the highest honor awarded by their country,\ngiven only to soldiers who accomplish greatness.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1100g_00400_02100_1: \nThose who receive it are said to be destined for success.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_1110g_00100_02100_1: "I'm going to be the best," continues the young man,\n"and everyone else is going to know it!":<TAP>
EID_a02100_1110g_00200_02100_1: \nThough many members of the army enlist for the cash bonus,\nthe young man joined only to fulfill the ambition in his heart.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1110g_00300_02100_1:
But this is the first time he's ever told
his squadmates about his true goals.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1110g_00400_02100_1: \nHe has skill to spare in the military arts,\nso it's clearly not some flash-in-the-pan ideal.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_1120g_00100_02100_1: The relief he feels at finally expressing it is palpable.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1120g_00200_02100_1: \nHis speech made, the young man makes to leave the storage room.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1120g_00300_02100_1: \nWhen his friend reminds him their work has only begun,\nhe keeps walking and says::<TAP>
EID_a02100_1120g_00400_02100_1: \n\n"My part's done. I'm going to sleep.":<PAGE>
EID_a02100_1130g_00100_02100_1: Ambitious goals cannot be achieved alone.\nIt takes the work of those who walk beside us.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1130g_00200_02100_1: \nThis is clearly a lesson the young man has yet to learn.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_1130g_00300_02100_1:
The remaining two soldiers in the storage room smile wryly at each other,
each of them silently mulling over this very thought.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2010g_00200_02100_1: \nThe squad is called together for a strategy meeting.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2010g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAs they gather in the briefing room, tension fills the air.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2010g_00500_02100_1: \n\nBut after ten long minutes, the briefing has yet to begin.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2020g_00100_02100_1: It seems the captain has slept in. Again.:
EID_a02100_2020g_00200_02100_1: \nThis realization spurs the young man's frustration anew.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2020g_00300_02100_1: \n\nFinally, the captain arrives in a disheveled state.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2020g_00400_02100_1: \n"Sorry about that," he says to muted laughter.\n"Guess I missed the alarm again.":<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2030g_00100_02100_1: This said, he turns serious, as does the rest of the room.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2030g_00200_02100_1: \n"Here's the latest: We've detected enemy forces\nmarching en masse toward the border.":<TAP>
EID_a02100_2030g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAny remaining smiles in the room vanish at this news.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2040g_00100_02100_1: "We are to stop the enemy's advance and protect our nation's territory.\nAnd as luck would have it, this base is directly in their path.":<TAP>
EID_a02100_2040g_00200_02100_1: "Our only objective is to protect this base. We just need the enemy to withdraw while keeping our losses to a minimum.":
EID_a02100_2040g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe briefing room fills with murmurs at this news.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2040g_00400_02100_1: \nReactions run the gamut from enthusiasm to relief to unease.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2040g_00500_02100_1: \nBut the young man leaps to his feet and asks permission to speak.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2050g_00100_02100_1: Stifling a tired yawn, the captain tells him to continue.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2050g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe sneer on the young man's face is clear to all.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2050g_00300_02100_1:
After some initial comments on the state of the enemy,
he voices disagreement with the plan,
and suggests a total annihilation of their forces instead.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2060g_00100_02100_1: A nervous buzz ripples through the room.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2060g_00200_02100_1: \nBut the young man ignores it and continues pressing his case.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2060g_00300_02100_1:
"These people have threatened our borders for far too long!
If we take out one of their squadrons, we'll be heroes!
People will have to—":<TAP>
EID_a02100_2060g_00400_02100_1: \n\n"That's enough, soldier," says the captain softly.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2070g_00100_02100_1: "Remember what I said? The most important part of this plan is\ndefending the base and keeping casualties to a bare minimum.\nBecause if any of the men here die, that falls on me.":<TAP>
EID_a02100_2070g_00200_02100_1:
Rather than backing down, the young man redoubles his efforts
and engages in verbal sparring with the captain for some time.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2070g_00300_02100_1: \n\nIn the end, however, he is overruled and the briefing ends.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2080g_00100_02100_1: His plan rejected, the young man is infuriated.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2080g_00200_02100_1:
"Why the hell doesn't he get it!?
I'm thinking of this squad far more than he is!":<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2090g_00100_02100_1: Still convinced his plan is correct, he makes the rounds of his\nfellow soldiers, looking for any who might agree with him.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2090g_00200_02100_1:
With the arrogant attitude he has always displayed to his fellows,
he does not find many who will side with him.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2090g_00300_02100_1: \n\nEven the man he thinks of as his best friend turns him down.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2100g_00100_02100_1: It's not that he doesn't desire glory; everyone in the squad\nwants nothing more than to wear a medal of honor.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2100g_00200_02100_1:
But he joined the military to keep his head down,
follow orders, and send money home to his family.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2100g_00300_02100_1: \nSo he can't risk everything on his friend's reckless plan.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_2110g_00200_02100_1: \nOr perhaps he is simply irritated the young man is crafting\nalternative plans on his own without even consulting anyone.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2110g_00300_02100_1: \nThe young man realizes his friend has balled his hand into a fist.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_2110g_00400_02100_1:
With the thoughts and emotions of the pair still at odds,
the day of the operation grows ever closer...:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3010g_00100_02100_1: The battlefield is silent; it's almost impossible\nto believe a war ever raged here.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3010g_00200_02100_1: \nAll the young man can hear is his own ragged breath.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3010g_00300_02100_1:
He stands in the borders of the base; scattered before him
are countless numbers of corpses.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3010g_00400_02100_1: \n\nThere is no doubt who they are.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3020g_00200_02100_1: \nThe enemy arrives at the base, and the battle begins.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3020g_00300_02100_1:
The squad digs in and defends the base from the enemy,
just as the captain ordered.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3020g_00400_02100_1: \nBut the young man, impatient with this war of attrition,\ndecides to commence with his own plan.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3020g_00500_02100_1: Taking advantage of the terrain surrounding the base, he launches\na surprise attack that takes out half the enemy in a single swoop.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3020g_00600_02100_1:
He is joined by a handful of soldiers who see things his way—
and though many of them fall in battle, their bold tactics
force the enemy to initiate a full retreat.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3030g_00100_02100_1: As he watches his foes scatter, the young man grins.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3030g_00300_02100_1:
Though his squad had not accomplished much in battle until now,
they are sure to earn praise for this great victory.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3030g_00400_02100_1: He is one step closer to his medal of honor.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3030g_00500_02100_1:
With those thoughts in his mind, he returns to the base—
but the sight waiting for him there is a hellscape.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3030g_00600_02100_1: \n\nHis squadmates—all of them—lie dead or dying on the ground.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3040g_00100_02100_1: Dumbfounded, he wanders among their bodies, the smell of burnt flesh\nand blood and gunpowder stinging his nostrils.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3040g_00200_02100_1: \nIt is the most horrific sight the young man has ever seen.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3040g_00300_02100_1: \n\nHe forces his breathing to slow and resists the urge to vomit.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3040g_00400_02100_1: \n"It's okay," he tells himself. "It's okay." And though his legs\nfeel heavy and false, he forces them to carry him forward.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3050g_00100_02100_1: But then his foot catches on something and he tumbles to the ground.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3050g_00200_02100_1:
At his feet is one of his squad members, heavily injured
and covered in dirt and debris from an explosion.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3050g_00400_02100_1:
Though he still breathes, it is with great difficulty,
as he is bleeding from multiple wounds.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3060g_00200_02100_1: \nRealizing the young man is speaking to him,\nthe instructor manages to open a single eye.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3060g_00300_02100_1:
It roves about blindly for a moment before finally
settling on the figure of the young man.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3070g_00400_02100_1: \n"He changed...our formation...\nand now look at us...":<TAP>
EID_a02100_3070g_00500_02100_1: \nWith that, the instructor draws one last, hitching breath\nbefore falling silent forever.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3070g_00600_02100_1: The captain did this for me? thinks the young man. But I always caused him so much trouble...:
EID_a02100_3070g_00700_02100_1: \nUnable to accept his instructor's death, the young man\nwanders the battlefield in a haze, searching for his captain.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3080g_00100_02100_1: Instead, he finds what remains of his only friend.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3080g_00200_02100_1: \nAn explosion has blasted off most of his left leg,\nleaving a pool of blood at the base of the stump.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3090g_00100_02100_1: "Good to see you're in one piece..." says his friend.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3090g_00200_02100_1: \nThe fact he is still able to make jokes\nin such a condition is remarkable.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3090g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe young man begins stammering out an apology.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3090g_00500_02100_1: \n\n"I know," whispers his friend. "I wanted one too...":<TAP>
EID_a02100_3090g_00600_02100_1: \n"Said this was for my family...but that medal\nsure would have been nice...":<TAP>
EID_a02100_3100g_00100_02100_1: Tears begin to run from the young man's eyes\nas he sets off again in search of his captain.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3100g_00200_02100_1: \nHe sees bodies. Bodies. Bodies.\nEach one bearing a familiar face.:
EID_a02100_3100g_00300_02100_1: \n\nFinally, he sees the captain and runs to his side.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3100g_00400_02100_1: \nHe calls out to him again and again,\nbut the man makes no response.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3110g_00300_02100_1: He wants the captain to reprimand him. He needs it. Otherwise, his apology would be meaningless.:
EID_a02100_3110g_00400_02100_1: \nThere is so much to say: He'd made a horrible mistake.\nHe'd been wrong where the captain had been right.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3110g_00500_02100_1: \n\nBut he can scarcely force two words together.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3110g_00600_02100_1: \nAnd the tears that pour down his face only make things harder.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3120g_00100_02100_1: But then the young man realizes something::<TAP>
EID_a02100_3120g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe captain is squeezing his hand in return.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3130g_00100_02100_1: The captain's eyes are closed; his senses all but gone.\nThere is no way he can know whose hand he grasps.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3130g_00200_02100_1:
And yet somehow, he seems to recognize the young man,
and ends his life with a faint smile on his face.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_3140g_00100_02100_1: With that, the operation is over.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_3140g_00200_02100_1: \nThe young man is the only survivor.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4010g_00100_02100_1: Though it came at the cost of everything,\nthe young man is finally a hero.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4010g_00200_02100_1: \n\nFor despite the sacrifices required, the enemy had withdrawn.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4010g_00300_02100_1: \nThe young man is given time off to recuperate.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4020g_00100_02100_1: Which is how he finds himself with nothing to do.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4020g_00200_02100_1: \nOr perhaps it is more apt to say there is nothing he can do.:
EID_a02100_4020g_00300_02100_1:
Day after day, he hides in his house and attempts
to drown his sorrows with strong drink.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4020g_00400_02100_1: \nEmpty bottles lie scattered across his floor.\nRats run to and fro amidst the refuse and spoil.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4030g_00100_02100_1: He wakes up, grabs a bottle, and drinks until he passes out. :<TAP>
EID_a02100_4030g_00200_02100_1: \nWhen he come to, he begins the process all over again.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4030g_00300_02100_1: \nIf that was his entire life, it might be all right.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4030g_00400_02100_1:
But he sees flashbacks to the battle in his sleep,
and these nightmares torture him.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4030g_00500_02100_1: \nThe battleground... The faces of enemies he killed...\nHis squadmates dying before his eyes...:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4030g_00600_02100_1: \n\nHis instructor. His best friend. The captain.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4030g_00700_02100_1: \nAll of them die in his arms.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4040g_00120_02100_1: \nafter day after day after day after day after day after day after day after day:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4040g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe nightmares play on repeat, bringing his life to a halt.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4050g_00100_02100_1: If only I hadn't made that suggestion...:
EID_a02100_4050g_00200_02100_1: \nIf only I hadn't ignored my orders...:
EID_a02100_4050g_00400_02100_1: \n\nHis world becomes an endless spiral of regret.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4060g_00100_02100_1: Was there even a point to what I did?:
EID_a02100_4060g_00200_02100_1: \nDo I feel pride in what I did?:
EID_a02100_4060g_00300_02100_1: \nWas there justice to what I did?:
EID_a02100_4060g_00400_02100_1: Is this all because of my selfishness? Because of a goddamn medal?:
EID_a02100_4070g_00100_02100_1: Maybe I should just end it all.:
EID_a02100_4070g_00200_02100_1: \nHe drunkenly loads bullets into his gun,\nraises the muzzle to his temple, and stands.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4070g_00300_02100_1:
He places his finger on the trigger, closes his eyes,
and breaths in a lungful of stale air.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4080g_00100_02100_1: But he is drunker than he imagines, and with his eyes closed,\nhis balance flees and sends him crashing into a nearby table.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4080g_00200_02100_1: \n\nWhen he opens his eyes, he sees a familiar envelope.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4080g_00300_02100_1: \nIt is the kind used for notices by the military's\nhighest-ranking officials.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4080g_00400_02100_1:
Inside is an official letter congratulating him on annihilating the
enemy, and announcing that he will be rewarded with a
medal of honor and promotion to captain.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4090g_00300_02100_1: \n"I'm only alive because the rest of them saved me.":<TAP>
EID_a02100_4090g_00400_02100_1: \n\nSeeing the letter again reminds him that the ceremony is tomorrow.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4090g_00500_02100_1: \nFinally, he takes a handful of sleeping pills and falls into bed.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4100g_00200_02100_1: \nIt is the same dream as ever—a dream of that day.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4100g_00300_02100_1:
But this time, it does not begin after the battle.
Instead, it begins before he set off to face the enemy on his own.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4110g_00100_02100_1: No. I won't make the same mistake again.:
EID_a02100_4110g_00200_02100_1:
This time, he does not initiate his plan. Instead, he remains at the
base and kills every last enemy soldier he sees, swearing he will
make sure they never kill again.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4110g_00300_02100_1: \n\nHe slays as if in the grip of madness.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4110g_00400_02100_1: \nEnemy soldiers fall—so many he cannot count their number.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4110g_00500_02100_1: \nBut it doesn't matter; he will do anything to save his brothers.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4110g_00600_02100_1:
Suddenly, he looks out and sees the faces
of the people he has been slaughtering::<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4120g_00100_02100_1: They are all part of his squad.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4120g_00200_02100_1:
His instructor. His friend. His captain.
He killed them with his own hands once more.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4120g_00300_02100_1: \nWith a short cry, the young man finally understands::<TAP>
EID_a02100_4120g_00400_02100_1: \n\n"I'll never be able to save them, no matter what I do.":<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4120g_00500_02100_1: The sickening dream wakes him up.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4120g_00600_02100_1: The morning sun streams in through the window. It is the day of the medal ceremony—the day of what he thought was his dearest wish.:
EID_a02100_4130g_00100_02100_1: What meaning can there be in someone who wiped out\nhis own squad accepting a medal?:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4140g_00100_02100_1: And when the ceremony is over, he will be a captain.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4140g_00200_02100_1: \nA leader with troops of his own.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4140g_00300_02100_1: \n\n"What do I do, Captain? How do I atone for my sins?":<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4140g_00400_02100_1: He asks himself this as he puts on his formal dress uniform.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4140g_00500_02100_1: \nAs he stares at himself in the mirror for the first time\nin a very long while, he sees how emaciated he has become.:<TAP>
EID_a02100_4140g_00600_02100_1:
With heavy steps, he turns his back on the ghost in the glass
and makes his way to the ceremonial venue.:<PAGE>
EID_a02100_4150g_00100_02100_1: <align=center>Almost as though it is his redemption...:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1010g_00100_02110_1: Machines line a darkened room like a row of steel coffins.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1010g_00200_02110_1: \n\nWith a sudden noise, a single door swings open.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1010g_00300_02110_1: \nThe coffin contains a sleeping girl whose pure-white hair\nreaches down to her shoulders.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1010g_00400_02110_1: \n\nAs her lashes flutter faintly, her eyelids slowly lift.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1010g_00600_02110_1: \nThey dart back and forth in an attempt to grasp the situation.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1020g_00100_02110_1: The first thing she sees is a monitor affixed to the wall.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1020g_00200_02110_1: \nThen a dozen or so unmoving female figures.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1020g_00300_02110_1: \n\nShe blinks once and stares at their faces.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1020g_00400_02110_1: \nShe turns her gaze to each, one after the other.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1020g_00500_02110_1: \n\nAfter a moment, she realizes they are all identical.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1030g_00100_02110_1: Eyes. Hair. Lips. Ears. Skin. Clothing. Height. Weight.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1030g_00300_02110_1: \nThe girl shows no surprise at this.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1030g_00400_02110_1: \nBut it's not as if she knew it was coming.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1030g_00500_02110_1: \nIn truth, she knows nothing at all.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1030g_00700_02110_1: \nAs blank as her shimmering white hair.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1040g_00100_02110_1: She exits the machine and takes a few steps forward.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1040g_00200_02110_1: \nShe passes the other girls and comes to the center of the room,\nthen looks around again.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1040g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThere are around a dozen girls, and an equal number of empty machines.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1040g_00400_02110_1: \nIt seems she is the last to awaken.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1040g_00600_02110_1:
Besides the floor and walls and ceiling,
there is nothing else to the room.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1050g_00100_02110_1: Having taken in the room, she now looks down at herself.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1050g_00200_02110_1: \n\nHer clothes are the same as her companions.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1050g_00300_02110_1: \nHer collar—which is high enough to hide her mouth—\ncontains a small apparatus on the inside.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1060g_00100_02110_1: The girl turns to look at the monitor.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1060g_00200_02110_1: \nHer face appears on it, a reflection from\nwhat scant light exists within the room.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1060g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThe face in the reflection matches the other girls.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1060g_00400_02110_1: \nA pair of emotionless eyes stare back at her.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1060g_00500_02110_1: \n\nAfter a time, the screen lights up blue.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1070g_00100_02110_1: White shapes are projected on the monitor.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1070g_00200_02110_1: \nThey blink and change shape, over and over again.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1070g_00400_02110_1: \nThe girl understands nothing; she simply stares\nat the dancing figures on the screen.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1070g_00500_02110_1: \nSuddenly, the apparatus in her collar springs to life,\naccompanied by a high-pitched sound.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1080g_00100_02110_1: The moment it does, the girl's consciousness is flipped upside down.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1080g_00200_02110_1: \nVoices ring in her head. Scenery dashes across her vision.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1080g_00300_02110_1: \nInformation flows inside her like a raging river.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1080g_00500_02110_1: \nThe hallucinations link together; images become words\nin her consciousness as they burn into her mind.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1080g_00600_02110_1:

voice color pain light heat form shadow:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1090g_00300_02110_1: \nHer breathing remains ragged, her footing unsteady.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1090g_00600_02110_1:
She brushes aside her sweat-slicked bangs
and directs her attention to the monitor.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1090g_00700_02110_1: \nIt contains writing in stark white letters::<TAP>
EID_a02110_1100g_00100_02110_1: Weapons built from plants or animals are known as "living weapons.":<TAP>
EID_a02110_1100g_00200_02110_1: \nIn the case of these girls, they are based on a single human.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1100g_00300_02110_1:
From the time they were born to the moment they woke up,
they were implanted with the instincts of a weapon and
administered drugs that forcefully caused them to mature.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1100g_00400_02110_1:
Once they are ready, they will be given the necessary
knowledge to function as a weapon and sent into battle.
They will never know the meaning of killing—or of living.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1110g_00100_02110_1: Now, a new mission is ready for them.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1110g_00400_02110_1: \nMultiples of an identical voice echo through the room,\nall saying the same word: "Yes.":<TAP>
EID_a02110_1110g_00500_02110_1:
Following the description of the operation,
target information appears on the screen.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1110g_00600_02110_1: \nThere is no sound; merely words and charts that appear\non the screen one after the other before vanishing again.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_1120g_00200_02110_1: \nWith that, the monitor goes dark once more.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1120g_00300_02110_1: \n\nWith the blue light gone, the room is again plunged into shadow.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1120g_00400_02110_1: \nA white light pours in, tearing the gloom apart.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1120g_00500_02110_1: \nA portion of the wall moves, granting a view of the outside world.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1120g_00600_02110_1: \n\nA black van appears in the light.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_1120g_00700_02110_1: \nThe girls begin their operation, piling into the vehicle\nwith perfectly synchronized footsteps.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2010g_00100_02110_1: Approximately twenty-one minutes have passed\nsince the beginning of the operation.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2010g_00200_02110_1: \nWithin an area that was once the city center,\nthe girls stand and stare at a single point.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2010g_00300_02110_1:
They encountered the first target four minutes
after arriving at their destination.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2010g_00400_02110_1: \nBut things have not yet proceeded to a combat situation.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2020g_00100_02110_1: The girls stare at their lone target.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2020g_00200_02110_1: \nMuch like the girls, it is made with humanoid elements,\nincluding a head, torso, and four limbs.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2020g_00300_02110_1:
But each part is warped and twisted,
like a doll haphazardly stitched together.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2020g_00400_02110_1: \n\nIts skin reflects the sunlight, creating an eerie rainbow.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2020g_00500_02110_1: \n\nAll these facts are just as their intel said it would be.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2030g_00100_02110_1: The girl at the rear of the group is the one who woke up last.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2030g_00400_02110_1: \nShe peers down the sight, checking on her allies.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2030g_00500_02110_1: \n\nThe ones on the front line wield swords and other close-combat weapons.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2030g_00600_02110_1:
Those with spears, greatswords, and other large weapons stand
behind them, while those with long-range weapons—like the girl
herself—watch and wait from even further in the rearguard.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2040g_00100_02110_1: The weapons were procured from the self-driving vehicle\nthey used for transport.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2040g_00200_02110_1: \nEach girl was allotted a different one that signified their role.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2040g_00300_02110_1:
Though they all share the same faces and minds,
they soon begin to separate from one another
based on the weapon they have been given.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2040g_00400_02110_1: \n\nAfter checking on her allies, the girl sights the target.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2050g_00100_02110_1: Something is different from their pre-battle information::<TAP>
EID_a02110_2050g_00200_02110_1: \nThe target shows no reaction to their presence.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2050g_00300_02110_1:
While it seems to know they are there, it shows no interest,
instead choosing to draw idly on the ground with a single finger.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2050g_00400_02110_1:
This behavior is strange; they had been told their target
exhibited characteristics of being "violent and cruel.":<TAP>
EID_a02110_2050g_00500_02110_1: \nThis expected behavior was the reason they had\napproached the upcoming battle with such caution.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2060g_00100_02110_1: Five minutes later, events finally begin to unfold.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2060g_00500_02110_1: \n\nWhen the sword-wielder is fifteen meters away, there is movement.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2060g_00600_02110_1: \nEmpty eyes turn to stare at her.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2070g_00200_02110_1: \nThe moment she raises her sword, the target leaps into the air.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2070g_00400_02110_1: \nThe target twists in the air and uses the speed of its fall\nto slam its arms down on the sword wielder.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2070g_00500_02110_1: \n\nShe blocks the attack with the blunt edge of her weapon.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2080g_00100_02110_1: A cloud of dust rises in the air at the impact.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2080g_00200_02110_1: \nIn the midst of it, the girl's eyes glow red.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2080g_00300_02110_1: \n\nEmpty eyes lock onto a crimson gaze.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2080g_00400_02110_1: \nBoth are shaped like humans, but both are false.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2090g_00100_02110_1: A red light zips around within the dust.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2090g_00200_02110_1: \nBlows and parries are traded with inhuman speed.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2090g_00400_02110_1: \nThe dust slowly settles, exposing the pair.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2090g_00500_02110_1: \n\nThe sniper takes in a short breath and holds it.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00200_02110_1: \nThe moment the sound reaches the target's ears,\nits left arm is blown from its body.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00300_02110_1: \nThe shock robs the creature of its ferocity.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00400_02110_1: \n\nIt slowly collapses into a defenseless heap.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00500_02110_1: \nAnother girl leaps forward from behind the sword user.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00600_02110_1: \nHer spear pierces their foe, ending it.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00800_02110_1: \nThe sniper thinks these words to herself.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2100g_00900_02110_1: \nAt the same time, she notices a strange sensation.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2110g_00100_02110_1: Almost like a hole is being filled.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2110g_00200_02110_1: \nBut the girl does not understand what the feeling is,\nor what brought it about.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2110g_00300_02110_1: \n\nAs though confirming something, she looks at her palms.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2110g_00500_02110_1: \n\nEven though she had just felt she had obtained something.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2120g_00200_02110_1: \nShe readjusts the grip on her rifle and stands.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2120g_00300_02110_1:
With the strange sensation still in her chest,
the girl and her companions set out for the next target.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2120g_00400_02110_1: \n\nIn front is the one who wields the sword.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2120g_00500_02110_1: \nThe roles given to them in battle had led her\nto assume a natural position of leadership.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_2130g_00100_02110_1: The girl in front looks down at her palm as they walk.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2130g_00200_02110_1: \nShe also does not know the source of her discomfort.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2130g_00300_02110_1:
What they feel is not joy in victory; simply excitement that
their perfectly coordinated actions have led to success.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_2130g_00400_02110_1: \n\nBut the girls do not yet understand that.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3010g_00100_02110_1: A white shadow dashes across the ruins.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3010g_00200_02110_1:
The girl runs silently; ahead, her companions
are locked in battle with a mighty foe.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3010g_00300_02110_1:
If her hurried footsteps make even the slightest sound,
the operation will end in failure.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3010g_00400_02110_1: \nYet if she slows her pace in hesitation,\nthere would be many casualties.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3010g_00600_02110_1: \nThe girl runs. She wipes her bloody hands on her sleeve,\nadjusts her grip on her rifle, and increases her pace.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3020g_00100_02110_1: They encountered the mighty foe fifteen minutes ago.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3020g_00200_02110_1: \nThey had just eliminated the eleventh target when it happened::<TAP>
EID_a02110_3020g_00300_02110_1: \n\nCalamity itself rose up above the ruins of a building.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3020g_00500_02110_1: \nIts body was unnatural—an image of the human form, but forcefully\nstretched and enlarged, with skin scarred like an old roadmap.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3030g_00200_02110_1: \nA being that had somehow gained characteristics\nwhich typically did not exist in their kind.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3030g_00300_02110_1: \nThis information was shared with them before the battle.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3030g_00400_02110_1: \nBut while they expected the mutant target,\nthe did not expect it to appear with such speed.:
EID_a02110_3030g_00500_02110_1:
The mutant fell from the sky like a meteorite, crushing one of the
girls on contact. Before the group could even register this fact,
it had felled another of their number.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3030g_00600_02110_1: \n\nThe girls' blood rained down across the ruined city.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3030g_00700_02110_1: \nThe mutant's empty eyes towered above them.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3040g_00100_02110_1: Which brings us to the present.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3040g_00200_02110_1: \nWhile the group successfully reorganized their formation,\nthe battle has not yet turned in their favor.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3040g_00300_02110_1: \n\nDodging the mutant's constant blows, the girls deliver their own.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3040g_00400_02110_1: \nBut their blades cannot pierce its thick skin.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3040g_00500_02110_1:
Their movements begin to slow, exhaustion taking hold
as attack after attack comes up empty.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3040g_00600_02110_1: \nBut then, the sound of an explosion from behind the target::<TAP>
EID_a02110_3040g_00700_02110_1: \nThe unmistakable percussion of a sniper rifle.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3050g_00100_02110_1: A large bullet pierces the mutant's neck,\ncausing the massive figure to stagger.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3050g_00400_02110_1: \nAs the girl loads another bullet in the chamber,\nthe mutant makes a slow turn to face her.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3060g_00100_02110_1: The human body is covered with soft muscle and skin\nthat stretches and contracts as it moves.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3060g_00200_02110_1:
And the larger a body is, the more that muscle and skin
is forced to move and contract—and to stretch thin.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3060g_00300_02110_1: \nThe scars on the mutant's skin are places that have\nbeen damaged from this constant stretching.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3060g_00400_02110_1: \n\nIt was the sword-wielder who first realized this.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3060g_00500_02110_1: \n\nAs the mutant turns, a scar tears open on its lower back.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3060g_00600_02110_1: \nAnd while its attention is focused elsewhere, the sword-wielder\nleaps high in the air and slams her weapon through the opening.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3070g_00100_02110_1: The mutant lets out a cry as it crumbles to the ground.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00200_02110_1: \nThe girl continues running up its back, dragging her blade\nbehind her to create a massive canyon of flesh and bone.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00300_02110_1: \nBlood fountains from the wound, painting her red.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00400_02110_1: \n\nThe mutant falls face first onto the ground.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00600_02110_1: \nThe moment it falls, the remaining girls\nfocus their attack on the head.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00700_02110_1: \n\nSpecifically the neck, where the bullet has created a new scar.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00800_02110_1: \nThe sniper fires again, creating a new furrow in the creature.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3070g_00900_02110_1: \nThe rest of the group attacks this new opening with relish.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3080g_00100_02110_1: The mutant shivers. It howls. Its fingers contract, convulse...\nand then, finally, it moves no more.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3080g_00200_02110_1:
Watching from a distance, the sniper releases her grip on her
rifle and lets out her breath.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3080g_00300_02110_1:
The purpose of holding her breath is to steady her aim.
It is only natural to exhale after the shot.
But this time, it almost sounds like a sigh of relief.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3080g_00400_02110_1: \n\nShe shoulders her rifle and prepares to rejoin the group.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3080g_00500_02110_1: \nBut before she can move, a sound erupts behind her.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_3090g_00200_02110_1: \nIt had emerged from the ruins close to the isolated sniper,\nand now tears out her windpipe.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3100g_00200_02110_1: \nA ragged breath escapes from her ripped throat.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3100g_00300_02110_1: \nIn her dimming consciousness, the girl looks at her palm.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_3100g_00400_02110_1: \n\nAll she finds is her bloody, lifeless hand.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4010g_00100_02110_1: And so, the thirteenth target falls.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4010g_00200_02110_1: \n\nWith the operation complete, the driverless vehicle returns.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4010g_00300_02110_1: \nThe armored machine carries the group back to the place\nwhere they first woke up.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4010g_00400_02110_1:
It is dark in the vehicle, and featureless save for
slots to store weapons and handrails along the sides.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4010g_00500_02110_1: \nIt is the typical construction for a vehicle that carries weapons.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4020g_00100_02110_1: The automobile motors across the wilderness.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4020g_00200_02110_1: \nThe girls sit on the floor inside.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4020g_00300_02110_1: \nA full half of them do not make the return trip.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4020g_00400_02110_1: \n\nThe air is filled with the scent of metal and oppressive silence.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4020g_00500_02110_1: \nThe weapons on the wall still drip with blood.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4020g_00600_02110_1: \nOne of the girls stares at them for no reason in particular.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4030g_00100_02110_1: She sees her own sword, as well as a number of weapons\nthat no longer have anyone to wield them.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4030g_00200_02110_1: \nSome of the slots contain nothing at all,\ntheir weapons having been too damaged to recover.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4030g_00300_02110_1:
In particular, many guns are missing, and the largest such gap is one
that used to hold a sniper rifle.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4030g_00400_02110_1: \n\nA thought crosses the girl's mind as she stares at the space::<TAP>
EID_a02110_4030g_00500_02110_1: \nThere is a hole that will never be filled.:
EID_a02110_4040g_00100_02110_1: The journey continues. No one speaks.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4040g_00200_02110_1: \nDespite the silence, they still hear nothing from outside the vehicle.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4040g_00300_02110_1: \n\nFinally, the girl stops staring at the weapons and closes her eyes.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4040g_00400_02110_1: \nShe leans back and waits for time to pass.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4040g_00500_02110_1:
She knows the return trip is the same distance as the first,
but it seems to be taking much, much longer.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4040g_00600_02110_1: \n\nIt feels like she will be in this vehicle forever.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4050g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThe vehicle finally comes to a stop.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4060g_00400_02110_1:
But the girl who had her eyes closed does not move; instead,
she remains in the vehicle and listens to the footsteps of
her companions slowly fade into the distance.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4060g_00500_02110_1:
Once that sound is no more, she opens her eyes,
forces herself to her feet, and steps out.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4070g_00100_02110_1: The moment she touches ground, the sound of the large doors closing begins.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4070g_00200_02110_1: \n\nOn a whim, she turns back to look.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4070g_00300_02110_1: \nShe sees the wall of weapons slowly disappear.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4070g_00600_02110_1:
The girl stands in place, completely alone,
until the vehicle drives off.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4080g_00100_02110_1: When the girls return to their dark room,\nthey see cold white letters on a blue screen.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4080g_00400_02110_1: \nThe words of praise flicker for a moment before vanishing.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4090g_00100_02110_1: A rundown of their next operation suddenly\nsprings to life on the screen.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4090g_00200_02110_1:
Though the objective and plan remain the same, the scale this time
will be larger, including the number of targets.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4090g_00300_02110_1: \nWhich means their numbers will need to be replenished.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4090g_00400_02110_1: \n\nThe girls stare silently at the screen.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4100g_00100_02110_1: Once the mission statement is complete, the screen urges them\nto enter the row of machines for rest and wound treatment.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4100g_00200_02110_1: \n\nEach girl replies with a single word: "Yes.":<TAP>
EID_a02110_4100g_00300_02110_1: \nBut unlike the last time, they do not speak in unison.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4100g_00500_02110_1: \nThe girls follow orders and return to their coffins.:<PAGE>
EID_a02110_4110g_00100_02110_1: Inside, the girl who closed her eyes cannot stop her thoughts.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4110g_00200_02110_1: \nThey estimated the number of dead and injured.:
EID_a02110_4110g_00300_02110_1: \nThose deaths had been predicted from the start.:
EID_a02110_4110g_00500_02110_1: \nBut that only means I survived this day.:
EID_a02110_4110g_00600_02110_1: \n\nIf I die tomorrow, I will be replaced. The fight will go on.:
EID_a02110_4120g_00100_02110_1: She feels a sense of unease.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4120g_00200_02110_1: \nHer thoughts spin as she drops her gaze to her palms.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4120g_00500_02110_1: \n\nWhat was she trying to think of?:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4130g_00100_02110_1: The machine fills with liquid. Her consciousness fades.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4130g_00200_02110_1: \n\nShe had felt something in her hand.:<TAP>
EID_a02110_4130g_00500_02110_1: \n\nHer question still unanswered, the girl slips into the dark.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_1010g_00100_01060_1: The ruined city lies covered in a thick layer of cloud.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_1010g_00200_01060_1: \nThe soft patter of rain echoes through empty streets.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_1010g_00300_01060_1: \n\nAmidst the still and silence, a young voice emerges from the second floor of a crumbling building::<TAP>
EID_b01060_1010g_00400_01060_1: \n\n"It's okay. A kiss will make the hurt go away.":<TAP>
EID_b01060_1010g_00500_01060_1: \n\nA young girl gently affixes a bandage to a scratch on her little brother's knee.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_1020g_00100_01060_1: The pair have been drifting through the ruined city for days, as though running from something.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_1020g_00200_01060_1: \n\nWet clothes. Dry throats. Empty stomachs. Lost parents.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_1020g_00300_01060_1: \n\nAll these anxieties and fears weigh heavy on their minds.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_1030g_00100_01060_1: Suddenly, there is a quick, faint shudder in the earth.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_1030g_00200_01060_1: \nThey hold their breaths and grip each other tightly.:<TAP>

EID_b01060_4010g_00200_01060_1: \n\nThe enormous creature reaches out to kill them.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4010g_00300_01060_1: \nThe girl places herself in front of her brother and closes her eyes.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4010g_00400_01060_1: \n\nBut then, the sound of gunfire and shattering rock rumbles through the air.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4020g_00100_01060_1: She cautiously opens one eye. Then another.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4020g_00200_01060_1: \n\nThe Legion's splintered body collapses to the ground in a cloud of white dust.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4020g_00300_01060_1: \n\nMoments later, young soldiers in military uniforms rush to her side.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4020g_00400_01060_1: \n\n"You're all right," says the voice of salvation.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4030g_00100_01060_1: This deadly game of hide-and-seek has lasted for days.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4030g_00200_01060_1: \nThe girl's brother begins to bawl as he is released from overwhelming unease.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4030g_00300_01060_1: \n\nAs the young girl holds him tight, powerful emotions well up from the depths of her heart.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4030g_00400_01060_1: \n\nShe wants the strength to protect what is most precious to her.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4040g_00100_01060_1: Sirens wail throughout the escort vessel.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4040g_00200_01060_1: \n\nA hole has been torn in the ship's hull, and it is beginning to sink.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4040g_00300_01060_1: \n\nThe survivors are mired in despair, but the girl alone refuses to succumb to it.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4050g_00100_01060_1: She activates her comm and speaks to whoever is left.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4050g_00200_01060_1: \n\n"All crew, abandon ship. I repeat: Make for the submarine and abandon ship. This is an order.":<TAP>
EID_b01060_4050g_00300_01060_1: \n\nAll who are able drop what they're doing and race for the submarine.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4060g_00100_01060_1: Minutes later, roughly forty souls are gathered in the hanger.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4060g_00200_01060_1: \nIt is less than half the number they started the voyage with—and the girl will not permit any more to be lost.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4060g_00300_01060_1: \n\nThe survivors clamber into the submarine. Once they're safely inside, the girl looks up at the lone figure beckoning her from the open hatch.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4070g_00200_01060_1: \n\nAs the soldier reaches for her hand, a Legion tears the hangar door from its hinges.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4070g_00300_01060_1: \n\nSuddenly, the meaning of her sacrifice is clear::<TAP>
EID_b01060_4070g_00400_01060_1: \nIf she does not stop the remaining Legion, the submarine will never get clear of the ship.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4080g_00100_01060_1: She orders the submarine to push off as quickly as possible.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4080g_00200_01060_1: \n\n"Don't die, Captain!" she hears over her comm. "We'll come back for you!":<TAP>
EID_b01060_4080g_00300_01060_1: \n\n"All right," she replies with a grim smile. "Now go.":<TAP>
EID_b01060_4080g_00400_01060_1: \n\nShe turns her back on the sub as it begins to slip free of the ship.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4090g_00100_01060_1: Fearsome howls echo through the hangar for a time, as well as the clash of steel on bone.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4090g_00200_01060_1: \nThe creatures almost seem to be mocking her.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4090g_00300_01060_1: \n\nLater—she knows not how long—she steadies herself against the wall of the hangar and looks out at the trail of dead.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4090g_00400_01060_1: \n\nHer bones are shattered. Her body is pain.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4100g_00200_01060_1: \n\nAs water fills the halls, she finds herself losing the sense of up from down.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4100g_00300_01060_1: \n\nBut then, a deep rumble fills the air.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4100g_00500_01060_1: \nAnd she knows precisely what it is.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4110g_00100_01060_1: Their cargo—the entire reason they set off on this transport mission—slowly rises up before her.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4110g_00200_01060_1: \n\nThe massive Legion has rent its cage asunder and is now wandering the ship.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4120g_00100_01060_1: This is what tore the ship apart.:
EID_b01060_4120g_00400_01060_1: \nAn enormous foe looms in her path.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4120g_00500_01060_1: \n\nYet in the face of this hopelessness...:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4130g_00100_01060_1: She drops low and swipes her blade at the Legion, her wounds forgotten.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4130g_00200_01060_1: \n\nShe dodges the arm it brings down and plunges her blade into the thin joint between bones.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4130g_00400_01060_1: \n\nThis is her secret—one she has kept hidden ever since the day she awoke in Tokyo...:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4140g_00100_01060_1: The city was a gray ruin.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4140g_00200_01060_1: \n\nIt was the day the organization saved the girl and her brother from the Legion.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4140g_00300_01060_1: \n\nAs she cradled her sobbing brother, she turned her face from him.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4150g_00100_01060_1: The girl suffered from a stress-induced psychiatric disorder, one that developed as a result of constantly protecting her brother.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4150g_00200_01060_1: \n\nThis illness led her to volunteer for increasingly dangerous assignments.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4160g_00100_01060_1: Like when she shouldered punishment in place of her squadmates.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4160g_00200_01060_1: \nOr when she volunteered to lead the vanguard after receiving the SOS signal.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4160g_00300_01060_1: \nOr when she single-handedly rid the ship of Legion.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4160g_00400_01060_1: \n\nEach time, the stress of the situation sent waves of ecstasy flooding through her system.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4170g_00200_01060_1: \n\nBut now, her chest fills with an unfathomable emptiness as she stands atop the Legion's shattered corpse.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4170g_00300_01060_1: \n\nShe gently lifts the monster's decapitated skull in her small hands.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4170g_00400_01060_1: \n\n"Thank you for amusing me," she says before pressing her lips to an exposed piece of bone.:<PAGE>
EID_b01060_4180g_00100_01060_1: The ship slowly slips beneath the waves.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4180g_00200_01060_1: \n\nA girl clings to a broken secret amidst a broken world.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4180g_00300_01060_1: \nAnd a metal vessel carries this secret into the depths.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4180g_00400_01060_1: \n\nMoments later, the waves wash quietly atop one another as though nothing was ever there at all.:<TAP>
EID_b01060_4180g_00500_01060_1: \n\nAnd the rays of sun that shine between the clouds bathe the ocean in a soft and fleeting light.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1010g_00100_01070_1: The city is an empty gray expanse.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1010g_00200_01070_1: \n\nA uniformed group marches through the rubble-strewn streets—a 20-person platoon dispatched by the organization.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1010g_00300_01070_1: \n\nOne boy—quiet by nature—walks behind the rest.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1010g_00400_01070_1: \nHis eyes suddenly drop to his feet, and what he sees there steals his words away.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1020g_00100_01070_1: White powder is strewn over the pavement, blown here and there in the wind.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1020g_00200_01070_1: \nIt is salt. But this is no ordinary mineral; this has come from human corpses.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1020g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThose afflicted by the disease find their fate in one of two ways.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1020g_00500_01070_1: \n\nOne: Their bodies turn to salt and they die.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1020g_00600_01070_1: \nTwo: They lose themselves and become monsters called Legion.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1030g_00100_01070_1: The quiet boy makes a sound then: a small yip.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1030g_00200_01070_1: \n\nIn an attempt to avoid the blowing salt, he has lost his footing.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1030g_00300_01070_1: \nBut he does not hit the ground.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1030g_00400_01070_1: \n\nA uniformed girl behind him grabs his arm, effortlessly keeping him upright.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1040g_00100_01070_1: Shocked by her strength, he opens his mouth to thank her.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1040g_00200_01070_1: \nBut her mouth widens in a mischievous grin, her crooked teeth on full display.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1040g_00300_01070_1: \n\n"You tripped on nothing there, man! Goddamn, you really are the Feeble Kid.":<TAP>
EID_b01070_1040g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThe boy draws a breath to reply, but finds himself too intimidated to speak.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1050g_00100_01070_1: "Cut it out," says another girl as she twirls her red hair with a finger. "Us rejects need to get along.":<TAP>
EID_b01070_1050g_00200_01070_1: \nThe girl with crooked teeth turns her savage gaze towards the redhead.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1050g_00400_01070_1: \n\n"You. Me. All of us. Haven't you noticed? This platoon is made up of underachievers.":<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1060g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThe platoon is comprised entirely of rejects.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1060g_00300_01070_1: \nThis mission is their last chance to remain with the organization.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1060g_00400_01070_1: \n\nBut the girl with crooked teeth does not accept this.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1060g_00500_01070_1: \n\n"I bet the people up top are worried about the reject platoon, so they stuck me here as insurance.":<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1070g_00100_01070_1: The platoon's mission is to venture into an unexplored area and find a specific individual.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1070g_00300_01070_1: \nEyewitnesses claim that though he is afflicted with white chlorination syndrome, he retains his mental faculties.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1070g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThey must find this man. If they do not, the platoon will be out of chances.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1080g_00100_01070_1: "Hey, c'mon," says a small boy with uneasy eyes. "Stop fighting.":<TAP>
EID_b01070_1080g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThis boy knows the girls will argue forever unless he intervenes.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1080g_00300_01070_1: \n\nHis voice is nasally. His eyes twitch. He is the very picture of a coward.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1080g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThe girl bears her crooked teeth at the cowardly boy and hisses, sending him scuttling away.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1090g_00100_01070_1: The quiet boy gives the rowdy trio a sidelong glance.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1090g_00200_01070_1: \nSighing, he turns his gaze to the sky and examines the gloomy violet cloud that hangs low over the city.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1090g_00400_01070_1: \n\nHe knows this. He has known it since they first set foot in the city two hours and forty-two minutes ago.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1090g_00500_01070_1: \n\nRain is on the way, a torrential downpour with lightning, wind, and fury.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1100g_00100_01070_1: The quiet boy hoped conditions would improve, but it is not to be.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1100g_00300_01070_1: \n\nIf a storm is incoming, they need to change their route.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1100g_00400_01070_1: \n\nBut no one replies. Instead, they come to a sudden halt and fix their eyes on a spot.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1110g_00300_01070_1: \n\nA skyscraper stands on the edge of collapse, its metal frame bared to the open air. And behind it, Legion.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1110g_00400_01070_1: \nThis is the fate of a person who becomes infected with white chlorination syndrome and loses control.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1120g_00100_01070_1: Its outer shell is hardened bone—a cross between an insect and a crustacean.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1120g_00200_01070_1: \nAnd it is easily over 130 feet tall.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1120g_00300_01070_1: \n\nFear and bewilderment race through the platoon; they had no warning so massive an enemy might be waiting for them.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1130g_00100_01070_1: Humans of flesh and blood—and rejects at that—stand no hope against it.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1130g_00200_01070_1: \nIt is so unreal, the platoon has trouble accepting it.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1130g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThe Legion slowly turns to look at them.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1130g_00500_01070_1: \nAs a single screaming mass, they turn and run into a nearby ruin of a building.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1140g_00100_01070_1: Behind them, the monster's howl causes their ears to bleed.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1140g_00200_01070_1: \nThe building in which they sought shelter shudders, scarcely holding together.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1140g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThe Legion is attempting to smash the building and everyone inside it.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1140g_00400_01070_1: \nThe platoon members shudder in terror, their minds threatening to break at any moment.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1140g_00600_01070_1: \nHis breaths alone remain measured. Steady. Calm.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1150g_00100_01070_1: He stares out the window and thinks.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1150g_00200_01070_1: \n\nBeyond the shattered glass, small droplets of rain quickly turn into a torrential downpour.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1150g_00300_01070_1: \n\nFlashes of lightning illuminate gray clouds, followed by thunder nearly as loud as the Legion's howl.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1160g_00200_01070_1: \nHe knows how they can escape—and more than that, how his platoon of rejects can defeat the Legion outside.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1160g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThe cold steel in his voice instantly stills the panic rippling through his fellows.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1170g_00100_01070_1: Prompted by their gazes, he begins to explain.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1170g_00200_01070_1: \n\nHe tells them how they can get out of this despair. About his one-in-a-million bet.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1170g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThe platoon hesitates at first, but they eventually realize it is the only hope they have.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1170g_00400_01070_1: \nAt least it's better than waiting for death.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1180g_00100_01070_1: The quiet boy runs up a set of collapsing stairs to the roof and looks down over the city.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1180g_00200_01070_1: \n\nPositioning himself somewhere with a clear view of the city below, he begins issuing orders that he hopes will get the Legion's attention.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1190g_00100_01070_1: First up is the cowardly boy, who bursts from the building and begins to run. He is the swiftest of their group.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1190g_00200_01070_1: \n\nHe is the lure for the Legion. The bait. His fellows make sure the path is open for him.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1190g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThe girl with crooked teeth uses superhuman strength to remove piles of rubble, creating the shortest route to the target location.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1190g_00400_01070_1: \nThe rest of the platoon helps as best they can, clearing a path for the boy as he races past.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1200g_00100_01070_1: The Legion lumbers after him, growing ever closer. But just as it is ready to reach down and rend the cowardly boy in two...:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1200g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThe redheaded girl's voice echoes around the ruined city.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1200g_00400_01070_1: \nFrom atop a nearby roof, she fires a bullet that knocks the Legion's hand away.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1210g_00100_01070_1: Every member of the platoon knows what they must do, and they give their all to the effort.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1210g_00300_01070_1: \n\nBecause the quiet boy understands the strengths of his reject platoon.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1210g_00400_01070_1: \n\nFinally, coward and monster arrive at a suspension bridge on the verge of collapse.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1220g_00100_01070_1: Aging wires extend from worn-out towers, barely holding up the bridge deck as it sways in the storm.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1220g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThe bridge groans as the massive creature steps upon it.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1220g_00300_01070_1: A flash of lightning streaks across the sky, covering the empty city in blinding white light.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1220g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThe entire platoon looks up as if in prayer.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1230g_00100_01070_1: A loud rumble rips apart the sky.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1230g_00200_01070_1: \nLightning has struck the bridge's supporting tower.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1230g_00300_01070_1: \n\nWires twist and snap as the deck begins to give way.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1230g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThe cowardly boy dashes across the undulating surface and leaps to safety.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1230g_00500_01070_1: \nBut the Legion is not so coordinated, and it stumbles to the side.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1240g_00100_01070_1: As it does, the bridge finally gives way, plunging stone and wire and beast down into the abyss.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1240g_00200_01070_1: \nIt wails as it falls, giving voice to madness.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1240g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThough it is unlikely to be dead, the Legion will not be crawling up anytime soon.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1240g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThe platoon rejoices at the quiet boy's brilliance.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_1250g_00100_01070_1: He knew lightning always strikes the highest point.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1250g_00200_01070_1: \n\nSo he had them lead the Legion to the bridge in the hopes a bolt might strike one of the towers.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1250g_00300_01070_1: \n\nIt was not so much a strategy as a last gasp—yet when he proposed the idea, everyone trusted him completely.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1250g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThere are no casualties. The reject platoon lives on.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_1250g_00500_01070_1: \nAnd in that moment, they all begin to praise their newfound savior.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2010g_00100_01070_1: A platoon of rejects has been given a mission.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2010g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThey are to find a researcher who is afflicted with white chlorination syndrome, yet retains his faculties.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2010g_00300_01070_1: \n\nOn the way, an unexpected enemy appeared: a monster known as Legion.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2010g_00400_01070_1: \n\nBut they worked together to overcome the threat.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2020g_00100_01070_1: "Come in! I repeat, come in. Do you copy? Over!":<TAP>
EID_b01070_2020g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThe quiet boy stands atop a skyscraper. He speaks into his wireless communication device and attempts to issue orders.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2020g_00300_01070_1: \nYet the only responses he receives are the death throes of his platoonmates.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2020g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThey are the last thing he hears before communications cut off entirely.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2020g_00500_01070_1: \n\nThey avoided one Legion threat, but a total of six were lurking in the area.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2030g_00100_01070_1: The quiet boy has strategic prowess. His companions have hidden powers.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2030g_00200_01070_1: \nYet a mere twenty of them cannot hope to take out multiple Legion.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2030g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThey requested backup from the organization, but none is coming.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2030g_00400_01070_1: \n\nThey are cornered now. Trapped. Doomed to annihilation.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2040g_00100_01070_1: He hears his companions screaming for help before Legion howls drown them out.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2040g_00200_01070_1: \n\nUnsure what to do, the boy stands frozen.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2040g_00300_01070_1: \nHe prays this hell might pass him by.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2050g_00100_01070_1: A sudden quiet descends like a hammer.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2050g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThen they whirl about as one and begin marching away.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2050g_00500_01070_1: \n\nThe boy does not know what is happening.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2050g_00600_01070_1: \nRegardless, it is a miracle. His prayer has been answered.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2060g_00100_01070_1: His surviving platoonmates slowly make their way to him.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2060g_00200_01070_1: \nThey cradle bloody corpses in their arms: remnants of their fellows.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2060g_00300_01070_1: \n\nThirteen corpses lay on the floor of a ruined building—including that of the cowardly boy.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2060g_00400_01070_1: \n\nHe was quick, and agreed to act as bait. But he was not fast enough to escape the other Legion, and when they caught him, they tore him limb from limb.:<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2070g_00100_01070_1: "This is all your fault!" cries the girl with crooked teeth as she grabs the quiet boy by the collar.:
EID_b01070_2070g_00200_01070_1: \nHer bloodied face twists into a scowl of rage.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2070g_00300_01070_1: \n\n"I knew we never should've followed the Feeble Kid.":<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2080g_00200_01070_1: \nThe organization's commanding officers use this insult whenever they want to ridicule the boy.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2080g_00300_01070_1: \n\nAnd he can never argue with it.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2080g_00400_01070_1: \n\n"Enough," says the redheaded girl. "The Legion retreated. We've got a chance.":<TAP>
EID_b01070_2090g_00100_01070_1: "You know they only retreated because they were responding to something, right?":<TAP>
EID_b01070_2090g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThe girl with crooked teeth's lips tremble in fear.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2090g_00300_01070_1: \n\n"This means there might be a Red Eye nearby.":<PAGE>
EID_b01070_2100g_00200_01070_1: \n\nThe nickname for intelligent Legion—those whose eyes glow red.:<TAP>
EID_b01070_2100g_00300_01070_1: \nThey have the ability to control other, mindless Legion, which makes them infinitely more terrifying.:<TAP>

EID_b01070_3040g_00200_01070_1: \n\nBut as they venture through the facility, disappointment colors their faces.:<PAGE>
