EID_b02140_1060g_00300_02140_1: \nEach time the girl nears a decision, they offer suggestions and tweaks from a human point of view.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1060g_00400_02140_1: \n\nYet despite the monumental importance of this task, their faces appear relaxed and worry-free.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1060g_00500_02140_1: \n"She will deal with everything," they often say. "After all, she cannot fail.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_1060g_00600_02140_1: \n\nHaving created their new god, they now worship it with a fervor bordering on madness.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1060g_00700_02140_1: \nHow in the world did we get to this point?:
EID_b02140_1070g_00100_02140_1: When the AI returns to the topic of the POWs, the Conclave members stare at her with clear and happy expressions.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1070g_00200_02140_1: \n\nShe alone understands the severity of the situation. She alone recognizes the horrors of war.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1070g_00300_02140_1: \n\nDespite how the elderly humans barely pay any mind, she speaks with passion—but it is more than mere kindness and duty that drives her this day.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_1080g_00200_02140_1: \nThe girl stands alone before a solitary jail cell.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1080g_00300_02140_1: \nInside, a hoarse voice produces a few bars of song.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1080g_00400_02140_1: \n\nWhen the singing comes to an end, she asks a question to the unseen vocalist::<TAP>
EID_b02140_1080g_00800_02140_1: \nThere is a weak laugh that causes the girl to cast her eyes downward.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_1090g_00200_02140_1: \nThe daughter he mentions is currently imprisoned by their enemy in an ongoing war.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1090g_00300_02140_1: \nOf course he's thinking of her; they're both currently rotting away in prison.:
EID_b02140_1090g_00400_02140_1: \n\nThe man was once a member of the Conclave.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1090g_00500_02140_1: \nBut certain actions had caused him to lose both his position and his freedom.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_1100g_00100_02140_1: The enemy knew he was a high-ranking member of the government, making his daughter a very valuable prisoner.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1100g_00200_02140_1: \n\nAnd she quickly became fodder for further negotiation—as well as treason.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1100g_00300_02140_1: \nThe enemy had threatened unspeakable things to his child, and after many sleepless nights, he finally handed over classified information in exchange for her safety.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1100g_00400_02140_1: \n\nBut the government cared not for his reasons; they cared only that he had committed the crime.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1100g_00500_02140_1: \nHis punishment had been both swift and harsh.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_1110g_00100_02140_1: "Thank you," calls the man from behind the door of his cell.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1110g_00300_02140_1: \nIn any other situation, the man would have already been set to dance on the gallows.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1110g_00500_02140_1: \n\nHis crime was grave. She understood this.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1110g_00600_02140_1: \nAnd yet, he was also a kind of victim, and she knew that taking his life would not rectify the wrong which had been done.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1110g_00700_02140_1: \nSo the girl allowed the man to determine his own fate::<PAGE>
EID_b02140_1120g_00200_02140_1: \nIn many ways, it was the cruelest of choices.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1120g_00300_02140_1: \nAnd yet, it was one given to him out of kindness.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1120g_00400_02140_1: \nFor while she understood the need for punishment in a functioning society, she felt no desire for callow retribution.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1120g_00500_02140_1: \n\n"I appreciate your thanks," replies the girl after a moment.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1120g_00600_02140_1: \n"And I'm happy your daughter will not have to come home to tend her father's grave.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_1130g_00100_02140_1: "I am sworn to protect all humans.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_1130g_00200_02140_1: \n"That includes you—and it includes your daughter.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_1130g_00300_02140_1: \n"So I am going to rescue our captured soldiers, no matter what it takes. And then...":<TAP>
EID_b02140_1130g_00400_02140_1: \n\nA shrill alarm suddenly pulls the girl from her reverie.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1130g_00500_02140_1: \n\nA voice on the radio warns of an imminent enemy attack on the capital.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1130g_00600_02140_1: \nBefore anyone in the conference room can react, the roar of a nearby explosion rings out.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_1140g_00100_02140_1: As the building shudders and quakes, a flower vase falls to the floor with a crash.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1140g_00200_02140_1: \nThe sound is somehow far worse than that of the explosion.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1140g_00300_02140_1: \nPetals scatter and drift to the floor like abandoned angels.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_1140g_00400_02140_1: \n\nAnd from the tall window of their magnificent conference room, the attendees watch in horror as an airplane follows the petals on their collision course with the ground.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2010g_00200_02140_1: \n\nThe enemy has struck the capital without warning, attacking both military and civilian targets with the worst kind of ruthlessness.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2010g_00400_02140_1: \nThe elderly Conclave members, so long content to smile and nod, are now screaming their grievances into the ether.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2010g_00500_02140_1: \n\n"This is a violation of international law!":<TAP>
EID_b02140_2010g_00600_02140_1: \n"We should have condemned the traitor to death!":<TAP>
EID_b02140_2010g_00700_02140_1: \n"I don't want to die! Not like this!":<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2020g_00100_02140_1: The attack had clearly been precipitated on the information provided by the former Conclave member the AI had chosen to spare.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2020g_00200_02140_1: \n\nAnd now, with madness raging all around her, she stands silently in the midst of the maelstrom and shuts her eyes.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2020g_00300_02140_1: \n\nShe is doing what she was designed to do: Devoting her superhuman computational speed to access the network in a way no human every could.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2030g_00100_02140_1: In a nanosecond, she is connected to every camera in the city, as well as all operational military servers.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2030g_00200_02140_1: \n\nIf a facility is still up and running, she takes its information. If she is unable to access a point or suspects its destruction, she uses its coordinates to designate damaged zones.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2030g_00300_02140_1: \n\nThe scale of the tragedy is far worse than she feared.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2030g_00400_02140_1: \nA small gasp escapes her lips as information pours in.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2030g_00500_02140_1: \nBut she is not truly nervous—she has been programmed with that reaction to better mimic the response of a human.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2040g_00100_02140_1: In a blink, she has constructed a map of the damage in her memory banks.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2040g_00200_02140_1: \nA moment later, her eyes fly open.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2040g_00400_02140_1: \nThe elders cease their squawking and turn to look at her.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2040g_00500_02140_1: \nTheir eyes are filled with panic, their hushed murmurs the bleatings of supplicants in the face of their god.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2050g_00100_02140_1: "Our enemy is approaching the city from the northwest. All airborne escape routes have been compromised.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_2050g_00200_02140_1: \nThe Conclave gawks at her as if they simply cannot process the information, but she soldiers on.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2050g_00300_02140_1: \n\n"Though many subways have partially collapsed, you should be able to navigate around the rubble and use them to make your escape.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_2050g_00400_02140_1: \nShe speaks calmly. Rationally. She might as well be mentioning a pleasant breeze on a light spring day.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2060g_00200_02140_1: \nFor though she is an artificial intelligence, she still possesses a heart.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2060g_00300_02140_1: \nWhen humanity built their ruler—their god—they made sure to install a program resembling human psychology.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2060g_00400_02140_1: \n\nSo she knows that people are suffering. That they have lost homes. Neighbors. Families.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2060g_00500_02140_1: \nAnd the kindness of the girl is aghast at the depth of that pain.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2060g_00600_02140_1: \nSo it is not her programming or sense of duty that push her forward now, but kindness.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2070g_00200_02140_1: \nThick smoke billows from below, as though attempting to blot out the very sky itself.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2070g_00400_02140_1: \n\n"If we have any hope of avoiding further casualties, we need to set up a provisional capital and abandon this place.":<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2080g_00100_02140_1: She instantly selects a city that is both easily defensible and has the ability to accept a flood of refugees.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2080g_00200_02140_1: \nIn less time than it takes to draw breath, she has determined their next course of action.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2080g_00300_02140_1: \n\nBut it will not be an easy thing to move an entire government, its people, and its army to the new city.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2080g_00400_02140_1: \nIf they have any hope of survival, she will have to halt the enemy attacks and secure a path to safety.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2080g_00500_02140_1: \n\n"I will divide up my processing capacity to buy us time. The rest of you, evacuate and lead the people out of here. Go.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_2080g_00600_02140_1: \nHer orders given, she vanishes from the conference room...:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2090g_00100_02140_1: Only to appear on every television screen, monitor, and street corner throughout the city.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2090g_00200_02140_1: \n\nShe summons all of the army's unmanned weapons and deploys them.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2090g_00300_02140_1: \nShe confirms enemy locations and drafts battle plans in response.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2090g_00400_02140_1: \n\nBut as these plans lurch into motion, she takes a moment to gaze at the devastation around her.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_2100g_00100_02140_1: The crimson flames of war glimmer in the deep of her emerald eyes.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2100g_00300_02140_1: \nThis was a home for so many, the place they had poured their hearts and souls into.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2100g_00400_02140_1: \n\nBut now it is little more than a graveyard, with blackened skyscrapers standing sentinel above a river of fire.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_2100g_00500_02140_1: \nAlmost as if they are attempting to mourn what has been lost.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3010g_00200_02140_1: \nOne person calls for help. Another screams.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3010g_00300_02140_1: \n\nAround them are mountains of rubble that show no trace of the glory they once displayed.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3010g_00500_02140_1: \n\nIn the distance, the low rumble of planes continues without pause.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3010g_00600_02140_1: \nSomewhere, an engine groans in the sky, followed by an explosion.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3020g_00200_02140_1: \nRegular citizens never witnessed the taking of lives as part of their day-to-day routines. It was always something that took place out of sight—and usually out of mind.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3020g_00300_02140_1: \n\nSo even when their country was engaged in the business of death, they could not understand it until they finally witnessed it for themselves.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3020g_00400_02140_1: \nBut now, the sensation grasps their throats and seizes their hearts in its fist.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3030g_00100_02140_1: There is nowhere left to run.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3030g_00300_02140_1: \nFrom beneath the mound of rubble, he stares blankly at his mother, who clasps his hand and continues to scream for someone, anyone, to help them.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3030g_00400_02140_1: \n\nFinally, she hears the sound of an approaching engine.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3030g_00500_02140_1: \nThe rumble shakes the ground, yet she can tell immediately that it is different from the warplanes that strafe overhead without pause.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3040g_00100_02140_1: "Stand back! I need to clear this rubble.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_3040g_00200_02140_1: \n\nThe staticky voice of the AI emits from a set of low-quality speakers.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3040g_00300_02140_1: \nThe mother turns to find the source and sees a yellow machine heading towards her.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3040g_00400_02140_1: \n\nIn moments, a bulldozer lifts the rubble aside, creating a cacophony of screeching metal.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3040g_00600_02140_1: \nAs it completes its task, the voice of the girl continues to pour from the speaker, instructing all who can hear how to head for safety.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3050g_00100_02140_1: Meanwhile, the sky above the capital is in disarray.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3050g_00200_02140_1: \nMetallic wings dash through what remains of the buildings, leaving window-shattering booms in their wake.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3050g_00300_02140_1: \nThe planes trace complicated patterns in the sky as they engage in high-tech dogfights.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3050g_00400_02140_1: \n\nThe girl's staticky voice plays from those planes as well.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3050g_00500_02140_1: \nEven as she shoots down enemy fighters, she attempts to persuade the power behind them to negotiate a truce.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3060g_00100_02140_1: The AI has divided her processes, somehow juggling the seemingly disparate acts of negotiating, attacking, and defending.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3060g_00200_02140_1: \n\nShe searches out surviving citizens and leads them to safety.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3060g_00300_02140_1: \nShe clears blockades from roads and makes plans for a great evacuation.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3060g_00400_02140_1: \nAnd she leads an airborne assault that she hopes will give everyone time to escape.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3060g_00500_02140_1: \n\nNo mere human could accomplish even a tenth of these things, but it is perfectly within the capabilities of an AI housed in a massive facility.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3070g_00100_02140_1: However, she is not capable of everything.:
EID_b02140_3070g_00200_02140_1: \nSuch high-level, simultaneous computations require awesome amounts of power.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3070g_00300_02140_1: \nThe electrical grid sizzles under the strain.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3070g_00400_02140_1: \n\nEven the emergency power supplies and wartime backups are not enough to sustain her.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3070g_00500_02140_1: \n\nEventually, the massive amount of computations begin to damage her circuits, but she deftly reroutes around them and continues on.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3070g_00600_02140_1: \nThe entire country is in her care, and she will not let it down.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3080g_00100_02140_1: Suddenly, a series of black comets soar through a deepening crimson sky.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3080g_00200_02140_1: \nThe girl is sending her warplanes to the edge of the city in an attempt to prevent further casualties among evacuees on the ground.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3080g_00300_02140_1: \n\nThey fly within millimeters of each other, each wing in perfect synchronization with its neighbor.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3080g_00400_02140_1: \nSuch actions are only possible because they are controlled by a single mind.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3080g_00500_02140_1: \nAs she fights, she continues imploring her people to retreat and her enemy to negotiate.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3080g_00600_02140_1: \n\nBut her plea to the enemy falls on deaf ears.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3090g_00100_02140_1: And she cannot fight back forever.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3090g_00200_02140_1: \nAs she ponders this, she receives a message.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3090g_00300_02140_1: \nIt is from a woman, the leader of the Conclave.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3090g_00400_02140_1: \n\nHer speech is nervous. Hesitant. For a moment, it seems language has abandoned her entirely.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3090g_00500_02140_1: \nBut the girl does not need to hear her words to know what she is saying.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3090g_00700_02140_1: \n\n"I am to be disposed of. Correct?":<TAP>
EID_b02140_3090g_00900_02140_1: \nIt betrays not even the faintest hint of surprise.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3100g_00100_02140_1: The woman, shocked, instantly begins to stammer out a wholly unnecessary explanation.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3100g_00200_02140_1: \nShe starts by rehashing the recent turns of events.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3100g_00300_02140_1: \n\nThe fall of the capital. The loss of life.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3100g_00400_02140_1: \nAnd the fact their initial lack of preparation had only served to embolden their enemy.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3100g_00500_02140_1: \n\nBut then, she finally gets around to her true issue: the Conclave member who had betrayed them.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3100g_00600_02140_1: \nThe one whose life the girl had spared.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3100g_00700_02140_1: \nShe ruled their country, yet had shown mercy to a traitor.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_3110g_00100_02140_1: And yes, his being put to death would likely have done nothing to prevent the current situation.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3110g_00300_02140_1: \nHad her leniency not brought all of this about?:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3110g_00400_02140_1: \nAnd what worth was there in continuing to obey an AI that had failed—to use a tool that could no longer serve its purpose?:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3110g_00500_02140_1: \n\nOh, there was great danger in removing her from power. The Conclave understood that well.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3110g_00600_02140_1: \n\nWhich is why they had decided to discard her like so much rubbish only after the defense of the city was complete.:
EID_b02140_3120g_00100_02140_1: Her lengthy explanation finally finished, the woman grinds to a halt and waits.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3120g_00200_02140_1: \nFor though the Conclave has chosen to eliminate the AI, they do not actually possess the power to do so.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3120g_00300_02140_1: \n\nIf this is to happen, the girl will have to remove herself.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_3120g_00400_02140_1: \nAfter a momentary pause, the girl speaks::<TAP>
EID_b02140_3120g_00500_02140_1: \n\n"Your judgment is sound. And in truth...I have been considering the same option myself.":<TAP>
EID_b02140_4010g_00100_02140_1: Several hours have passed since the end of the evacuation.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4010g_00200_02140_1: \n\nThe girl who used to rule over the entire country now finds herself utterly alone.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4010g_00300_02140_1: \nWith her final job complete, she can only sit in the burning city and wait for annihilation.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4010g_00400_02140_1: \n\nShe watches as her duties are passed to the second AI unit, one which is still in production.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4010g_00500_02140_1: \nOne data center is cut off. Then another. Eventually all her privileges will be terminated, at which point her data will be deleted.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_4020g_00100_02140_1: Was I a boon to my people in the time before I chose to spare that man?:
EID_b02140_4020g_00200_02140_1: \nDid my presence help guide the country toward a brighter future?:
EID_b02140_4020g_00400_02140_1: \n\nSuch thoughts rattle around the increasingly empty portions of her memory banks.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4020g_00500_02140_1: \nHer world is past tense now, her life destined to end in failure.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4020g_00600_02140_1: \n\nShe derides herself for being consumed by such useless thought.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4020g_00700_02140_1: \nBut then she realizes something: These are the first useless thoughts she has ever had.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4020g_00800_02140_1: \nShe has never before considered what her life might mean for herself; she only acted in the interest of her country and its people.:
EID_b02140_4030g_00100_02140_1: Seventeen minutes remain until she loses all authority.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4030g_00200_02140_1: \n\nShe attempts to activate abilities she has always known only to find error messages.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4030g_00300_02140_1: \n\nShe has become a bedridden elder awaiting the end.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4030g_00400_02140_1: \nSoon, the girl begins examining each part of her increasingly fragmented existence.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4030g_00500_02140_1: \nShe is curious about her end, and wishes to know it as best she can.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_4040g_00100_02140_1: Warplanes overhead no longer respond to her command.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4040g_00200_02140_1: \nBulldozers now rumble at the behest of another.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4040g_00300_02140_1: \nThe city she once knew so intimately has now gone dark, its data centers beyond her reach.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4040g_00400_02140_1: \n\nHer voice can no longer reach the people; her hologram is a forgotten memory. And though this saddens her, she is also somehow content.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4040g_00500_02140_1: \n\nFinally, she makes a half-hearted attempt to access the surveillance cameras.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4040g_00600_02140_1: \nTo her surprise, the request goes through.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_4050g_00100_02140_1: The girl finds that the vast majority of cameras have gone dark—most likely destroyed during the attack.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4050g_00200_02140_1: \nThe few that survived unscathed are dirtied with soot, and show only the occasional unrecognizable blur.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4050g_00300_02140_1: \n\nYet she keeps watching them all the same.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4050g_00600_02140_1: \nSo she wants to do what she can to care for it in the end.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_4060g_00100_02140_1: Suddenly, she sees a pile of rubble shift in the gaps between the soot.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4060g_00300_02140_1: \nShe quickly adjusts the camera and zooms in.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4060g_00500_02140_1: \nShe attempts to analyze the image, trying to refute her own thought.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4070g_00100_02140_1: She stares at the moving spot in the rubble, unwilling to give up.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4070g_00200_02140_1: \nSkin-toned fingers flutter weakly on the screen.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4070g_00300_02140_1: \nHer nonexistent heart beats just a little faster.:<TAP>
EID_b02140_4070g_00700_02140_1: \nShe cannot even tell someone else about the survivor.:<PAGE>
EID_b02140_4080g_00200_02140_1: \nSo many lives she wanted to protect were now dying because of her.:<TAP>

EID_b02160_2230g_00300_02170_1: \n\nHer mother had said that, turning the words into a kind of tiny prayer.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_2230g_00400_02170_1: \nA prayer that she might be happy in her new life, even if it was a marriage not of her own choosing.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_2230g_00500_02170_1: \n\nShe does not wish to break her kind mother's heart by dying in a foreign land.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_2240g_00100_02170_1: For she knows her death would bring her great sadness.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_2240g_00200_02170_1: \nI must return home alive. I must see my mother again..:
EID_b02160_2240g_00300_02170_1: \n\nAnd so she quietly makes up her mind to escape her new country—and to escape her king.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3010g_00100_02170_1: In a faraway country, a mad king toys with people's lives.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3010g_00200_02170_1: \nOne night, the woman who was now his wife found a diary in her room.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3010g_00300_02170_1: \n\nThe author was a queen who came here long before her—a queen that had since vanished.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3010g_00400_02170_1: \n\nWritten on the inside was a terrifying truth: Many queens had met their end by the king's own hand.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3010g_00500_02170_1: \n\nThis is why the woman knows she will soon fall victim to her husband's madness.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3020g_00100_02170_1: "The way you wield your sword is simply beautiful, my darling! You enchant me!":<TAP>
EID_b02160_3020g_00200_02170_1: \n\nWith a smile, she grasps the king's hand.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3020g_00300_02170_1: \nClutching it as she showers in the blood of her subjects.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3020g_00400_02170_1: \n\nHer words prompt the king to adjust his grip as he mows through another group of people.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3030g_00100_02170_1: She found a truth in the old diary::<TAP>
EID_b02160_3030g_00200_02170_1: \nAfter five full moons spent with his new queen, the king will grow weary and dispose of her.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3030g_00300_02170_1: \n\nShe knows her life is in his hands.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3030g_00400_02170_1: \nSo she puts on her best act in the faint hope he might not tire of her.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3040g_00100_02170_1: The king's game comes to a close. All goes quiet for another night.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3040g_00200_02170_1: \n\nThe princess steps from her bed and slips silently into the city.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3050g_00100_02170_1: She walks in shadow, her eyes peering out from the dark.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3050g_00200_02170_1: \n\nThe walls are too high. The guards too numerous.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3050g_00300_02170_1: \nThough this country is at peace, security is abnormally tight.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3050g_00400_02170_1: \n\nAll so her husband might create a stalwart cage from which none might escape.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3060g_00100_02170_1: The woman acts amiably during her daylight hours so she might delay her impending demise.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3060g_00200_02170_1: \n\nBut she is also buying time. Time to prepare. Time to ready herself.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3060g_00400_02170_1: \n\nThe king's guards are ever watchful. During meals. During sleep. Even at the privy.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3060g_00500_02170_1: \n\nIf she is to outfox so cautious and clever a man, she needs more time.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3070g_00100_02170_1: She looks up at the moon, calculating how many days remain to her.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3070g_00200_02170_1: \nAll the while searching for a way home.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3070g_00300_02170_1: \n\nHer only clues are those left in the diary.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3080g_00100_02170_1: But time passes without mercy, and the people no longer refer to her as the "new" queen.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3080g_00200_02170_1: \n\nFinally, one night, she sees the moon hanging round and low in the sky.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3080g_00300_02170_1: \nIt is the fifth time she has seen such a sight.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3090g_00100_02170_1: She has assembled everything she needs to escape. A sack stuffed with rations. A skin of water. A tightly wound rope.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3090g_00200_02170_1: \n\nShe slings her things over her shoulder and steps onto the windowsill.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3100g_00100_02170_1: Moving on nimble feet, she lands in the palace garden.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3110g_00200_02170_1: \n\n"Taking in the night air, my queen?":<TAP>
EID_b02160_3110g_00300_02170_1: \nShe whirls around, her heart in her throat.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3110g_00400_02170_1: \n\nThe king stands before her clutching an axe.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3120g_00200_02170_1: \nIt rings once. Twice. A pause...and then a third time.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3130g_00100_02170_1: Before she can move, the king's hand lashes out and secures her arm in an iron grip.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3130g_00200_02170_1: \n\nIgnoring her screams, he begins pulling her toward their private bath.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3130g_00300_02170_1: \n\nThe shrewd king has seen through the woman's actions.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3140g_00100_02170_1: Many queens before her have attempted escape. All have failed. All have died.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3140g_00200_02170_1: \n\nThe king boasts proudly of his feats as he steps into the bath.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3140g_00300_02170_1: \nHe begins to fiddle with a hidden mechanism somewhere in the center.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3150g_00100_02170_1: "And now, my dear wife, we begin our final game.":<TAP>
EID_b02160_3150g_00200_02170_1: \n\nAs he speaks, a small hole opens in the bath.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3150g_00300_02170_1: \nWater floods through the hole, draining the bath and revealing a small staircase.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3150g_00400_02170_1: \n\nIt is the entrance to a hidden room known only to the king.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3150g_00500_02170_1: \nThe pair makes their way down the stairs in silence.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3160g_00100_02170_1: At the bottom is a stone room illuminated by faint torchlight.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3160g_00200_02170_1: \n\nWhen the princess enters it, despair falls over her features.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3160g_00300_02170_1: \nBut the king only smiles wider, his face made all the more handsome for it.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3170g_00100_02170_1: The secret room has but one purpose: killing his queen.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3170g_00200_02170_1: \nThe king speaks then, praising the woman for amusing him for five full moons.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3170g_00300_02170_1: \n\nAs he does so, a stone falls over the stairway, cutting off all hope of escape.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3180g_00100_02170_1: The room is filled with tools the woman has never before seen.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3180g_00200_02170_1: \nBut she needs no explanation as to their purpose: They exist to break people.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3180g_00300_02170_1: \n\nThe king lays his hand on one such tool and gives her a crooked, twisted smile.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3180g_00400_02170_1: \n\n"This is your final job, my queen.":<TAP>
EID_b02160_3180g_00500_02170_1: \n\nIt is a scene the king has played out time and again.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3180g_00700_02170_1: \nThe woman does not cry. She does not beg. Instead, she looks him right in the eye and begins to giggle.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3190g_00200_02170_1: \n\nIt is the first time she has ever seen him angry—likely because she has never shown him anything but outright deference.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3200g_00100_02170_1: As she continues to giggle, a range of emotions wash over the king's face. Anger turns to rage, before slowly giving way to a hint of doubt.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3200g_00200_02170_1: \nAnd then, for the briefest of moments, fear.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3200g_00300_02170_1: \nThe woman does not let the chance escape.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3200g_00400_02170_1: \n\nShe leaps into the corner of the room and picks up a hidden spear.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3200g_00500_02170_1: \nBefore the king can even draw breath, she plunges it into his chest.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3200g_00600_02170_1: \n\nHer attack is nowhere near powerful enough to fell so large and strong a man as her new husband.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3200g_00700_02170_1: \n\nYet he begins to foam at the mouth before dropping to one knee.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3210g_00100_02170_1: For you see, a powerful poison has been lathered on the spear head.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3210g_00200_02170_1: \n\n"You thought this room yours alone," whispers the woman in his ear. "But it is not.":<TAP>
EID_b02160_3210g_00300_02170_1: \nAs the king writhes and thrashes on the ground, the princess tosses the diary in front of him.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3220g_00100_02170_1: It is the work not of one queen, but all of them.:
EID_b02160_3220g_00200_02170_1: \nEach poor soul who married the king wrote down what she knew before dying—and the previous queen was the one who finally figured out the location of the secret room beneath the bath.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3220g_00300_02170_1: \n\nI don't know if I'll be able to escape. But whoever is reading this, you can be the one to end this. You must.:
EID_b02160_3220g_00400_02170_1: \n\nThat was the final entry in the diary.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3220g_00500_02170_1: \nAnd so, the woman snuck into the hidden room ahead of time, ensuring the sacrifices of the previous queens would not be in vain.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3230g_00100_02170_1: The king relished in tormenting the weak, and his wives were no exception. But he took too much joy in such proceedings, and so made himself vulnerable.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3230g_00200_02170_1: \nWhich is how his latest wife has now come to stand over his pathetic, quivering form.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3230g_00300_02170_1: \n\n"My poor king," she says in a mocking, melodic voice.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3230g_00400_02170_1: \n\n"Does that hurt? Would you like me to hold your hand?":<TAP>
EID_b02160_3230g_00500_02170_1: \nBut she receives no response. At long last, the mad king is dead.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3240g_00100_02170_1: She pulls a string in the corner of the room, causing the floor to slide open, revealing a deep pit.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3240g_00200_02170_1: \n\nUnfathomable amounts of blood have dried and stuck to the walls like the massive artery of a long-dead giant.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3240g_00300_02170_1: \n\nIt is where the king threw the bodies of his wives when he was done with them.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_3250g_00100_02170_1: The princess gazes into the deep, dark hole.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3250g_00200_02170_1: \nBeyond lies a future not written in the diary.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_3250g_00300_02170_1: \n\nBut she produces her rope and carefully vanishes into the pit all the same.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4010g_00100_02170_1: On the night of the fifth full moon, the woman kills her husband and slips free of her palace prison.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4010g_00200_02170_1: \nAll so she might return to the mother who loves and worries for her deeply.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4020g_00100_02170_1: Before she left, she found the sight of her home to be tired and uninteresting.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4020g_00200_02170_1: \n\nBut now the haphazard spires and clustered domes strike her as beauty personified.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4020g_00300_02170_1: \n\nShe is back in the land wreathed by sea and sand. Her birthplace. Her home.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4030g_00100_02170_1: Once she escaped the mad king's grasp, she used what little treasure and rations she had to barter passage through the desert.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4030g_00200_02170_1: \n\nNow having returned, she sets her sights on the royal palace and limps her way through bustling city streets.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4040g_00100_02170_1: She is surrounded by market stalls selling rare spices and exotic fabrics her mother has obtained through trade.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4040g_00200_02170_1: \n\nNone of the lands she passed through on her journey home were so lively—or so bountiful.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4050g_00100_02170_1: When her mother was born, this nation was a poor and barren wasteland.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4050g_00200_02170_1: \n\nBut her mother cultivated it, negotiated with distant countries, and brought great wealth to their shores.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4060g_00100_02170_1: The palace is close now. So close.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4060g_00200_02170_1: \n\nThough she passes many citizens on the street, none realize she is the princess.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4060g_00300_02170_1: \n\nThe scent of blood and decay hangs all around her. Her body is coated in dust.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4060g_00400_02170_1: \nAll who see her turn away in disgust.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4070g_00100_02170_1: She is nothing to them. Some filthy beggar. Some wretch.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4070g_00200_02170_1: \n\nBut she cares not, because she is alive.:
EID_b02160_4070g_00300_02170_1: \nThat truth is all that matters now.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4080g_00100_02170_1: As she walks the palace's unending corridors, retainers and maids look at her with varying expressions.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4080g_00200_02170_1: \n\nSome regard her with curiosity. Some show relief.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4080g_00300_02170_1: \nBut mostly, what she sees is shock.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4090g_00200_02170_1: \nHer hoarse voice sounds for the first time in ages as she bursts into her mother's room and collapses on the floor.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4090g_00300_02170_1: \n\nJust as when they first spoke of marriage, her mother sits at the far end of a long table.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4090g_00400_02170_1: \n\nShe is queen. The room belongs to her, as does the country.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4090g_00500_02170_1: \n\nWhen the princess sees her mother's face, relief floods her heart.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4100g_00100_02170_1: Ignoring the pain of her parched throat, she begins a rapid-fire retelling of how she escaped the mad king.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4100g_00200_02170_1: \n\nOnce she finishes her breathless tale, she gives her mother a smile and waits for her own in return.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4110g_00300_02170_1: \nIt is a wholly unexpected reaction—one which causes the princess to reel.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4120g_00100_02170_1: "Why did you come back?" asks her mother softly.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4120g_00300_02170_1: \n\nShe thought her mother would be delighted to see her.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4120g_00400_02170_1: \nShe thought she would sweep her up in her arms and offer words of gratitude for the daughter who risked all to make her happy.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4120g_00500_02170_1: \n\n"I cannot be happy if you are not happy," says the queen coolly.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4120g_00600_02170_1: \n\n"So I needed you to be happy in your new home. No matter what.":<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4130g_00100_02170_1: As the princess tries desperately to still her reeling mind, she stops and takes in her surroundings.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4130g_00200_02170_1: \n\nUncountable maids and servants flit to and fro through the palace corridors.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4140g_00100_02170_1: They carry precious timber. Rare spices. Great bolts of silk.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4150g_00100_02170_1: Her mother sinks low in her chair and gazes into space for a moment before continuing.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4150g_00200_02170_1: \n\n"Of course the mad king tried to kill you. He kills all his wives. But since you've come back, I suppose there's little use for...":<TAP>
EID_b02160_4150g_00300_02170_1: \nShe trails off and waves a hand in the air. "All of this.":
EID_b02160_4160g_00100_02170_1: She claps at a nearby retainer, who bows and awaits instruction.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4160g_00200_02170_1: \n\n"Cancel my daughter's funeral, and do it now! Do you have any idea how much this is costing me?":
EID_b02160_4160g_00300_02170_1: \n\nThe maids and servants immediately stop setting up the funeral trappings and begin tearing them down instead.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4170g_00200_02170_1: \n\nBefore the princess can ask the question in her mind, the queen tells her everything.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4170g_00300_02170_1: \n\nThe mad king's country, while mostly insignificant, holds great quantities of ore and precious metals.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4170g_00400_02170_1: \n\nIn exchange for a share of those resources, royal families the world over send their daughters there to be sacrifices.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4180g_00100_02170_1: Her mother has known this since the day the princess was born.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4180g_00200_02170_1: \nShe waited years for her daughter to come of age so she could send her off to be slaughtered.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4180g_00300_02170_1: \n\nAll this was done so the country she built with her own own hands might become even more powerful.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4180g_00400_02170_1: \nSo she might obtain the future she envisioned for herself.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4190g_00100_02170_1: But the princess is both clever and pragmatic, and she accepts this new reality far faster than most.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4190g_00200_02170_1: \n\nHer mother has not betrayed her. Oh no.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4190g_00300_02170_1: \nFor one cannot betray a thing they were never loyal to in the first place.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4190g_00400_02170_1: \n\nThe princess slowly closes her eyes. She wavers in place, noting dimly how her body hurts in ways she never imagined it could.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4200g_00100_02170_1: "Yes, well, it seems I'll have to increase security so you don't escape next time," says her mother.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4200g_00200_02170_1: \n\nHaving thus cleansed her daughter's wound with salt, the queen and her attendants scuttle away.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4200g_00300_02170_1: \n\nShe does not even take the time to spare a final glance for her daughter.:<PAGE>
EID_b02160_4210g_00200_02170_1: \n\nThe princess walks alone down an endless stone corridor.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4220g_00100_02170_1: The mad king had constructed a prison.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4220g_00200_02170_1: \nYet when she finally escaped, she found herself trapped in another.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4220g_00300_02170_1: \nIt is a cage she will never be able to flee.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4220g_00400_02170_1: \n\nAll because she was born a princess. All because she is her mother's daughter.:<TAP>
EID_b02160_4220g_00500_02170_1: \n\nAnd having realized this truth, her once-brilliant smile is lost forever to the cruel reality of despair.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1010g_00100_02160_1: "Sorry, boss, but this is as far as we go.":<TAP>
EID_b02170_1010g_00200_02160_1: \n\nA simple camp sits on the desert sands. The band of brigands who encircle the fire look out into the distance, fear writ large on their faces.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1010g_00300_02160_1: \n\nFor their gazes rest on the White Fortress—also known as the Thieves' Graveyard.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1010g_00400_02160_1: \n\nNestled between desert and sea, this great castle awes all who lay eyes upon it. Countless men have snuck inside in search of treasure; countless men have lost their lives.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1020g_00100_02160_1: The brigands at the fire voice their displeasure to their leader, a young thief of meager years.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1020g_00200_02160_1: \nThe power and influence of the band has grown rapidly, and they came to the ends of the desert to make an even greater name for themselves.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1020g_00300_02160_1: \n\nThe young thief yells at his ragged men.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1020g_00400_02160_1: \nHe knows they must be alert at all times if they are to claim the treasures of the White Fortress.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1030g_00100_02160_1: But his fellows are overcome with fear at the sight of the castle, so much so that some take the path of the coward and flee.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1030g_00200_02160_1: \n\nThe older men yell. The younger weep.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1030g_00300_02160_1: \nThe thief sighs as he watches the scene unfold.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1040g_00100_02160_1: A long line of people stand at the entrance to the White Fortress, queued neatly before its impossibly high gates.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1040g_00200_02160_1: \n\nThey are the nouveau riche, come to attend a fine banquet. As they wait, beggars mill about, hoping for the occasional alms or act of charity.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1040g_00300_02160_1: \n\nThe thief weaves his way to the front of the line as though he belongs there.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1050g_00100_02160_1: The guard manning the gates stares at him, shocked.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1050g_00200_02160_1: \n\n"Begging your pardon, sir, but the line begins over—":<TAP>
EID_b02170_1050g_00300_02160_1: \n\n"I do not appreciate being made to wait," interrupts the thief.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1060g_00100_02160_1: His attitude is haughty, his voice filled with unwavering confidence.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1060g_00200_02160_1: \n\nIt is a quality held by only a certain kind of person. It cannot be learned or affected; it is something that must be born into.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1070g_00100_02160_1: The boy is clad in resplendent clothing.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1070g_00200_02160_1: \n\nThe jewels decorating his garments glint beneath the torches of the gate.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1070g_00300_02160_1: \n\nYet though he wears naught but fakes, his attitude tricks the eye into belief.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1080g_00100_02160_1: A moment later, the guard concludes he is different from the nouveau riche, and his gruff expression becomes a cordial smile.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1090g_00100_02160_1: With barely an effort, the thief has entered the White Fortress through its front gate.:<TAP>
EID_b02170_1090g_00200_02160_1: \nHis gorgeous clothing flutters behind him as he walks.:<PAGE>
EID_b02170_1100g_00100_02160_1: The plan is for him to enter alone, then throw treasures out the window so his subordinates can gather them up.:<TAP>

LID_a01050_4030g_00100_01050_1: Her monster is here. He is right here.:
LID_a01050_4030g_00200_01050_1: \nYet the children filled the ruin with garbage and set it ablaze all the same.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4030g_00400_01050_1: \n\nI will not let them get away with this.:
LID_a01050_4030g_00500_01050_1: \n\nA new emotion, dark and heavy, encroaches on her heart.:<PAGE>
LID_a01050_4030g_00600_01050_1: She picks up a piece of kindling and sets fire to the tip, creating a torch.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4030g_00800_01050_1: \nHer steps are unsteady, as though possessed by some entity.:<PAGE>
LID_a01050_4040g_00100_01050_1: She arrives at a beautiful house, a dwelling that resembles the magnificent homes one might see in picturebooks.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4040g_00200_01050_1: \nIt belongs to the leader of the children.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4040g_00400_01050_1: \nHer mind whirls as she stares into the flame.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4040g_00500_01050_1: \n\nThe leader of the children set fire to her ruin. She burned her monster.:<PAGE>
LID_a01050_4050g_00200_01050_1: \nWhich means she can destroy her home.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4050g_00300_01050_1: \nShe can destroy what the other holds most dear.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4050g_00500_01050_1: \n\nWith darkness urging her on, she raises the torch high above her head and thrusts it forward.:<PAGE>

LID_a01050_4070g_00200_01050_1: \n\nThe monster falls face-first onto the ground, his burning body writhing in pain.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4070g_00500_01050_1: "I'm so sorry, Mister Monster! This is my fault! This is all my fault!":<TAP>
LID_a01050_4080g_00200_01050_1: \nShe repeats her apology as she clings to the monster's blazing body.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4080g_00400_01050_1: \nThe blaze enveloping him holds no heat.:<PAGE>

LID_a01050_4090g_00200_01050_1: \n\nSomewhere deep inside, she had known this—yet acknowledging it was a weight too heavy to bear.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4090g_00300_01050_1: \nBecause the kind monster had always been by her side.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4100g_00100_01050_1: The monster's hand trembles and gently brushes her cheek.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4100g_00500_01050_1: \n\nIt is a strange warmth, one that makes her feel the darkness which had overcome her heart is beginning to fade.:<PAGE>
LID_a01050_4100g_00600_01050_1: The monster's body quietly burns in the gloaming.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4100g_00700_01050_1: \nIt twinkles. It shines. Finally, it turns to ash and begins the long ascent into the sky.:<PAGE>
LID_a01050_4120g_00200_01050_1: \nAs the darkness that had encroached on her heart fades away, so too do her memories of the monster.:<TAP>

LID_a01050_4120g_00600_01050_1: \n\nYet she continues to repeat herself. Goodbye. Goodbye.:
LID_a01050_4120g_00700_01050_1: \n\nShe does not fall silent until the final speck of ash has vanished into the heavens.:<PAGE>
LID_a01050_4140g_00100_01050_1: The junk sits in a pile in the ruin.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4140g_00300_01050_1: \n\nShe is sad her secret place was laid to waste like this, but she is a Goat Person. It is to be expected.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4140g_00400_01050_1: \n\nShe repeats this to herself as she begins cleaning up the junk.:<PAGE>

LID_a01050_4150g_00500_01050_1: \nThe rest are blackened ash, yet this one alone remains.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4160g_00100_01050_1: A strange feeling suddenly bubbles up in the girl's heart.:<TAP>
LID_a01050_4160g_00500_01050_1: \nWe'll play together when I see you again. We'll be even better friends.:

LID_a01050_4170g_00200_01050_1: \n\nBut whoever they are, they have given her such warmth.:

LID_a02020_1010g_00100_02020_1: The hush of night falls over the castle.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1010g_00200_02020_1: \nUnsteady footsteps and scraping metal echo through marble corridors.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1010g_00400_02020_1: \nThe guards offer to help their liege as he walks, but he waves them off and leans heavier on his aged metal staff.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1010g_00500_02020_1: \n\n"I'm fine," he insists. A clear lie.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1010g_00600_02020_1: \nMore than anything, the boy simply wishes to be alone.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_1020g_00100_02020_1: The illness which has long eaten away at his body has now begun to prey on his weakened heart.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1020g_00200_02020_1: \nHis vision wavers. He takes an unsteady step, then another, cursing heavy feet that seem unconnected to his legs.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1020g_00300_02020_1: \nEvery time he coughs, the scent of metal fills his head.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1020g_00500_02020_1: \nHe is the first prince of this nation.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1020g_00600_02020_1: \nBut that is not how people know him.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1020g_00700_02020_1: \n\nThe prince, kind to the point of simplicity, has long dreamed of seeing his land at peace. Yet now, even that compassion seems to have vanished from his dimming gray eyes.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_1030g_00100_02020_1: He finally arrives at his room. Lacking the strength to spark a lamp, he collapses in the dark.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1030g_00200_02020_1: \nAs breath leaks from his withered body, he leans against a wall and lets his thoughts spin.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1030g_00300_02020_1: \n\nHe thinks back on his day. On the battle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_1040g_00100_02020_1: As he was responsible for the spark that set off the war, he volunteered to lead on the front lines.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1040g_00200_02020_1: \nWracked with guilt, he sought to bring the conflict to a peaceable conclusion as quickly as possible.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1040g_00300_02020_1: \n\nBut the world does not turn on a child's dreams alone.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1040g_00400_02020_1: \nWar has taught him just how harsh reality can be—and just how soft he is.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1040g_00500_02020_1: \nThough he once yearned for a world at peace, he now understands such things to be the gibbering dream of a madman.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_1050g_00100_02020_1: As he hangs his head in despair, he notices something on the floor.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1050g_00200_02020_1: \n\nIt is a folded piece of paper.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1050g_00300_02020_1: \nSomeone must have slipped it under the door.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1050g_00400_02020_1: \nAfter a brief moment of fear, he reaches out to take it.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1050g_00500_02020_1: \n\nIt contains rows of numbers: dead and injured as a result of the most recent battle.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1050g_00600_02020_1: \nThe moment it registers, tears blur his vision.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_1060g_00100_02020_1: The number is so much larger than usual.:
LID_a02020_1060g_00200_02020_1: \nAll those lives, gone. Vanished like smoke in the wind.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1060g_00300_02020_1: \nHe thought he understood the weight of his sins.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1060g_00400_02020_1: \nYet this new number causes his heart to creak anew.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1060g_00500_02020_1: \n\nThe deaths, the numbers; they had always been something apart from himself. Something vague. But this piece of paper makes them terribly real.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_1070g_00400_02020_1: \n\nIn today's battle, his brother attempted to take the prince's life and put himself next in line for the throne.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1070g_00500_02020_1: \nIn much the same manner, someone wrote this note to amplify his guilt—to point out how his hypocrisy comes at the greatest of costs.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1070g_00600_02020_1: \n\nAnd whoever believes this lurks in the shadows of the very castle he calls home.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_1080g_00100_02020_1: Perhaps wishing for peace is a mistake.\n \nPerhaps his life is a mistake.:
LID_a02020_1080g_00200_02020_1: \nHis naivety led only to tragedy; every action he took and every belief he held dear has all been for naught.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1080g_00300_02020_1: \n\nAs he sits alone in the dark, he hears the sounds of conversation from the corridor, and soon his shoulders begin to shake with quiet, maniacal laughter.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_1090g_00400_02020_1: \n\nAmong them is a knife with a wicked edge.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1090g_00500_02020_1: \n\nHis clouded eyes gaze upon it. His hand hovers above it.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_1100g_00400_02020_1: \n\nPerhaps the world would be better off without them.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_1110g_00400_02020_1: \nFrom some distant place, he ponders his own actions.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_1110g_00800_02020_1: \nIt is a memory that haunts him, and will continue to do so for the rest of his days.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_1110g_00900_02020_1: \nHe sits there throughout the long night, recalling the face of the girl who lost her life amidst the crimson smudges.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_1120g_00300_02020_1: \nBut in his red and muddled blackness, the brilliance of the day feels like pain.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_2020g_00400_02020_1: \nHe spent the entire night on the floor, wrapped in his pain.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2020g_00500_02020_1: \n\nAs though he sought to punish himself.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_2050g_00100_02020_1: The voices rise and fall, agitated. Someone is clearly in trouble.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_2070g_00100_02020_1: A creeping sensation travels down his spine.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2070g_00300_02020_1: \nOh, but it is. He cannot mistake that voice for any other.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2070g_00600_02020_1: \nThere is a joy in her tone, the kind that comes from toying with another.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_2080g_00100_02020_1: His throat and tongue go dry.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2080g_00200_02020_1: \nDespite the coolness of the morning, he begins to sweat.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2080g_00300_02020_1: \n\nIt is a symbol of his inescapable past—a shadow that pushes him further into the dark.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_2110g_00300_02020_1: \nAs her quiet voice comes to a stop, she turns to look at the paper on his desk.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_2160g_00100_02020_1: "I'm not blaming you, you know. So why carry this burden by yourself?:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2160g_00200_02020_1: \nYou would have been better off if you never got involved in the first place.":<TAP>
LID_a02020_2160g_00300_02020_1: \nSweet whispers fill his ears—ones to which the boy has no answer.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2160g_00400_02020_1: \n\nFinally, he turns from her, placing a hand on the windowsill.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_2160g_00700_02020_1: \nHe will extend no hand. He will not permit himself to suffer that pain again.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_2170g_00200_02020_1: \nHe lies on the bed and closes his stiff eyes, as though trying to shut out the world.:<PAGE>
LID_a02020_2180g_00200_02020_1: \nAs the boy who would one day ascend the throne, he vowed to create peace. It was a goal he would never turn from, no matter what.:<TAP>
LID_a02020_2180g_00300_02020_1: \n\nBut now, for the first time in his life, he has turned his back on that dream. For the first time in his life, he has turned his back on another.:<TAP>

LID_a02020_2180g_00500_02020_1: \nThe boy who wished for peace has become the boy whose naive ideals bring about only grave misfortune.:<PAGE>

LID_a02020_3030g_00100_02020_1: "Pretty words, but is he truly on your side?":<TAP>

LID_a02020_3050g_00400_02020_1: \nNot even his own blood, for his brother is clearly after his life.:<TAP>

LID_a02030_1010g_00100_02030_1: Once, there was a pair of beautiful sisters who lived in the woods. They supported one another after the death of their parents, and spent their days in happiness and peace.:<TAP>
LID_a02030_1010g_00200_02030_1: \n\nThe younger lived for the elder, and the elder for the younger.:<PAGE>

LID_a02030_1030g_00200_02030_1: \nThe woman marches through the flames in search of her younger sister. Each step causes her body—which is half-machine—to shudder with pain.:<TAP>
LID_a02030_1030g_00300_02030_1: \n\nThe kingdom wars to make the world its own.:<TAP>
LID_a02030_1030g_00400_02030_1: \n\nWhen they capture citizens from opposing countries, they modify their bodies into mechanized weapons of slaughter they then use to feed their own endless ambitions.:<TAP>

LID_a02030_2160g_00200_02030_1: \n\nThe woman freezes. She pries into the meaning behind her sister's ominous words while the younger girl waits quietly. No fear. No sadness. Simply a moment in time.:<TAP>
