LID_a02040_1120g_00300_02040_1: \n\n"Do you get it? You've been reborn!":<PAGE>
LID_a02040_1130g_00200_02040_1: \nThey are small. Soft. A child's. It almost seems as though natural blood flows through them.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_1130g_00300_02040_1: \nSuch hands could not even grasp a gun—how can they possibly be his?:<TAP>
LID_a02040_1130g_00400_02040_1: \n\n"So? What do you think?" asks the woman with red hair.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_1130g_00500_02040_1: \n\nAs she begins to giggle, the man trapped in the false body of a boy looks back at her in confusion.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2010g_00100_02040_1: Parts fill the boxes: cables, circuit boards, integrated circuits.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2010g_00200_02040_1: \nThe man—no, the boy—does not know their purpose.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2010g_00300_02040_1: \n\nFollowing the woman's instructions, he carries the goods, separates the parts, and polishes that which can be used.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2010g_00400_02040_1: \n\nThe juvenile body lacks muscular tissue, and cannot carry much.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2010g_00500_02040_1: \nIt cannot reach for items in high places, nor physically exert beyond the capabilities of any human child.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2020g_00100_02040_1: The boy does not recall his previous body, exactly.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2020g_00200_02040_1: \nBut he remembers it was not this small, nor this powerless.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2020g_00300_02040_1: \n\nFaint fragments of memory slumber in a far corner of his mind.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2020g_00400_02040_1: \nThe hands on his previous body were large enough to hold a gun of deadly caliber.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2020g_00500_02040_1: \n\nHe does not know if they were used to protect, or to destroy.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2020g_00600_02040_1: \nBut he knows his previous orders were all ones of slaughter.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2030g_00100_02040_1: As such, he finds indescribable discomfort at being placed in the body of one meant to meld seamlessly into human society.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2030g_00200_02040_1: \n\nSuddenly, his hands cease their work. His head snaps up. The woman who had been so engrossed in her work has fallen asleep at her desk.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2030g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe boy drapes a blanket over her shoulders with a practiced hand.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2040g_00100_02040_1: The woman calls herself a researcher, and collects pieces of abandoned machines from the world over.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2040g_00200_02040_1: \nShe has a particular interest in those produced by a kingdom that fell many, many years ago.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2040g_00300_02040_1: \n\nApparently, his new young body was crafted from parts created in that kingdom.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2040g_00400_02040_1: \n\nThe storage incorporated in his chassis is old, but the woman claims it is compatible with wireless communication, and therefore of great value.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2040g_00500_02040_1: \nShe has also found indications it was once used as a kind of backup storage.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2050g_00100_02040_1: She is a master of machinery; It is her life's work to turn discarded parts into incredible robots.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2050g_00200_02040_1: \n\nBut she does not let the boy go, instead keeping him by her side so he might aid in her work.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2050g_00300_02040_1: \nThe humans of the city respect her.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2050g_00400_02040_1: \nAnd because he keeps so close to her, they immediately accept him as well.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2050g_00500_02040_1: \n\nThey even call out to the boy whenever he walks through the city.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2060g_00100_02040_1: "You're with the researcher, right? There's a good lad.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2060g_00200_02040_1: \n"If you ever need help with anything, just let me know.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2060g_00300_02040_1: \n"You and me should go play sometime!":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2060g_00400_02040_1: \n\nWhenever they do this—treating him like a human child—the boy is forced to quietly calculate an appropriate response.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2060g_00500_02040_1: \n\nHis life now is one of peace and ease.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2060g_00600_02040_1: \nAnd each time such pleasant sensations come to him, the voice fragment replays in his mind.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2070g_00100_02040_1: Once this world finds peace, I want you to search for the reason you live.:
LID_a02040_2070g_00200_02040_1: \n\nMost of the data in his memory has been destroyed.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2070g_00300_02040_1: \nHe does not know from whence he came, nor where he is headed.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2070g_00400_02040_1: \n\nWhy would someone ask a thing like him—a machine—to search for the reason he lives?:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2080g_00100_02040_1: As he ponders this, the young baker's son notices him and tilts his head curiously.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2080g_00300_02040_1: \n\n"I am searching for an answer. Please inform me the reason why I live.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2090g_00100_02040_1: "But I think we live so we can do fun stuff!":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2090g_00300_02040_1: \n"Yeah! I have lots of fun playing with friends from school, so that's probably why I'm alive.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2090g_00400_02040_1: \n\nThe boy now has one more piece of data to analyze.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2090g_00500_02040_1: \nAfter that, wherever he goes, he poses the same question to any townsperson or robot capable of communication.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2100g_00100_02040_1: "The reason I'm alive is to work hard, get tons of money, and look reeeal good.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2100g_00200_02040_1: \n\nTaking the florist's words to heart, the boy attempts to find meaning in her purpose.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2100g_00300_02040_1: \nHe paints his face in various colors, decorates his hair, and bedecks himself in finery.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2100g_00400_02040_1: \n\nBut he does not understand what purpose these actions serve.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2110g_00100_02040_1: "I EXIST TO KEEP EVERY CORNER OF THE CITY NICE AND CLEAN.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2110g_00200_02040_1: \n\nThe words of the city's cleaning robot are easier to understand than those of the florist.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2110g_00300_02040_1: \n\nIts is a simple existence: It sweeps dust from crevices in flagstone and places rubbish in the basket on its back.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2120g_00100_02040_1: The boy follows the cleaning robot and tries to aid in these tasks.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2120g_00200_02040_1: \nThough it is repetitive, endless work, it poses little trouble for the boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2120g_00300_02040_1: \nBut while he finds a sense of pleasure in keeping the city clean, he does not know if it is a reason to live.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2120g_00400_02040_1: \n\nAs the cleaning robot was created for that sole purpose, it makes sense the task would be its reason for existence.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2120g_00500_02040_1: \nBut the boy feels it is not quite right for him.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2120g_00600_02040_1: \n\nWhat is a reason for living, anyway? Can one find it simply by being ordered to be a certain way?:
LID_a02040_2130g_00100_02040_1: As the boy helps the researcher with her work, he asks more townsfolk his question and attempts to emulate their purpose.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2130g_00200_02040_1: \n\n"You've been tackling complicated stuff lately, huh?" she asks him one day. "Asking why people live and all that?":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2130g_00300_02040_1: \n\nA curious smile crosses the researcher's face.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2130g_00400_02040_1: \nIn response, he poses the question to her.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2140g_00100_02040_1: "Me? Oh, that's easy. I make people's lives better and more peaceful by building robots.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_2140g_00200_02040_1: \n\nWhen people speak of their purpose, their eyes shine.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2140g_00300_02040_1: \nEven the robots speak with a hint of pride and duty.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_2150g_00100_02040_1: But for some reason, the boy cannot find the same emotions in himself.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_2150g_00200_02040_1: \n\nNone of the answers given to him quite line up with the reason the boy lives.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3010g_00100_02040_1: Easy days pass amidst the peace.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3010g_00200_02040_1: \nThough the boy continues to assist the researcher, he remains unable to find the reason he lives.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3010g_00300_02040_1: \n\nBut simply living among the people gives him ample opportunity to see them smile.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3010g_00400_02040_1: \nHe assumes it to be a vastly different experience from when he was a tool of slaughter.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3020g_00100_02040_1: Machines were made to serve people.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3020g_00200_02040_1: \nLike the other robots, he knows that fulfilling his prescribed task will count as a reason for living.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3020g_00300_02040_1: \n\nBut that does not sit well with him. His thoughts—his circuits—reject the notion.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3030g_00100_02040_1: And then, a fateful day arrives.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3030g_00200_02040_1: \nThe woman, who always wore comfortable clothes while engaged in research, appears before the boy in a beautiful dress, her hair tied neatly back.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3030g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe pale green of the dress reminds him of the first buds of spring.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3030g_00400_02040_1: \n\n"I'll be wearing this to the commendation ceremony," she informs him. "So am I looking good or what?":<TAP>
LID_a02040_3030g_00500_02040_1: \nThe boy can only tilt his head in response.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3040g_00100_02040_1: "The king is presenting me with a medal," the woman says shyly.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3040g_00200_02040_1: \nThere is a faint blush on her cheeks, as well as a brilliant shine in her eyes.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3040g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe robots she created had improved the lives of many, and the king wished to reward her contribution to the peace.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3040g_00400_02040_1: \n\n"You know, this medal belongs to you as much as me.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_3040g_00500_02040_1: \n"I do not understand. I only worked in accordance to your orders.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_3040g_00600_02040_1: \n"Yeah, but you were such a HUGE help! And in fact...":<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3050g_00100_02040_1: With that, she begins to tell him a story.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3050g_00200_02040_1: \nShe spins the tale of what inspired her to start building robots.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3050g_00300_02040_1: \n\nIn her hands, she holds an old picture book.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3050g_00400_02040_1: \nIt tells the story of a prince who traveled the land preaching peace, accompanied by a clockwork attendant.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3050g_00500_02040_1: \n\nThe story left a strong impression on her when she read it as a young child.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3060g_00100_02040_1: That fabled kingdom of yore had become embroiled in the fires of war.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3060g_00200_02040_1: \nIn that tragic time where many people lost their lives, machines were used not to support, but to kill.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3060g_00300_02040_1: \n\nBut amidst the war and strife, one person stood up for others.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3060g_00400_02040_1: \nHe was the eldest prince of the selfsame kingdom that started the wars, and he had a singular companion: a clockwork man slated for disposal.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3060g_00500_02040_1: \nTogether, this pair avoided the kingdom's pursuers, traveling the land while they advocated for peace.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3070g_00100_02040_1: But the prince was born sickly, and did not live to see the world he strove so hard to create.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3070g_00200_02040_1: \nYet people had been so moved by his ideals that they became the foundation for peace in the current times.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3070g_00300_02040_1: \n\n"So that's basically it," the woman concludes. "I just wanted to be like the prince who was good with machines—I never really understood the significance of what he accomplished.":<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3080g_00100_02040_1: The robots she now creates to help people are built from parts salvaged from old clockwork soldiers.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3080g_00200_02040_1: \nAt the thought of all the people she's helped, a smile crosses her face.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3080g_00400_02040_1: \n\nAt its appearance, a thought occurs to the boy: He has seen this smile before.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3090g_00100_02040_1: His memories should have broken down long ago.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3090g_00200_02040_1: \nYet those fragments now begin to bind together in a way he can only think of as significant.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3090g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe kingdom. Wars. Clockwork soldiers. A prince.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_3100g_00200_02040_1: \nThough muddled by static, he beholds the face of a boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3100g_00300_02040_1: \nA boy around the same age as his current body.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3100g_00400_02040_1: \n\nThe boy is looking directly at him.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3100g_00500_02040_1: \nThough his eyes are gentle, there is an unyielding light shining behind them.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3100g_00700_02040_1: \nWhen he next speaks, he says the same words which first came from the darkness::<TAP>
LID_a02040_3100g_00800_02040_1: \n\nOnce this world finds peace, I want you to search for the reason you live.:
LID_a02040_3110g_00100_02040_1: As the voice fades, countless memories flicker through his mind.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3110g_00200_02040_1: \n\nBlending with the crowds of a city. Hiding in a shop near a battlefield. Walking a road in the rain. An empty forest. A shattered church.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3110g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe images twinkle like stars in the darkness of his memory. Images of days spent protecting him.:
LID_a02040_3110g_00400_02040_1: \n\nThough worn and riddled with static, they remain surprisingly fresh in his mind.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_3110g_00500_02040_1: \n\nAnd to the very end, they hold a powerful grip on his heart.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4010g_00200_02040_1: \nThe memories that endure within the boy are missing much, but now he finally recalls what is most important to him.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4010g_00300_02040_1: \n\nHe remembers who beseeched him to find the reason he lives.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4010g_00600_02040_1: \nIt is the day after she received the medal from the king.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4020g_00100_02040_1: Unable to hide her curiosity, she asks him question after question.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4020g_00200_02040_1: \nBut he is prepared with ready explanations to them all.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4020g_00300_02040_1: \n\nFinally, she sets her kind eyes on him. "Safe travels," she says.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4030g_00100_02040_1: Perhaps she has known all along. Perhaps she has known about the memories that drift in his storage.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4030g_00200_02040_1: \nThis would explain why she kept him by her side all this time.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4030g_00300_02040_1: \n\nInstead of saying anything in return, the boy simply nods.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4030g_00500_02040_1: \nThanks for awakening him—and for allowing him to remember what matters.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4040g_00100_02040_1: As he leaves the city, people turn to him with smiles.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4040g_00400_02040_1: \n"GREETINGS. I ENGAGE IN ANOTHER DAY OF KEEPING THE CITY CLEAN.":<TAP>
LID_a02040_4040g_00600_02040_1: \nAnyone can find the happiness they desire in this place.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4050g_00100_02040_1: But the boy does not think twice.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4050g_00200_02040_1: \nHe now knows from whence he came. He now knows to where he goes.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4050g_00400_02040_1: \n\nHe will retrace the steps of his broken memory.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4060g_00100_02040_1: The world beyond the city is vastly different than the one he once knew.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4060g_00200_02040_1: \nYet he follows the trail of his recollections, letting long-forgotten names and vague echoes of the past guide him.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4060g_00300_02040_1: \n\nHe walks as though following another boy's footsteps.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4070g_00100_02040_1: He passes through lively towns and wide fields. Past cheery groves and silent lakes. Eventually, the boy finds himself in a deep, dark wood.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4070g_00200_02040_1: \n\nThere is nothing particularly special about these woods.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4070g_00300_02040_1: \nBut the boy is certain it is the place.:
LID_a02040_4070g_00400_02040_1: \n\nAs he ventures deeper into the forest, he finds a ramshackle church long fallen into disrepair.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4070g_00500_02040_1: \n\nThe moment he sees it, a thin voice rises from his sandworn memories.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4080g_00200_02040_1: \n\nI want you to search for the reason you live.:
LID_a02040_4080g_00300_02040_1: \nThe soldier did not understand why the prince told him so at the time.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4090g_00100_02040_1: The prince had likely been worried what would become of the soldier after he passed.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4090g_00200_02040_1: \nHe often spoke of the future between troubled, delicate breaths.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4090g_00300_02040_1: \n\nPerhaps he hoped to offer his guardian the faintest guidance for the time after he passed from the world.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4100g_00100_02040_1: Once the robot boy—the man—passes through the church, he arrives at the spot he has been searching for.:
LID_a02040_4100g_00200_02040_1: \n\nThe ground is slightly raised. Sticking from it is a metallic staff eaten away by rust.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4110g_00100_02040_1: From beneath the earth, he senses a faint signal.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4110g_00200_02040_1: \nIf his memory can be trusted, this is where the prince and his clockwork attendant are buried.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4110g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe clockwork soldier's original body had been laid to rest at this grave uncountable years ago.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4110g_00400_02040_1: \nWhat the man now carries is his backup memory.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4110g_00500_02040_1: \n\nThough his adolescent form is weak, it can still exist in a peaceful world.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4110g_00600_02040_1: \nFor he is no longer a tool of slaughter, but a being that exists to help others.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4120g_00100_02040_1: Yet he still cannot find a reason to live in that life.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4120g_00200_02040_1: \nThat reason exists in only one place: here.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4120g_00300_02040_1: \n\nThe man aligns his signal with the body slumbering beneath the earth.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4120g_00400_02040_1: \nHe then begins transferring his memories to his original self.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4120g_00500_02040_1: \n\nStrength leaves his body. Light flickers and fades.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4120g_00600_02040_1: \nHis boyish form crumples to the earth.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4130g_00100_02040_1: At long last, the clockwork man awakens.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4130g_00300_02040_1: \n\nHis sight has long since broken down.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4130g_00400_02040_1: \nThough he would not be able to see anything from his position beneath the earth regardless.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4130g_00500_02040_1: \nHis hearing is dim. His body still.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4130g_00600_02040_1: \n\nHe feels a terrible heat emanating from deep within his form—likely due to broken machinery being forced to life once more.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4130g_00700_02040_1: \n\nBut here, in this dark and quiet place, he is buried with his master.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4130g_00800_02040_1: \nThe one person the man willingly chose to serve—and the one he sought to protect.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4140g_00100_02040_1: The reason for living he had been so desperately searching for.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4140g_00200_02040_1: \nAll he ever wanted was to stay by the prince's side.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4140g_00300_02040_1: \nEven if the prince himself no longer lived.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4140g_00500_02040_1: \nImages and sounds crumble like castles of sand.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4140g_00600_02040_1: \n\nYet the man recalls all the humans and robots who spoke of their purposes in life.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4150g_00100_02040_1: The shining eyes of the humans. Their happy smiles.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4150g_00200_02040_1: \nThe inorganic voices of the robots. Their sense of pride and duty.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4150g_00300_02040_1: \n\nOnly now, in this place, does the man understand.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4150g_00400_02040_1: \nHe knows how they felt and what they think, for he feels and thinks the same.:<PAGE>
LID_a02040_4160g_00100_02040_1: A sense of relief eases into his heart.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4160g_00200_02040_1: \nEven though clockwork men are not meant to have such things.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4160g_00400_02040_1: \nHe lays quiet and still beside the one for whom he risked his everything.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4160g_00500_02040_1: \nWith spring emerging far above him, he slips into a deep and dreamless slumber.:<TAP>
LID_a02040_4160g_00600_02040_1: \n\nOne from which he will never wake.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1010g_00100_02050_1: A dry wind blows across the pallid, twilit sky.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1010g_00200_02050_1: \nAt a quiet teahouse away from the thoroughfare sits a lone woman clad in an elegant kimono, eating dango.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1010g_00300_02050_1: \n\nHer movements are graceful, and the air around her smells sweetly of flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1010g_00400_02050_1: \nThe way she licks her lips would lead anyone to believe that the unassuming mugwort dango are made of the most sensual nectar.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1020g_00100_02050_1: In truth, the woman is a skilled assassin working in the name of a great lord.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1020g_00200_02050_1: \n\nShe has felled countless wretched villains who hoped to take her lord's life—insignificant characters her lord loathed.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1020g_00300_02050_1: \nThe number of lives she has severed from this world would dwarf the population of the average town.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1030g_00100_02050_1: To her, human lives are little more than a commodity. To her, the notion that life is precious and irreplaceable is pure fantasy.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1030g_00200_02050_1: \nThe act of taking lives is hardly different from pulling weeds.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1030g_00300_02050_1: \nAnd today, she is tasked with such gardening duties.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1030g_00400_02050_1: \n\nHer targets: a pair of sisters who have recently moved to the town's outskirts.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1040g_00100_02050_1: She asks the long-time owner of the teahouse what sort of people these sisters might be.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1040g_00300_02050_1: \nEvery now and then, he says casually.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1050g_00100_02050_1: The two seem to come to drink tea a few times a month.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1050g_00200_02050_1: \nThey always walk together, just the two of them, to avoid the watchful eyes of others, and they never attempt to deepen relationships with anyone else.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1050g_00300_02050_1: \n\nIt's not that they conduct themselves poorly—they do nothing to cause trouble, so the townsfolk have no reason to shut them out.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1060g_00100_02050_1: Everybody knows them, but nobody knows them well. They're like the midday haze—there, but only barely.:
LID_a02050_1060g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThe teahouse owner's voice has a jesting tone, but the woman senses no malice behind it.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1060g_00400_02050_1: \nThough their actions don't stand out, their appearance is almost otherworldly.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1060g_00500_02050_1: \n\nThe elder sister acts with such grace that even when sipping the cheapest barley tea, she would hardly look out of place in a masterwork portrait.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1070g_00100_02050_1: She reminds me of you, come to think of it, he says.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1070g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThe woman sighs, glazing over the compliment.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1070g_00400_02050_1: \n\nShe is not humbling herself—that is her genuine opinion. But the teahouse owner insists she's alike, to the point that she stands out in town.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1080g_00100_02050_1: He goes on to note that the younger sister has an otherworldly nobility about her as well.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1080g_00200_02050_1: \nIt is in the way she drinks tea, eats dango, stands, walks.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1080g_00300_02050_1: \n\nHe likens her to an angel given mortal form for the very first time.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1080g_00400_02050_1: \nHis choice of words does not suit the owner of a run-down teahouse.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1090g_00100_02050_1: Though the sisters do not cause problems, it seems their actions can turn the lowliest commoners into poets.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1090g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThat positive influence on others turns the woman's heart cold and dark.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1090g_00300_02050_1: \n\nShe already knows the truth behind the sisters.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1100g_00100_02050_1: The elder "sister" was once a woman who walked the path of slaughter, just like her.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1100g_00200_02050_1: \nShe was born a daughter of the woman's lord and made her living off murder.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1100g_00300_02050_1: \nOver countless jobs, she mercilessly slew her lord's political enemies.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1100g_00400_02050_1: \n\nThe woman was her student and learned the art of killing directly from her. Indeed, it was as though she was an older sister.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1110g_00100_02050_1: The younger "sister" was a girl who was fated to die at the hands of the assassin elder sister.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1110g_00200_02050_1: \n\nIt's said she was raised as a boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1110g_00300_02050_1: \nAll so that the family she was born into would survive.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1110g_00400_02050_1: \n\nShe was brought into this world against her will, given a life against her wishes.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1110g_00500_02050_1: \nHer sole purpose was to fulfill her duty. She was little more than a puppet.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1120g_00100_02050_1: A duty in and of itself, the woman thinks.:
LID_a02050_1120g_00200_02050_1: \n\nLearning of this, the elder chose not to kill the younger. Instead, she took her away and the two ran.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1120g_00300_02050_1: \nThat was said to have happened during torrential rainfall strong enough to wash away all the blood.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1120g_00400_02050_1: She must be punished, the woman thinks.:
LID_a02050_1120g_00500_02050_1: \nShe considers both the girl and the woman who saved her.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1120g_00600_02050_1: \nThey had both thrown away the reasons they were given to live.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1120g_00700_02050_1: \n\nShe despises that they chose freedom at the cost of their duties.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_1130g_00100_02050_1: I thought you were living an unsightly life, dear sister.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1130g_00200_02050_1: \n\nSuch is the duty the woman was given—she lives for her duties and rules.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1130g_00300_02050_1: \nShe is to perform the last rites for the woman who was once like her sister.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_1130g_00400_02050_1: \n\nShe finishes her dango and stands decisively. As she stares into space, words spill from her lips.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2010g_00100_02050_1: There was once a woman who was born to a family that lived off murder.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2010g_00200_02050_1: \nShe wielded a blade for her family. She walked the path of slaughter for her family.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2010g_00300_02050_1: \n\nThere was once a girl born to a family that wished for a boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2010g_00400_02050_1: \nAnd so she was raised as a boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2010g_00500_02050_1: \n\nBoth lived only to fulfill their duties like puppets. But fate brought together the slaughterer and slaughtered.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2020g_00100_02050_1: They joined hands, cast away their duties, and chose to live freely.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2020g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThat night coincided with torrential rain that washed away blood and tears both.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2040g_00100_02050_1: The late autumn twilight was as quiet as the underworld.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2040g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThough she appreciates the stillness, the lack of life only serves to amplify her unease.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2040g_00300_02050_1: \nShe is the former assassin who once lived to kill but turned her back on her orders.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2040g_00400_02050_1: \n\nThe crimson tranquility is the same as that which heralds the coming of battle.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2050g_00100_02050_1: The house sits far from town at the edge of the forest.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2050g_00200_02050_1: \nHer life with the girl is a solitary one, but peaceful.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2050g_00300_02050_1: \nShe is more than content with her life.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2050g_00400_02050_1: \n\nCertainly, there's room for improvement—she is clearly inferior to the girl in many aspects, including cooking and looks.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2050g_00500_02050_1: \n\nThough she occasionally works as a bodyguard or mercenary, she seldom strays far from what society considers acceptable.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2050g_00600_02050_1: \nHer life is that of an ordinary human, one that does not shed much blood.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2060g_00200_02050_1: \nNever did she think such a life was attainable.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2060g_00300_02050_1: \n\nAnd yet, she finds herself living an honest life.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2060g_00400_02050_1: \nSometimes, she wonders if this life is but foam on the waves, a fleeting dream.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2060g_00500_02050_1: \n\nShe ponders this whenever she watches the girl sleep so soundly.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2070g_00100_02050_1: And so she has grown especially sensitive to the air of impending danger.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2070g_00200_02050_1: \n\nAn unease lingers deep in her chest throughout the day. The sun hides away, and the early evening stars begin to twinkle in the sky.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2070g_00400_02050_1: But no—she is more than familiar.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2070g_00500_02050_1: \n\nShe is a fellow assassin, a killer who had once taught the techniques she had mastered over a lifetime.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2080g_00100_02050_1: It's been quite some time, dear sister.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2080g_00200_02050_1: \n\nShe speaks in a calm, low voice nothing like how the other woman remembered.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2080g_00400_02050_1: \n\nThe woman replies in an unaffected manner.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2080g_00500_02050_1: \nHow long has it been since she'd been referred to as "dear sister"?:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2090g_00100_02050_1: It brings back memories from long ago.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2090g_00200_02050_1: \nHer former student had once laughed with joy, cried often, and even hesitated to kill bugs.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2090g_00300_02050_1: \nAnd yet, the woman taught her to strike a person's weak point in a single breath.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2090g_00400_02050_1: \n\nShe doesn't recall giving her special treatment, but she does recall that she grew to be a superb assassin.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2090g_00500_02050_1: \nThe woman knows immediately that she has not simply dropped by to say hello while passing through—she is here to kill her.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2100g_00100_02050_1: The assassin speaks with delight for reasons unknown.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2100g_00200_02050_1: \n\nKill the girl now and your betrayal will be forgiven.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2100g_00300_02050_1: \n\nIt is a message from the lord the woman once served.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2100g_00400_02050_1: \nThe suggestion is as abrupt as it is merciless.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2110g_00100_02050_1: The assassin stares, running her tongue over lips, as the woman's brow knits and faint panic washes over her face.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2110g_00200_02050_1: \n\nYou would not have hesitated back when I knew you.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2110g_00300_02050_1: \n\nThe woman looks to the exhilarated assassin.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2110g_00500_02050_1: \n\nShe gives her response and returns to the house.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2110g_00600_02050_1: \nShe then takes the hand of the girl who had awoken at some point and rushes out of the house.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2120g_00100_02050_1: The assassin simply watches as the pair runs.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2120g_00300_02050_1: \nIn the following moments, countless silhouettes swarm around the fleeing duo.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2120g_00400_02050_1: The lord's assassins had laid in wait around the woman's house.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2120g_00500_02050_1: \n\nKill them, the assassin orders with cold indifference. The silhouettes leap at the woman.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2130g_00100_02050_1: From a pocket emerges a knife, and from a mouth a single breath.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2130g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThe woman's blade shines in the moonlight, soaring through the night sky like a firefly.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2130g_00300_02050_1: \n\nShe fights valiantly to protect the girl, but it is hardly the manner of one who takes lives without mercy or thought.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2130g_00500_02050_1: \n\nShe is graceful yet brutal, her eyes kind but intense.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2140g_00100_02050_1: Beholding her elegance and integrity, all emotion vanishes from the assassin's face.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2140g_00200_02050_1: \n\nPathetic. You truly have changed, dear sister.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2140g_00400_02050_1: \nIn stark contrast to the woman who fights to protect, the assassin brandishes her blade, her eyes filled with twisted glee.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2150g_00100_02050_1: Shall I remind you of the sweet taste of blood? The bitter taste of steel?:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2150g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThe assassin dashes forth with ferocious vigor.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2150g_00300_02050_1: \nThe woman greets the assassin's blade with her own. She parries her back as she cuts down the other assailants.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2150g_00400_02050_1: \n\nHer former colleague breaks the silence with muted cries.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2150g_00500_02050_1: \nOne falls, and then another. The woman and the girl reel as the hot blood of the nameless killers splatters over them.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2150g_00600_02050_1: \nThe girl does not make a sound—it is as though she was prepared for this.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2160g_00100_02050_1: The assassin brings down her blade once more.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2160g_00200_02050_1: \nThe woman roots herself to the ground and focuses.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2160g_00300_02050_1: \nShe concentrates her intent on the here and now.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2160g_00400_02050_1: \n\nBut as she fights to protect the girl, her body...:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2160g_00600_02050_1: \n\nRecalls the sensation of fighting another skilled combatant to the death. Her body trembles with excitement.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2170g_00100_02050_1: She derives no enjoyment from this act.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2170g_00300_02050_1: \n\nBut in her former life when killing was her duty, she lived by the rule of kill-or-be-killed.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2170g_00400_02050_1: She lived with a cold heart fit only for murder. This shameful instinct is once again being rekindled in her, forcefully.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2170g_00500_02050_1: \n\nPerhaps it is penance for never denying that part of her.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2170g_00600_02050_1: \nThe woman and the assassin exchange clashes of metal in their dance of blades.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2180g_00100_02050_1: A hand grasps the back of the woman's neck, pulling her away from the assassin's blade.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2180g_00200_02050_1: \nIt is as though a guardian angel intervened.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2180g_00400_02050_1: \n\nAnd just as her elder sister once taught her, the assassin slashes at the girl's artery in a single elegant motion.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2180g_00500_02050_1: Thus does the girl whom the woman fought so hard to protect find her life cut short.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_2190g_00300_02050_1: \nShe simply looks to the heavens like a newborn child.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2190g_00400_02050_1: \nIt's exactly the same way she did when they cooked together.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_2190g_00500_02050_1: \n\nWith a kind smile to the woman, she departs this world.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3010g_00100_02050_1: They ran through the rain together, abandoning a duty-bound life.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3010g_00200_02050_1: \n\nTheir life of freedom was a lonely one, but peaceful. An honest living was far from easy, but brought with it its own joys.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3010g_00300_02050_1: \n\nHow easily such a delicate lifestyle crumbles.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3020g_00100_02050_1: Though the woman had cleaned her hands of a life of killing and instead filled them with normalcy, she now watches as the girl's fleeting life fades before her.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3020g_00200_02050_1: \n\nBlood spurts from the girl's neck, covering her face and limbs in bright, vivid red.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3020g_00300_02050_1: \n\nLike wild mountain camellia blooming, buds broken with a fallen splendor.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3020g_00400_02050_1: \nAnd yet, she wears a clear, carefree smile upon her face.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3030g_00100_02050_1: As the woman recalls that sight, the area around her has become a sea of blood.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3030g_00200_02050_1: \n\nThe moment she sees the girl's smile—the face she wears in death—the woman loses the last remnants of her rationality.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3030g_00300_02050_1: \nNow, there stands a killer who once existed between the boundaries of life and death.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3030g_00400_02050_1: \nThe exceptional assassin that the ambitious killer so treasured.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3030g_00500_02050_1: \n\nIn her frenzy and despair, the woman's heart arrives at an understanding, and she finds acceptance.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3040g_00100_02050_1: She was born to kill. She was raised to kill.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3040g_00200_02050_1: \n\nShe killed to steal away the ordinary. She killed to overthrow the ordinary.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3040g_00400_02050_1: \nA wicked woman who never walked the path of the righteous.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3040g_00500_02050_1: \nHow could she ever lead an upstanding, normal life?:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3040g_00600_02050_1: \nThe impartial heavens would have never allowed her such convenience.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3050g_00100_02050_1: She gazes down at the assassins she killed with her own two hands, and then turns her eyes to the still body of the girl.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3050g_00200_02050_1: \nShe slowly drops her head and twists in remorse.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3050g_00300_02050_1: \n\nBack when she met the girl, the girl had called herself a puppet.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3050g_00400_02050_1: \nThe woman saw herself in the girl and absconded with her.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3050g_00500_02050_1: \nShe had so frivolously assumed that they would somehow manage so long as they could escape. She would figure things out afterward.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3060g_00100_02050_1: So long as the girl was happy, she would manage.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3060g_00200_02050_1: \nSo long as the girl lived an unassuming life in the ordinary world, became an ordinary adult, dreamed ordinary dreams.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3060g_00300_02050_1: \n\nThe woman thought she had worked hard enough to make that wish come true.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3060g_00400_02050_1: \n\nIt was she who had dreamed of a peaceful life.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3060g_00500_02050_1: \n\nAnd ultimately, it was she who stole the girl's future away from her.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3060g_00600_02050_1: \nIt was because the girl was with her that she ended up dead.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3070g_00100_02050_1: Sinking to the depths of self-reproach, she digs her teeth into her lip.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3070g_00200_02050_1: \nBlood oozes out and spills down her chin.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3070g_00300_02050_1: \nShe resembles a ghoul tearing into human flesh.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3070g_00400_02050_1: \n\nIt is not the sadness of loss that is strongest in the woman's heart, but intense resentment and anger.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3070g_00500_02050_1: \n\nHer face twists like it never did when she was an elite assassin.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3080g_00100_02050_1: Perhaps there is nothing concealing her wicked devilishness now.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3080g_00200_02050_1: \nOr perhaps it is simply the face of a demon who has become a living revenant.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3080g_00300_02050_1: \n\nShe had found tranquility in search of a happiness that never suited her, and now it was gone.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3080g_00400_02050_1: \n\nHer white breath rose against the cold, late autumn sky like a miasma that cursed all living things.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3090g_00100_02050_1: The assassin survives, clinging to a delighted consciousness with that excess power.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3090g_00200_02050_1: \n\nDark red blood spills from her lips, and despite the bitterly metallic taste spreading through her mouth, she smiles.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3090g_00300_02050_1: \n\nShe gazes at the peerless demon woman that is her sister.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3090g_00400_02050_1: \nShe always yearned to be like her, but she always stood beyond a threshold just outside of her reach.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3100g_00100_02050_1: Yes, yes, that's it. This is who you truly— Before she can finish, a cold white blade descends on her head.:
LID_a02050_3100g_00200_02050_1: \nIt happens in an instant. With precision. Without mercy.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3100g_00300_02050_1: \nIt is infinitely easier than preparing mackerel.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3100g_00400_02050_1: \n\nThe assassin's skull, her spirit's domicile, is cut cleanly in two.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3100g_00500_02050_1: Not once, even when they spent time together, did the woman ever pull her punches.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3100g_00600_02050_1: \n\nNot once did she ever find someone she wanted to go easy on.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3110g_00200_02050_1: \n\nHer empty emotions spill from her mouth, and slowly she begins to walk.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3110g_00300_02050_1: \n\nIn her arms, she holds the smiling corpse of the girl.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3110g_00400_02050_1: \nShe ventures into the mountains by the light of the moon. She buries the girl in a thicket no one will ever find, and clasps her hands together.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_3120g_00200_02050_1: \n\nI'm sorry I ever tried to make a life with you.:
LID_a02050_3120g_00300_02050_1: \n\nThe last thing she says is a croaked apology.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_3120g_00400_02050_1: \nAnd so, she begins to walk again, alone, and vanishes.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4010g_00100_02050_1: Several nights pass since the former assassin lost the girl she sought to protect.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4010g_00200_02050_1: \nNow, the woman stages a lone assault on a castle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4020g_00200_02050_1: \nHer faith. Her dignity. Her future. Her past.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4020g_00300_02050_1: \nShe exists now as an unparalleled demon of the blade.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4020g_00400_02050_1: \n\nShe is clad in black in her mourning, and she stains it with the blood of others.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4030g_00100_02050_1: The samurai stationed in the castle were skilled masters adept in the art of battle.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4030g_00200_02050_1: \nYet she cuts them all down with ease.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4030g_00300_02050_1: \n\nThey swarm her like moths to a flame, only to be engulfed in her fury. The satisfying rhythm of death resembles a carefully choreographed dance.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4040g_00100_02050_1: Everyone in the castle is an object of her vengeance.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4040g_00200_02050_1: \nShe shows mercy to no one, be it head servant or the lowliest maid.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4040g_00300_02050_1: \n\nWhether they scream and beg forgiveness, turn tail and run, it matters not—her expression remains blank, and she cuts them all down.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4050g_00100_02050_1: She will kill every living thing in this castle.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4050g_00200_02050_1: \nShe will sever all fates leading to this castle.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4060g_00100_02050_1: She has already cut down all of her previous lord's closest confidants.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4060g_00200_02050_1: \nShe does not let a single member of her clan live.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4060g_00300_02050_1: \nThat leaves only her master, the great lord himself.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4060g_00400_02050_1: At last, she arrives at the castle keep where the lord took refuge. Assassins and the lord's personal retainers attempt to stop her, to which she simply spits, "Bothersome flies.":<TAP>
LID_a02050_4060g_00600_02050_1: \n\nValiant though they may have been, they were no match for the woman now.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4070g_00100_02050_1: She steps forward across the tatami and throws open the door.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4070g_00200_02050_1: \nThere she finds her former master, cowering and terrified.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4070g_00300_02050_1: \n\nThe man who toyed with her fate, the one she hates more than any.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4070g_00400_02050_1: \n\nA cruel man without a shred of decency, willing to sacrifice his entire family if it meant more power...now curled into a trembling ball as the looming demon stands over him.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4070g_00500_02050_1: \n\nNo matter how pathetic he looks, she will never forgive him for robbing the girl of her life.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4080g_00100_02050_1: For the first time in her life, the woman lends herself wholly to her wrath.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4080g_00200_02050_1: \n\nYou can apologize from the depths of hell.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4080g_00300_02050_1: \n\nShe brings down her weapon with all her might, all her hatred.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4080g_00500_02050_1: \n\nThe cold steel of her blade sinks into the lord's heart like a beast's fang.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4080g_00600_02050_1: \nAnd thus the lord's sinful life comes to an end. He makes no sound, leaves nothing behind.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4090g_00100_02050_1: And yet the woman's rage does not abate.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4090g_00200_02050_1: \nNot once does she flee from those seeking vengeance for the slain lord. She slashes, skewers, dismembers, beheads, crushes, and mangles every last one of them.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4090g_00400_02050_1: \n\nThis hellscape of viscera and blood brought on by the girl's death brings the woman nothing but pain. It is as though she is an infinite font of hatred in a cruel and uncaring world.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4100g_00100_02050_1: It is then that she understands.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4100g_00200_02050_1: \n\nShe is looking for a place to die.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4100g_00400_02050_1: \nShe could destroy the entire world and still her hatred would live on.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4100g_00500_02050_1: \nShe hates her pathetic self for being unable to protect the girl she held so dear.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4100g_00600_02050_1: \n\nShe hates herself more than anyone else, anything else.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4100g_00700_02050_1: \n\nOne needs an appropriate punishment for their sins.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4110g_00100_02050_1: Please, she begs, why won't someone punish me?:
LID_a02050_4110g_00200_02050_1: \nIt does not matter if her punisher is man, beast, or demon.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4110g_00300_02050_1: \n\nShe wants to die in the most cruel manner, in gruesome agony, and savagely pulverized into the dirt.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4110g_00400_02050_1: \nOnly then, she believes, will her soul be saved.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4120g_00200_02050_1: \n\nHer true sin is not losing the girl.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4120g_00300_02050_1: \nAnd she has yet to realize the truth.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4120g_00400_02050_1: \nWhy did the girl not leave this world with any last words?:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4120g_00500_02050_1: \n\nOnly the girl knew in that moment that she was happy till her very last moments.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4130g_00100_02050_1: She was happy since the day the woman took her hand.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4130g_00200_02050_1: \nShe was happy to live a mundane, inconsequential life.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4130g_00300_02050_1: \nShe was happy she found a life in which she was free to make her own decisions.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4130g_00400_02050_1: \nShe did not feel a speck of hatred for this world.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4130g_00600_02050_1: \nShe prayed the rest of the woman's life would be happy, and she died with a heart free of hatred.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4130g_00700_02050_1: The woman, who has submit wholly to her anger, cannot possibly realize this truth.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4130g_00800_02050_1: \n\nTo the very end, the woman could never understand the girl's heart.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4140g_00100_02050_1: That is the woman's gravest, most abominable sin.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4140g_00200_02050_1: \nDeath will not be visited upon her until she understands this sin.:<TAP>
LID_a02050_4140g_00300_02050_1: \n\nAnd she will never realize that to live not knowing is her greatest punishment.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4150g_00100_02050_1: The demon woman roams in a purgatory of her own making. Today, tomorrow, and the next day, in a space of agony manifest by meaningless guilt, she takes the lives of others with an inerrant heart.:<PAGE>
LID_a02050_4150g_00200_02050_1: I will kill as much as I have to. So please, someone...kill me. She begs at the empty precipice, turning her eyes away from her only salvation.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1010g_00100_02060_1: A cold, biting wind howls through the spaces between houses.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1010g_00200_02060_1: \nThe town sits at the foot of a mythical and sacred mountain, its peaks standing against gray skies.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1010g_00300_02060_1: \n\nAmong the adventurers preparing to climb the mountain is a woman.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1010g_00400_02060_1: \nIn stark contrast to the heroic builds of the others, she is hardly blessed with a robust physique.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1010g_00500_02060_1: \n\nYet her eyes burn with an unshakable will and resolution every bit as bright as theirs.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1010g_00600_02060_1: \nDespite her youth, she has considerable adventuring experience under her belt.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1020g_00100_02060_1: She breathes deep to whet her spirit.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1020g_00200_02060_1: \n\nShe reflects on her memories to prepare for the fight to come.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1020g_00300_02060_1: \nPrior to coming here, she heard all sorts of rumors about the sacred mountain.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1020g_00400_02060_1:
Whispers of a wild and vicious yeti...
Tales of an all-healing herb near the peak...
Rumors of disembodied voices of the dead luring climbers into darkness.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1020g_00500_02060_1: \n\nSome rumors are eerie and meant to evoke fear, while others are fantastical and strange.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1030g_00100_02060_1: The mythical mountain is majestic, profound, primeval.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1030g_00200_02060_1: \nIts ever-present looming and the people's devout dread are the sources of all manner of conjecture.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1030g_00300_02060_1: \n\nAs she ponders the mountain, she steels her resolve anew.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1030g_00400_02060_1: \n\nShe's finally done readying herself and her things.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1030g_00500_02060_1: \nThe residents of the town, especially other women, speak to her with worry.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1040g_00100_02060_1: The mountain is much too dangerous for you.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1040g_00200_02060_1: \n\nA woman climbing the mountain? That's downright rash.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1040g_00300_02060_1: \n\nThink of the family you're leaving behind!:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1040g_00400_02060_1: \n\nThere's no mischief or malice in their voices—their concern is genuine.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1040g_00500_02060_1: \n\nThey sympathize with the woman while also admonishing her.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1040g_00600_02060_1: \n\nThey've seen countless men off and have witnessed almost as many failures.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1040g_00700_02060_1: \nAnd their own family members surely made up some of that number.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1050g_00100_02060_1: More than a few wives and daughters have watched their families fall apart.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1050g_00200_02060_1: \nTheir feelings for the mountain are odd and complex.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1050g_00300_02060_1: \n\nBut their distress is readily apparent to the adventurer woman.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1050g_00400_02060_1: \n\nEven more so because she, too, has experienced the same.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1050g_00500_02060_1: \n\nHer father was an adventurer who left her mother and unborn child behind to climb this mountain, only to abruptly lose his life here.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1060g_00100_02060_1: Said unborn child was her little brother.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1060g_00200_02060_1: \nEven in the womb, her little brother was in poor health.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1060g_00300_02060_1: \n\nIt wasn't certain if he'd be born without complications if he lived at all—the doctor's diagnosis was dire.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1060g_00400_02060_1: \nBut miraculously, he was born healthy and grew well.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1060g_00500_02060_1: \n\nThis was shortly after her father left her mother behind and prioritized climbing the mountain, never to return.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1070g_00100_02060_1: When the woman was still but a girl, she couldn't understand what it was he gave up and what he was trying to conquer.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1070g_00200_02060_1: \nShe couldn't understand why he wasn't there when her mother was in pain.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1070g_00400_02060_1:
Her father harbored a deep desire to master the art of adventure.
The woman would understand what that meant only many years later.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1080g_00100_02060_1: That's just who your father is.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1080g_00200_02060_1: \n\nIt was her mother's common refrain whenever the woman's resentment and resistance caused her to question him.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1080g_00300_02060_1: \n\nBut something in particular eventually led her to read his journal.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1080g_00400_02060_1: \nEver since then, her perspective of him changed drastically.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1080g_00600_02060_1: \n\nBut he was someone she was meant to surpass.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1090g_00100_02060_1: She chose the same path as him, one of adventure.\nIn her eyes, this mountain is a place of destiny, an object of revenge.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1090g_00200_02060_1: \n\nShe remembers it like it was only yesterday.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1090g_00300_02060_1: \n\nBefore she read the journal, her father once murmured something in her presence.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1090g_00400_02060_1: \n\nY'know, if you were a boy, I'd take ya on an adventure with me.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1100g_00100_02060_1: Thinking on it now, she wonders if perhaps he simply didn't want to put his daughter in danger.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1100g_00200_02060_1: \n\nPerhaps witnessing his wife distance herself from adventuring after giving birth influenced him.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1100g_00300_02060_1: \n\nBut when the woman heard him speak those words, she began to cry for reasons she didn't understand.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1100g_00400_02060_1: \n\nAn emotion she could not name, neither loneliness nor sorrow, welled up inside of her.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1110g_00100_02060_1: She could no longer bear the vexation.\nWhy had she been born a girl?\nWhy couldn't she live up to her father's expectations?:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1110g_00200_02060_1: \n\nEven now, long after her complicated feelings for her father have melted away, she still cannot forget that frustration.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1110g_00300_02060_1: \n\nAnd that is why she must balance the scales.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1110g_00400_02060_1: \n\nShe must climb the legendary mountain her father failed to conquer and claim those peaks for herself.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1120g_00300_02060_1: \n\nShe brushed away those flawed convictions and became a true adventurer in her own right.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1120g_00400_02060_1: \nShe would prove her skill as his daughter.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1120g_00500_02060_1: \n\nShe cannot deny the fear and unease, of course, but it's too late to turn back now.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1120g_00600_02060_1: \n\nShe can already hear her mother laugh dryly, but this, too, flows in her blood.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_1130g_00100_02060_1: I won't lose to you, Dad.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_1130g_00200_02060_1: \n\nWearing the mittens she once wove but never had the chance to give to her father, the adventuring woman sets off for the mountain.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2010g_00100_02060_1: The wind is far colder than it was in the town.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2010g_00300_02060_1: \n\nThe adventuring woman begins climbing the mountain that her father failed to conquer.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2010g_00400_02060_1:
The path is steep, but she's determined to surpass her father.
Fatigue is nowhere to be found on her face.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2010g_00500_02060_1: \n\nRather, her expression is one of ferocity and joy, as though bravery wells up within her.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2010g_00600_02060_1: \n\nIt's a face her father never saw.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2020g_00100_02060_1: <align="center">My little girl, once so adorable and small...</align>:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2030g_00100_02060_1: An astonished man looks at the woman.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2030g_00300_02060_1: \n\nThe man is none other than her father, the very man who attempted to conquer this mountain and failed.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2030g_00400_02060_1: \n\nThe souls of adventurers who failed the climb remain on the mountain.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2030g_00500_02060_1: \n\nHis existence is hollow and cannot be seen, but his spirit burns.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2040g_00100_02060_1: Though she has grown and matured, the man knows his daughter when he sees her.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2040g_00200_02060_1: \n\nThe mountain is steep, and loneliness wears her down, but the smile beaming across the woman's face is one of excitement and delight.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2040g_00300_02060_1: \nShe has clearly inherited the man's adventuring blood.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2040g_00400_02060_1: \n\nBut what ebbs and flows in his chest is not sentimentality for the life she's led thus far.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2050g_00100_02060_1: Rather, what concerns him the most is her mountaineering technique.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2050g_00200_02060_1: \n\nShe's chosen to traverse the same peaks as him, which requires appropriate strength, refined skills, and, above all else, spirit to match.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2050g_00300_02060_1: \n\nOn this mountain especially, even the smallest of reservations will quickly pull the rug out from underneath any climber.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2050g_00400_02060_1: \n\nThe man keeps a close eye on his daughter's every move.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2060g_00100_02060_1: The man knows all too well the challenges this mountain has to offer.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2060g_00200_02060_1: \nChasms in the ground run deeper than the darkest abyss.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2060g_00400_02060_1: \n\nEvery obstacle the man overcame with spirit and grit alone relentlessly assail the woman.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2060g_00500_02060_1: \n\nBut she faces these trials in ways completely unlike his approach.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2070g_00100_02060_1: There's a particular crevice he once braved with strength alone.\nInstead, she places a foldable ladder over it and deftly crosses.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2070g_00200_02060_1: \n\nThat little ladder will not save you! the man bellows.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2070g_00300_02060_1: \n\nBut his voice is little more than the faint whisper of the dead.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2070g_00500_02060_1: \n\nDisregarding his panicked yell, she continues along and misses her step.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2080g_00100_02060_1: The man covers his eyes and wails, but he never hears the woman scream.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2080g_00200_02060_1: \nThe lifeline she attached to herself beforehand comes in handy.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2080g_00300_02060_1: \n\nShe calmly climbs back onto the ladder and then carefully continues to the other side of the gap.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2080g_00400_02060_1: \n\nShe has a meticulousness that the man never had.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2090g_00100_02060_1: But upon reaching the other side, a sudden and ferocious blizzard batters the woman, just as he expected.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2090g_00200_02060_1:
Her vision is blanketed by white in the span of a second.
She can't see an inch in front of her.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2090g_00300_02060_1: \nThe wind's piercing howl robs her of her hearing all the while.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2090g_00400_02060_1:
The man once fell into the same predicament.
He relied on his own wild instincts to find the path again.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2100g_00100_02060_1: He prays his daughter inherited the same instincts.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2100g_00200_02060_1:
He is practically beside himself with unease.
But in stark contrast to his emotions, the woman shows no sign of panic.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2100g_00300_02060_1: \n\nHe notices her rummaging around in her supplies, and she produces a compass.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2100g_00400_02060_1:
She turns until the needle points precisely north.
With careful steps, she follows the path.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2110g_00100_02060_1: Compasses are hardly a new invention, but the man reacts as though he's never seen one.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2110g_00200_02060_1: \nHe always adventured on raw vigor, after all.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2110g_00300_02060_1: \n\nThe blizzard finally calms, and her vision returns to her.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2110g_00400_02060_1: \n\nWatching his daughter's progress, the man finds himself deeply impressed by their differences.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2110g_00500_02060_1:
Though their approaches were hardly the same, his daughter is, without a doubt, risking her life on this journey.
She is a true adventurer in her own right.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_2120g_00100_02060_1: To think she's grown so much...:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2120g_00200_02060_1: \n\nThe man does not dwell on his own biases. Rather, he rejoices in the birth of a stalwart and capable adventurer.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2120g_00300_02060_1: \n\nUnaware of his satisfied gaze, the woman presses forward through the mountain.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_2120g_00400_02060_1: \n\nHaving made it this far, it's possible that she might reach the peak.:<TAP>

LID_a02060_2130g_00200_02060_1: \n\nBut then, her ears pick up on the starved breath of a wild animal.:<TAP>

The man has no way to help.

The woman takes a deep breath and prepares to face off against the wolves...:<PAGE>

LID_a02060_3010g_00300_02060_1: \nOr perhaps it's a thirst for life; a desire no human could ever taste.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3010g_00400_02060_1: \n\nThe wolf pack and the adventurer anticipate the other's first move.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3010g_00500_02060_1: \nIf one misjudges the other's strength, they will lose.:<TAP>

LID_a02060_3020g_00300_02060_1: \n\nHis daughter is one lunge away from death.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3030g_00100_02060_1: The gentle noise of snow underfoot echoes through the quiet mountain.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3030g_00200_02060_1: \n\nThe wolf pack leader makes the first move with a furious leap.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3030g_00300_02060_1:
Sharp, ferocious fangs fly straight for the woman.
The father screams.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3030g_00400_02060_1: \n\nBut suddenly, the wolf falls to the ground.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_3040g_00200_02060_1:
The woman does not let this chance go.
She throws her fist against one wolf and then another.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3040g_00400_02060_1: \n\nAnd then, she lets out a ferocious bellow.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3040g_00500_02060_1: \n\nTheir will to fight completely stolen from them, the wolves, quite literally, run away with their tails between their legs.:<PAGE>
LID_a02060_3050g_00100_02060_1: It is with great effort and wit that she has so skillfully overcome these difficulties.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3050g_00200_02060_1: \nAnd now, the woman has earned an overwhelming victory through pure and tenacious strength.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3060g_00100_02060_1: I was worried for a sec there, but that's my girl! It'll take more than some mangy mutts to do her in.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3060g_00200_02060_1: \n\nForgetting his panic, the man smiles proudly.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3060g_00300_02060_1: \n\nThe sole source of his unease now is that he can no longer hear the echoes through the mountain, sounds which rang constantly when he was alive and always lifted his spirits.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3060g_00400_02060_1: \n\nUnaware of her father's booming laughter, the woman presses onward.:<TAP>
LID_a02060_3060g_00500_02060_1: \nThe man follows her frantically, nearly losing sight of her.:<PAGE>

LID_a02070_2170g_00300_02070_1: \n\nHe will escape this place that separates him from a fate far more wicked and cruel.:<TAP>
