LID_a02070_3010g_00200_02070_1: \nIn his captivity, he finds freedom for the first time. He finds bliss in the time he spends with her.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3020g_00100_02070_1: He finds data on the Resistance servers.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3020g_00200_02070_1: \n\nHe learns the truth—he and the woman are clones, implanted with memories of being a couple who lost their child, and made to fight as the army commands.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3020g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThe man now realizes: The woman knew all of this, and she feigned friendliness to placate him.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3020g_00400_02070_1: \n\nIn his disappointment and despair, he makes up his mind—he must escape this place.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3030g_00100_02070_1: One day, fighting breaks out between the army and the Resistance. The man grasps this golden opportunity to leave the Resistance base.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3030g_00200_02070_1: \nOther Resistance members do not chase him far.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3030g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThey are few in numbers to begin with.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3040g_00100_02070_1: Evidently, the Resistance cannot spare a single member to track down an escaped prisoner when the fighting gets serious.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3040g_00300_02070_1: \n\nHe will surely find his way back to the army base if he keeps running.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3050g_00100_02070_1: But there is one person who has stuck to his trail.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3050g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe defective woman. She alone has pursued the man.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3050g_00300_02070_1: \n\nPanicked by his absence, she set off in search of him to set him right without having to rely on the help of her comrades.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3060g_00100_02070_1: Her breath is ragged as she stands before him, pointing a gun.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3060g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe distant affection lingering in him pangs.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3060g_00300_02070_1: \n\nShe was using his feelings against him.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3060g_00400_02070_1: \n\nAnd now, it seems she insists on killing him by her own hand.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3070g_00100_02070_1: How lively their conversations once were. But now, there is only silence. A dry, desolate wind blows between them.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3070g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe man pushes down the stinging sorrow in his chest and points his own gun at her.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3070g_00300_02070_1: \n\nHe rests his finger on the trigger to rid himself of these pointless emotions that drag on endlessly.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3080g_00100_02070_1: But then, he notices something unusual in the woman's face.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3080g_00200_02070_1: \n\nTears stream down her face. But it is not from the fear of death.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3080g_00300_02070_1: \n\nHer jaw is clenched, her fingers quiver, her brows knit in perplexity—in truth, they are tears of sadness.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3090g_00100_02070_1: Weren't you using me to your own ends?:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3090g_00300_02070_1: \n\nI was. I used your fate and my own so that I could be free.:
LID_a02070_3090g_00400_02070_1: \n\nAs though ridding herself of the trauma burned into her heart, she continues speaking her truth.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3100g_00100_02070_1: Once she was disposed of as defective, and after the Resistance took her in, she learned that she was a clone.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3100g_00200_02070_1: \n\nShe felt as though her whole life, her whole being was rendered into nothing, and she fell into despair.:
LID_a02070_3100g_00300_02070_1: \nThough she was once a soldier who fought the Flowers, she no could no longer hold onto the motivation to fight, becoming nothing more than a weak human who did no battle.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3100g_00400_02070_1: \n\nThe world had no need for her, yet she still desired life. And so she sought a future in which she could live.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3110g_00100_02070_1: The Resistance's cause hardly resonated with her. And yet she devoted herself to her work so that she could make a place for herself.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3110g_00200_02070_1: \n\nAnd then one day, they captured a man.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3110g_00300_02070_1: \nShe knew they were created to be a married couple—their compatibility was all but guaranteed.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3110g_00400_02070_1: \nShe believed she could easily manipulate him into giving up information.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3120g_00100_02070_1: She did her work as usual, protecting the niche she carved out for herself. For a time, things went just as planned.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3120g_00200_02070_1: \n\nBut the feelings she had for him slumbering in the depths of her mind arose with more power than she ever imagined.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3130g_00100_02070_1: As she tried to win him over to their side, she enjoyed the conversations they shared, she sympathized with his thoughts and opinions, and ultimately fell deeply in love with him.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3130g_00200_02070_1: \n\nShe knew it was false. Things were unfolding according to this terrible fate, though she thought she could run from it.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3130g_00300_02070_1: \n\nI couldn't fight the feelings, she declares.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3140g_00100_02070_1: When the man hears this, he knows.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3140g_00200_02070_1: \n\nHe too has feelings he cannot fight.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3140g_00300_02070_1: \n\nIs there any point to fighting them?:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3150g_00100_02070_1: Making up his mind, he lowers his gun.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3150g_00200_02070_1: \n\nHe fearlessly steps toward her in spite of the barrel pointed at him and speaks softly.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3150g_00300_02070_1: \n\nEven if everything is a lie, I still want to live my life with you.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3150g_00400_02070_1: \n\nHis honest feelings are at once predictable and genuine.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3160g_00100_02070_1: They are not married, nor parents, but strangers. Even if their spark was nothing but fabricated memories, the desire to remain together is real.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3160g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe woman lowers her gun with trembling hands. Tears continue to stream down her face. The man extends a hand to her.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3160g_00300_02070_1: \n\nLet's run away. It doesn't matter where. We're getting out of this world that's hell-bent on using us.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3160g_00400_02070_1: \n\nShe gives a firm nod to his invitation.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_3170g_00100_02070_1: And so begins their escape journey.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3170g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe feelings they share for each other are their only truth.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_3170g_00300_02070_1: \n\nAnd by their own hands, they will find true freedom.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4010g_00100_02070_1: A pair of clones created to be family.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4010g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThrough ill-starred fate, they met, fell in love, and decided to run away together.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4010g_00300_02070_1: \n\nAway from the world that wished to toy with their hearts.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4020g_00200_02070_1: \n\nNeither of them have returned to the military base or the Resistance hideout.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4020g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThey live quiet, modest lives scattered across lands far from civilization.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4030g_00100_02070_1: Their lives are neither leisurely nor dignified, but they understood this the moment they decided to run.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4030g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThey knew they were not long for this world.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4030g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThey knew their deaths were not far off.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4040g_00100_02070_1: I'm sorry for dragging you along on this life.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4040g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe man speaks with dry, aged lips.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4040g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThere's no need to apologize. I'm the one who chose to go with you.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4040g_00400_02070_1: \n\nThe woman's lips are similarly parched, but they smile in return.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4050g_00100_02070_1: They know it, understand it, accept it.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4050g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThey know they are inferior clones of an original pair.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4050g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThe makeup of their bodies is not the same as that of a pure human.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4050g_00400_02070_1: \n\nWithout the military's newest bespoke maintenance routines and provisions, their physical bodies and organs cannot sustain function.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4060g_00100_02070_1: In essence, neither can live life to their satisfaction so long as they remain free. In a few years' time, their lives will cease.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4060g_00200_02070_1: \n\nChronologically, they are not even twenty years old.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4060g_00300_02070_1: \n\nAnd unlike what their false memories recalled, they never had a child.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4060g_00400_02070_1: \n\nThough their background was that of a married couple, they were never given reproductive organs in the first place.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4070g_00100_02070_1: This world does not want them to be parents.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4070g_00200_02070_1: \n\nLife is hardly necessary in a world that battles the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4070g_00300_02070_1: \n\nYet they chose to be life partners, to become that married couple.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4070g_00400_02070_1: \nThey were not forced into marriage—they chose it.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4080g_00100_02070_1: At the end of their journey, there are no other humans there to bless their relationship.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4080g_00200_02070_1: \nThere are no other living beings at all.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4080g_00300_02070_1: \n\nWherever they live, wherever they visit, there are no children.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4080g_00400_02070_1: \n\nThe world's struggle against the growing forces of the Flowers goes on, and the army loses soldier lives and creates new ones every day.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4090g_00100_02070_1: Both the man and the woman once fought against the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4090g_00200_02070_1: \n\nBut victory for humanity is not their goal, so they evade the Flowers entirely. They have no reason to fight, so they have no need to engage.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4090g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThey will leave behind no legacy, and they do not fight to protect anything—they simply live. In the eyes of the army and the Resistance both, they live useless, lonely, and empty lives.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4090g_00400_02070_1: \n\nNor will they ever have the chance for a glorious death in battle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4100g_00100_02070_1: This world is in ruins. Its condition will only worsen, and there is no truth worth rejoicing in. There are only the faintest rays of light.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4100g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe man could have lived a full life if he remained in the army under strict supervision.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4100g_00300_02070_1: \n\nHe would have met and fallen in love with another woman, living his life to protect her. Perhaps that mundane life would have been ideal for him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4110g_00100_02070_1: Yet both he and this woman acted of their own will, joined together in matrimony of their own will, and they regret nothing.:
LID_a02070_4110g_00300_02070_1: \nHow are the other clones faring? What about the ones who birthed them?:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4110g_00400_02070_1: \n\nPerhaps they have found satisfaction in their own ways, but the man and the woman believe they are more free than those people will ever be.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4120g_00100_02070_1: Painful though it is, they accept this death.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4120g_00200_02070_1: \n\nDifficult though it is, this is the life they wish to share together.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4120g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThis is the true essence of freedom, they believe.:
LID_a02070_4130g_00100_02070_1: No matter how things end, we will face it together. So long as I'm with you, I can find happiness anywhere.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4130g_00200_02070_1: \n\nThe man speaks gently, his body weakened.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4130g_00300_02070_1: \n\nWe will be together to our last breath. So long as I'm with you, I can accept whatever awaits us.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4130g_00400_02070_1: \n\nThe woman speaks warmly, her brittle bones creaking.:<PAGE>
LID_a02070_4140g_00100_02070_1: A lost civilization. A lost future.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4140g_00200_02070_1: \n\nAn endless era of dulled grays and steel, devoid of the life of human activity.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4140g_00300_02070_1: \n\nThe only sound is that of their own voices. No legacy will remain to recount the path they walked.:<TAP>
LID_a02070_4140g_00400_02070_1: \n\n...But their lives are fulfilling all the same.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1010g_00100_02080_1: Ferocious man-eating Flowers threaten the very existence of humanity.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1010g_00200_02080_1: \nSoldiers known as "prisoners" face the Flowers in brutal, deadly battle day in and day out.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1010g_00400_02080_1: \nA particular frontline base suffered catastrophic damage after a large-scale Flower attack.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1010g_00500_02080_1: \n\nThe only survivors were a prisoner couple—a man and a woman.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1010g_00600_02080_1: \nThe Flowers had taken their precious child's life, and they fought to avenge him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1020g_00100_02080_1: The battle ended in utter defeat for the base. Their fellow prisoners were mercilessly slaughtered.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1020g_00400_02080_1: \nThe couple had not forgotten about their revenge.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1030g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThough the Flowers destroyed most of the base's facilities, not all of its functions ceased.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1030g_00400_02080_1: \nMiraculously, the bare minimum of supplies remained.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1030g_00500_02080_1: \n\nAnd so together, the couple begins repairing the base in preparation to fight the Flowers once more.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1040g_00100_02080_1: We need to do something about these seeds first. They've jammed up all the equipment.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1040g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThe Flowers scattered the seeds during their attack.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1040g_00300_02080_1: \nThey will continue to grow and hamper the restoration of the base until the day they awaken.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1050g_00100_02080_1: If the seeds aren't dealt with quickly, young Flowers will bud and grow rampant.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1050g_00200_02080_1: \n\nIn such an event, the Flowers would trample the base from the inside, bringing an inevitable and total defeat.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1050g_00300_02080_1: \nIt's the one scenario they want to avoid at all costs.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1060g_00100_02080_1: The couple ventures deep into the base, doing all they can to remove seeds from every nook and cranny.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1060g_00200_02080_1: \n\nIt's backbreaking work, but not once do they voice a complaint.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1070g_00100_02080_1: Amidst their intensive yet critical work, the wife finds a corridor she's never seen before.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1070g_00200_02080_1: \nIt's likely a consequence of the partial destruction of the base. Things that were once completely obscured are now plainly visible.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1070g_00300_02080_1: \n\nWhat is this? The two exchange looks, quietly nod, then cautiously make their way down the corridor.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1080g_00100_02080_1: They come to the deepest part of the base.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1080g_00200_02080_1: \nIn the center of the room is a console, and on the opposite side, a massive door.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1080g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThanks to the room being so deep within the base, it suffered no damage from the Flower attack and retains the full scope of its functions.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1090g_00100_02080_1: The woman accesses the console and quickly skims over the data within.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1090g_00200_02080_1: \nIt seems to be quite a large database. However...:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1090g_00300_02080_1: \n\nNo communication functions? Was this device cut off from the network?:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1100g_00100_02080_1: Standing before them is an apparatus that does not send nor receive information, but rather, it is a vessel for storing it.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1100g_00200_02080_1: \nBut why? To what end? Though doubt lingers in their minds, the couple continues to fiddle with the console and studies its data.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1100g_00400_02080_1: \nThey understand why this device and its data were in use despite being isolated from the network.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1110g_00100_02080_1: What unfolds before them is the genetic information of the Flowers, something long considered a mystery.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1110g_00200_02080_1: \n\nNot a word of this was mentioned to the prisoners. This information is as confidential as can be.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1120g_00100_02080_1: This data could very well be key to eliminating the Flower seeds effectively and definitively.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1120g_00300_02080_1: \n\nWith a thorough analysis of the genetic data, they might be able to find a way to eradicate the Flowers entirely.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1120g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe wife trembles with excitement. It's as though the data is divine intervention.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1120g_00500_02080_1: \nTheir revenge may well be within their grasp.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1130g_00200_02080_1: \n\nWhy didn't they tell anyone about such critical information? Why hide it away here?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1130g_00500_02080_1: \nWith data like this, the development of weapons effective against the Flowers would have been possible.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1140g_00100_02080_1: Someone must have been plotting something.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1140g_00200_02080_1: \nPerhaps a greater secret is hidden somewhere in this base?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1140g_00300_02080_1: \n\nIn search of further information, the couple decides to venture beyond the great door on the other side of the room.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1140g_00400_02080_1: \n\nIt's a place the officers kept hidden away from the prisoners.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1150g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThey find the massive corpse of a Flower.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1150g_00300_02080_1: \n\nIt floats in what appears to be a water tank, and several cables connect to it.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1160g_00200_02080_1: \n\nHundreds of clear capsules are filled with liquid and peacefully sleeping human bodies.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_1170g_00100_02080_1: At a loss for words, the couple immediately understands the significance of the shocking sight.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_1170g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThey are human, and yet they are not.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2010g_00100_02080_1: A prisoner couple were the sole survivors of a ferocious Flower attack.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2010g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThey ventured into the core of their base in search of a way to rid the base of Flower seeds.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2010g_00300_02080_1: \n\nIt was there they found a well-preserved Flower corpse.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2010g_00400_02080_1: \n\nAnd with it, tanks of manufactured humans.:<PAGE>

LID_a02080_2020g_00200_02080_1: \nThe sight bluntly spells out the reality of their situation.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2020g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThe ones before them are far from the only clones.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2020g_00400_02080_1: \nThey, too, were once among them. They were mass-produced humans.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2020g_00600_02080_1: \nThey are nothing but pawns used to fight against the Flowers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2030g_00200_02080_1: \nWhat was the agony they experienced when their child was taken from them?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2030g_00300_02080_1: \nWhat is the inferno of revenge that burns within them?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2030g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe couple accesses the attached console in search of answers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2030g_00500_02080_1: \n\nThey've come too far to leave empty-handed.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2030g_00600_02080_1: \n\nThey've crossed the point of no return.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2040g_00100_02080_1: The records reveal to them a terrible, unthinkable truth.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2040g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThe truth is that they are but two of many mass-produced clone soldiers implanted with false memories.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2040g_00300_02080_1: \n\nGenuine humans no longer exist on the planet. They died out long ago.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2050g_00100_02080_1: Over the many years of battle, resources are nearly depleted, leading the military to devise a plan to recoup these losses.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2050g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThe plan: to break down and analyze the Flowers and then use their parts as resources.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2060g_00100_02080_1: Initially, they were used mainly for fuel, food, and other daily necessities, but the military gradually expanded the scope of their usage.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2060g_00200_02080_1: \n\nBefore long, they began using Flower corpses as the raw material for clone soldiers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2070g_00100_02080_1: The Flowers propagated rapidly as they fed on the soldiers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2070g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThough they were at eternal war, both sides were quietly entangled in a symbiotic relationship.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2080g_00100_02080_1: All the couple can do is stand there in shock.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2080g_00200_02080_1: \n\nShocked by the truth that their enemy—the ones they sought vengeance toward, the despicable entities responsible for taking everything from them—are the ones that give them life.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2080g_00300_02080_1: \n\nBut the top brass never revealed this truth, nor did they find a breakthrough in the war. They simply pushed forward with an aimless battle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2090g_00100_02080_1: Of course they did—the Flowers became an indispensable resource.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2090g_00200_02080_1: \nIf they were eradicated, humanity would soon follow.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2090g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThe Flowers are a function of life in this modern civilization. They are the foundation that supports all life, the pillar of the precious food chain.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2100g_00100_02080_1: Is the couple little more than the cogs that make up this hellish machine?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2100g_00200_02080_1: \nAnd what of the precious, devoted affection they hold for one another that keeps them going in this world?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2100g_00300_02080_1: \n\nWhat of the tragic memories of losing their dear child, the source of their immeasurable will and wrath in battle?:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2110g_00100_02080_1: It is all a deceitful fabrication.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2110g_00200_02080_1: \nA tale of fate meant to guide the couple.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2110g_00300_02080_1: \n\nAnd above all else, if humanity died out long ago, then this eternal war is a meaningless massacre.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2110g_00400_02080_1: \n\nIs this the only meaning our lives hold?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2110g_00500_02080_1: \n\nThe husband is furious over the empty truths, his spirit cracking to its breaking point.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2120g_00100_02080_1: Without even despair to keep him, he crumples to sit on the floor and gazes into an invisible distance.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2120g_00200_02080_1: \nBut the wife remains in her spot, staring at the data.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2120g_00400_02080_1: \n\nDoubting there's much point in learning any more terrible truths, the husband lifts his head and speaks.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2130g_00200_02080_1: \n\nShe responds, her voice ringing clear with will. The light has not yet gone from the woman's eyes.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2130g_00300_02080_1: \nIt's the face of a person who has not yet given in to hopelessness.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2130g_00600_02080_1: \n\nThe wife, however, gives an undaunted smile.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_2140g_00100_02080_1: I finally understand what I'm—no, what we're supposed to do.:
LID_a02080_2140g_00200_02080_1: \n\nShe turns to her husband and extends a hand.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_2140g_00300_02080_1: \n\nWe'll put an end to all of this. It's something only we can do.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3010g_00100_02080_1: The Flowers destroyed the prisoner couple's base. In the process of ridding the base of scattered seeds, they ventured into the hidden core of the building.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3010g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThere, they learned that the soldiers who fight the Flowers, themselves included, are clones.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3010g_00300_02080_1: \nThe soldiers were born from Flower corpses.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3020g_00100_02080_1: Genuine humans had long since died out. All that remained was the bizarre symbiotic relationship between Flowers and clones.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3020g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThis truth was enough to render to ash any and all reasons to press on that they had been clinging to.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3020g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe wife does not despair at all.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3020g_00500_02080_1: \nIf anything, she is optimistic that they can end this cycle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3030g_00200_02080_1: \n\nShe brings her husband to his feet and points at a record on the terminal.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3030g_00300_02080_1: \nFanned out over the screen are biological records of the Flowers, as well as experiment logs.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3030g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThere is a way to defeat the Flowers—it's just that nobody has put it to practice yet.:
LID_a02080_3040g_00100_02080_1: Hidden among the collection of meticulously thorough experiment logs is an article on a particular chemical.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3040g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThis chemical rewrites a part of the genetic code that makes up the Flowers and accelerates their growth until they wilt—a decisive weapon indeed.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3050g_00100_02080_1: Along with a wealth of data from the research are instructions on how to synthesize this chemical.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3050g_00300_02080_1: \n\nAs though answering that very question, ID numbers of those who proposed the chemical are listed at the end of the article...along with photos of their faces.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3060g_00100_02080_1: They look exactly like the couple.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3060g_00200_02080_1: \n\nJudging by the years written on the report, they were clones several generations prior to themselves.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3060g_00300_02080_1: \nThey desperately fought the Flowers, desperately studied their characteristics...:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3060g_00400_02080_1: \n\nAnd they ultimately completed research that could wipe out the Flowers once and for all.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3070g_00100_02080_1: Was it the by-product of something? Or was it something these clones created in secret for themselves?:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3070g_00200_02080_1: \nThe research logs offer no insight into these questions.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3070g_00300_02080_1: \n\nWhat is clear, however, is that this chemical could not be made public.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3070g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe Flowers could not be eliminated—they were a precious resource.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3070g_00500_02080_1: \nThat is the conclusion the military leaders came to, and all information regarding the chemical was hidden away here.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3080g_00100_02080_1: The Flowers pushed humanity to extinction. And now, there is a way to eliminate them once and for all dangling within reach.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3080g_00300_02080_1: \nTheir research was taken from them and likely destroyed.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3080g_00400_02080_1: \nBut their will to eradicate the Flowers flourished.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3080g_00500_02080_1: \nIt remained with them. And though it could be an inexplicable coincidence, they find themselves here in this future.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3080g_00600_02080_1: \n\nIronically, it's thanks to the top military brass that the data was hidden away intact rather than wiped from existence entirely.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3090g_00200_02080_1: \nThe words echo in the woman's head after a brief moment of hesitation.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3090g_00300_02080_1: \n\nTheir goal remains the same as ever—they were to eradicate the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3090g_00400_02080_1: \nOnly now, their reasons are different. It's not for revenge but for something far greater.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3100g_00100_02080_1: Here, with the many precious things humanity left behind, they will put an end to this warped symbiotic relationship between them and the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3100g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe husband looks to his wife and nods firmly.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3110g_00100_02080_1: They embrace, collect their courage, and right themselves to walk forward.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3110g_00200_02080_1: \n\nIn this moment, their hearts are one.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3110g_00300_02080_1: \nThey reached their hapless fate, and records of the past appeared before their eyes.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3110g_00400_02080_1: \nTheir singular goal: to create the chemical and take back the planet from the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3110g_00500_02080_1: \n\nThe couple's lives rest on this fight to break the eternal cycle of life and death.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_3120g_00100_02080_1: They were born, killed, and eaten, only for the process to repeat.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3120g_00200_02080_1: \nThey never knew why they were born nor why they lived.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_3120g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe battle to prove their worth, to prove their humanity, starts here.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4010g_00100_02080_1: The prisoner couple fights against the Flowers, humanity's natural enemy.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4010g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThey have learned the harrowing truth of this world.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4010g_00300_02080_1: \nThe truth is that they are clones and that they and their fellow clones were born from the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4010g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThough they know their memories are false, they press on hand-in-hand.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4020g_00200_02080_1: \n\nTheir past selves—clones from several generations prior—developed a chemical.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4020g_00300_02080_1: \nThis chemical rewrote parts of the genetic data that made up the Flowers and accelerated their growth, pushing them to wilting.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4020g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe two cut off all communication with the outside and focus solely on producing the chemical, using the research data that the military superiors kept hidden.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4030g_00100_02080_1: There is ample information in the records on the synthesis of the chemical, but the process itself proved difficult.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4030g_00200_02080_1: \n\nMany of the steps are far outside of their fields of expertise, but they can't risk attracting the military's attention by seeking help from the outside.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4030g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThey trust only each other, working together closely to create the chemical.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4040g_00100_02080_1: All that's left now is attaching payloads to the drones in the hangar.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4040g_00300_02080_1: \nThough they lack great amounts of the chemical, there's still a chance of success.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4040g_00400_02080_1: \nWe only need one strain. Once the Flowers are exposed to the chemical...:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4040g_00500_02080_1: With victory before their eyes, the couple smiles at each other.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4040g_00600_02080_1: \nTheir memories are false. Their lives are fabrications. Yet, in spite of being presented with the truth, their bond remains as strong as ever.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4040g_00700_02080_1: \n\nThey are comrades in arms through adversity. They are family who navigate life together. Their implanted memories were no more than the spark that ignited their love.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4040g_00800_02080_1: \nThe footprints they left behind were undoubtedly real.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4040g_00900_02080_1: \n\nTomorrow's the big day. So today, let's—:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4050g_00100_02080_1: Before the wife can finish, an alarm blares throughout the base.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4050g_00200_02080_1: \n\nThe ground rumbles, and vines slither through every gap in the room, entwining everything they can find.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4050g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThese were the seeds left behind by the Flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4050g_00400_02080_1: \nThey paused their seed disposal to prioritize synthesizing the chemical, but they assumed they would have a few more days before they bloomed.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4060g_00100_02080_1: Perhaps it's an unlucky coincidence. Or perhaps the seeds sensed something.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4060g_00200_02080_1: \nPerhaps they instinctively sensed their impending doom.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4060g_00300_02080_1: \nThey would silence the couple here before they can disperse the chemical.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4070g_00400_02080_1: \nWith all their might, they mow down the budding Flowers, trampling them as they rush to the hangar.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4070g_00500_02080_1: Though it's not far away, through the chaos and distress, it feels like miles.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4070g_00600_02080_1: \nDespite it all, the couple reaches the hangar, their breath ragged.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4070g_00700_02080_1: \n\nThey manage to activate a number of drones, affix what little of the chemical they have, and set them off.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4070g_00800_02080_1: \nThe amount of chemical they managed to synthesize will likely only kill a portion of a given area's Flowers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4080g_00100_02080_1: But to the couple, that's more than enough.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4080g_00200_02080_1: \nBesides killing Flowers outright, the chemical has another effect.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4080g_00300_02080_1: \n\nPollen from Flowers exposed to the chemical would have a similar effect.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4090g_00100_02080_1: Pollen spreads far and wide and with great speed.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4090g_00200_02080_1: \nIt would carry on the wind across the land, across the seas, across the entire world.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4090g_00300_02080_1: \n\nThe multiplicative nature of the effect means even the tiniest amount of chemical could purge the planet of Flowers forever.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4090g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe effects are already taking effect on the budding Flowers in the base.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4090g_00500_02080_1: \nThe seedlings are born, immediately wither, then die.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4090g_00600_02080_1: \nThe couple heaves a victorious sigh of relief.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4100g_00100_02080_1: But their victory is not without its sacrifices.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4100g_00200_02080_1: \n\nAs she watches the Flowers wither, the wife is suddenly overcome by a terrible coughing fit.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4100g_00300_02080_1: \nA stream of blood pours from her mouth.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4100g_00400_02080_1: \nThe husband then clutches his chest in pain.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4100g_00500_02080_1: \n\nThe chemical that would eradicate the Flowers is both a panacea and poison.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4100g_00600_02080_1: \nIt affects those created from Flowers—the clones called prisoners.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4110g_00100_02080_1: This detail was not mentioned in the lab report.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4110g_00200_02080_1: \n\nAt a certain point, the clones' genetic data began to closely mirror the same base sequence as that of the Flowers. They were born from the same material, after all.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4110g_00300_02080_1: \n\nAs the couple produced the chemical, they realized this.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4110g_00400_02080_1: \nThey knew they would die if their strategy succeeded.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4120g_00100_02080_1: This was the greatest reason the military hid and sealed away all information regarding the chemical.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4120g_00200_02080_1: \n\nOnce they dispersed the chemical, it wasn't only the resources of the Flowers they'd lose.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4120g_00300_02080_1: \nThey would lose their lives as well.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4120g_00400_02080_1: \n\nYet, despite knowing this, they pressed on with their research.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4120g_00500_02080_1: \nThey gave everything to bring this agonizing eternal cycle to an end.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4130g_00100_02080_1: The drones take to the sky and scatter the chemical. The compound glitters in the sunlight.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4130g_00200_02080_1: \nAs death approaches, they sit, neither having the strength to stay on their feet.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4130g_00300_02080_1: \nThey lean against each other, waiting for time to pass.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4130g_00400_02080_1: \n\nThe husband is pleased with the success of their operation and satisfied with a life well-lived. He smiles through a cough.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4130g_00500_02080_1: \n\nIt's all over after this. Our suffering...and this world.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4140g_00100_02080_1: He speaks with resignation. But his wife does not nod.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4140g_00200_02080_1: \nBlood spills from her lips, but she gathers enough strength to reply.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4150g_00100_02080_1: In a world where everything spins toward destruction, this act is little more than a blip of chaos.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4150g_00200_02080_1: \nFlowers wilt and die, and the clones aren't far behind.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4150g_00300_02080_1: \n\nA long, harsh winter is surely on the horizon.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4160g_00100_02080_1: But the planet has been reclaimed.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4160g_00200_02080_1: \nThe eternal war will come to an end, and those who survived will lead new lives.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4160g_00400_02080_1: \nIn place of the Flowers that brought humanity to extinction, new life will bloom across this world.:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4160g_00500_02080_1: \n\nHow far into the future that might be, the couple can't say, but the future is awash in the light of hope all the same.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4170g_00100_02080_1: They hold hands and gaze up through the open roof of the hangar.:<PAGE>
LID_a02080_4170g_00200_02080_1: <align="center">The sky outside the base is dyed a dirty ash.</align>:<TAP>
LID_a02080_4170g_00300_02080_1: \n\n<align="center">But in their minds, it's a crisp, clear blue.</align>:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1010g_00100_02090_1: The summer night swelters. The air is still. A roar of flame climbs over the darkened suburbs and into the starry sky.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1010g_00200_02090_1: \nThe labor camp beyond the barbed wire burns.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1010g_00500_02090_1: \nThe workers' footsteps become a frenzied pounding as they seek escape.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1010g_00600_02090_1: \n\nThe sudden fires throw the inside of the building into chaos.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1020g_00100_02090_1: A small girl of meager years races down the burning corridor, her wails echoing off the walls.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1020g_00300_02090_1: \n\nA guard grabs her hand and attempts to pull her away.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1020g_00400_02090_1: \nHis plan is to take the sobbing girl away from the fire and outside to safety.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1020g_00500_02090_1: \n\nBut instead, she looks up with frightened eyes and digs her heels in tight.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1030g_00200_02090_1: \nFor she is a worker at the camp.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1030g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHer life has been a litany of abuses at the hands of the military, including guards like him.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1030g_00400_02090_1: \n\nSo when he grabs her hand, her fear instinct kicks in, and she is unable to move.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1040g_00100_02090_1: His irritation rising, the guard raises his voice.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1040g_00200_02090_1: \n\n"Do as I say, girl! Take advantage of the chaos and get out of—":<TAP>
LID_a02090_1050g_00100_02090_1: The girl stares at the blade that now protrudes from his chest.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1050g_00200_02090_1: \n\nSomeone has stabbed him from behind with a rapier.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1050g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe guard musters what remains of his hate to turn and face the figure behind him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1060g_00100_02090_1: It is a slim young man with silver hair.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1060g_00200_02090_1: \n\nIn his fading consciousness, the guard recalls a wanted poster he has seen countless times.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1060g_00300_02090_1: \nIt showed the image of the young man who now stands before him; of this there is no doubt.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1060g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe army has been searching for him, for he leads a group of insurgents who attack labor camps such as this.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1060g_00500_02090_1: \nAnd it is him and his people who caused this chaos.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1070g_00100_02090_1: The bloodied blade slides from the guard's body.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1070g_00200_02090_1: \nHis corpse slips into a puddle of blood on the ground.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1070g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe girl trembles to see the tragic sight before her. Her legs are heavy weights.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1070g_00500_02090_1: \n\nThe young man wipes his bloody blade on the fallen guard's clothes before turning his attention to the girl.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1070g_00600_02090_1: \n\n"Come on. We're getting out of here.":<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1080g_00100_02090_1: There is one reason he and his comrades attack the army's forced-labor camps::<TAP>
LID_a02090_1080g_00200_02090_1: \nThey seek to free children captured by the Infant Abduction Strategy and absorb them into their ranks.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1080g_00400_02090_1: \n\nIt is a secret operation in which this country's army kidnaps genetically superior children from foreign countries and trains them to be soldiers.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1080g_00500_02090_1: \n\nThose who prove ill-suited for warfare are instead thrown into labor camps.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1090g_00100_02090_1: The young man was abducted as part of this operation.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1090g_00200_02090_1: \nAnd though he fought for his new country for a short time, he deserted once he learned the truth of his background.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1090g_00300_02090_1: \n\nNow, he attacks their camps alongside those who are also fueled by a desire for revenge, freeing the laborers before taking them in as companions.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1090g_00400_02090_1: \n\nOne day, he will find and kill the man responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy—the man who tore him from his parents and made his life a misery.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1090g_00500_02090_1: \nBut in order to accomplish this task, he needs fighters of his own.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1100g_00100_02090_1: A dozen or so of his people wait for him outside the burning camp.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1100g_00200_02090_1: \nThe children who had been working there gather around them.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1100g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAs the young man sends the girl over to the others, one of his compatriots—a man with freckles—offers a report::<TAP>
LID_a02090_1100g_00500_02090_1: \n\nHe is one of their fellows who often acts outside of orders.:
LID_a02090_1110g_00200_02090_1: \n\nUnable to hide his irritation, the young man clicks his tongue.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1110g_00300_02090_1: \n\n"What's the plan?" asked the freckled man.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1110g_00400_02090_1: \nEven if they decide to launch a search, the camp is engulfed in flame.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1110g_00500_02090_1: \nAnd while they are safe at the moment, enemy reinforcements are surely on the way.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1120g_00100_02090_1: "Take the kids and get out of here. I'll catch up.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_1120g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThere is no hesitation in the young man's voice. Once he finishes speaking, he steps back inside the burning camp.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1130g_00100_02090_1: Flames billow in every corner. Superheated air burns in his lungs.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1130g_00200_02090_1: \n\nBut the young man with silver hair continues to search for his compatriot—and at last, he finds him.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1130g_00300_02090_1: \n\nA boy sits on the ground, his back leaning against the wall.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1130g_00400_02090_1: \nHis pitch-black hair—a rare feature in this part of the world—shines brightly in the light of the billowing flames.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1130g_00500_02090_1: \n\nHe has taken a gunshot wound to his leg—but though it has rendered him immobile, it does not appear fatal.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1140g_00100_02090_1: The young man sighs in relief before offering a cutting remark::<TAP>
LID_a02090_1140g_00200_02090_1: \n\n"Pretty sure this wasn't where I ordered you to be.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_1140g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe black-haired boy is defiant. His gaze drops to the dead soldiers scattered on the ground around him.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1140g_00500_02090_1: \n\n"I don't care about saving kids; I just want to kill as many of these bastards as I can.":<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1150g_00100_02090_1: After being taken through the Infant Abduction Strategy, the boy was deemed ill-suited for combat and sent to a labor camp.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1150g_00200_02090_1: \nHe now harbors a deep hatred for the soldiers that abused him.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1150g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAs his leader, the young man finds this desire for revenge to be the height of selfishness.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1150g_00400_02090_1: \n\nBut he reprimands the boy no further.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1150g_00500_02090_1: \nInstead, he slings him over his shoulders and silently moves back up the flaming corridor.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1160g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThey fall from his mouth without warning.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1160g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe young man understands why his subordinate acts as he does.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_1170g_00100_02090_1: When he was part of the army, he also made the same mistakes over and over in an attempt to avenge his parents. And every time, it was his captain and squadmates who pulled him from the fire.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_1170g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe black-haired boy reminds the young man so much of his earlier self.:
LID_a02090_1170g_00300_02090_1: \nAnd when he thinks of it that way, he finds he cannot abandon him to fate.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2010g_00100_02090_1: When he was yet small, the young man's parents were killed by an enemy army, after which he became a soldier so he might avenge them.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2010g_00300_02090_1: \n\nOnce his revenge was complete, he was forced to face an empty truth::<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2020g_00100_02090_1: Those he believed were his parents were actually not.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2020g_00200_02090_1: \nThey were merely a couple attempting to raise a kidnapped child into the perfect soldier.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2020g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe person he killed to avenge his parents was his true father.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2030g_00100_02090_1: On that day, he found his resolve.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2030g_00200_02090_1: \n\nHe would seek out and kill the man who devised the Infant Abduction Strategy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2030g_00300_02090_1: \nThe top-secret military operation that had ruined his life.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2030g_00400_02090_1: \n\nSo he gathered people who harbored the same resentment, a group that grew more powerful by the day.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2040g_00100_02090_1: They made their headquarters in a corner of a destitute area, acting as a kind of vigilante group in the region.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2040g_00200_02090_1: \nViolence had once been a staple of life in the area, but since the young man and his group arrived, it had grown safe enough for children to play outdoors.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2050g_00100_02090_1: A symphony of gunshots and heavy bootheels fills the air.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2050g_00200_02090_1: \nThe young man's compatriots fall in a hail of bullets, their bodies trampled without mercy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2050g_00300_02090_1: \nInnocent villagers are caught in the crossfire.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2060g_00100_02090_1: The group has attacked so many labor camps that the enemy army was finally able to locate their headquarters.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2060g_00200_02090_1: \n\nAs the young man shouts orders in an attempt to repel the siege, the gears in his head continue to turn.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2060g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe enemy had marched right into their stronghold without activating any traps or setting off even a single alarm.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2070g_00100_02090_1: Even the best-trained soldiers could not accomplish such a feat.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2070g_00200_02090_1: \nIt's as if they knew exactly where to step.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2070g_00300_02090_1: \n\nIs it possible? Could someone on the inside be providing them intelligence?:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2070g_00400_02090_1: \n\nAs doubt scrambles for purchase in the young man's heart, he shakes his head. Everyone on his side fights for the same objective; none would ever do such a thing.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2080g_00100_02090_1: He shouts another order and draws his sword. As he does, the freckled man rushes to his side.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2080g_00200_02090_1: \n\n"I'll hold them off," he says. "Take any who can still fight and get out of here.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_2080g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe young man opens his mouth, thinking to reject the man's proposed course of action.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2080g_00400_02090_1: \nBut he falters under the man's straightforward gaze.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2090g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHis eyes bear down on the young man with determination and confidence.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2090g_00400_02090_1: \nHe will entrust all that is left to him so he might accomplish their mission: revenge on those who ruined their lives with the Infant Abduction Strategy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2100g_00100_02090_1: He could not find it in his heart to betray the resolve of his compatriots.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2100g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThat is the answer the young man arrived at.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2100g_00300_02090_1: \nHe takes any who can still move and escapes the burning stronghold.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2110g_00100_02090_1: Dawn is still a distant dream.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2110g_00200_02090_1: \nThe remaining dozen or so fighters sit together in a remote ruin and speak of what is to come.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2120g_00100_02090_1: They have somehow evaded any pursuers along the way.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2120g_00200_02090_1: \nBut the army knows the direction in which they took flight, so they cannot escape them for long.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2120g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAnd yet, the young man can't let the responsibility he has been entrusted with go to waste.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2130g_00100_02090_1: "We need to kill the man in charge of the Infant Abduction Strategy before we're found. Only then will our revenge be complete.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_2130g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThey know their target is stationed in a domestic military facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2130g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe young man produces a sketched set of facility blueprints they obtained for just this moment, then begins laying our their plan in a hoarse voice.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2140g_00100_02090_1: The remaining dozen or so fighters will infiltrate the facility and kill key military personnel.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2140g_00300_02090_1: \n\nBut if they are going to be tracked down and cornered anyway, fighting is a better option than running.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2140g_00400_02090_1: \nOr at least, that's how the young man sees it.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2150g_00100_02090_1: "I'm not asking you to come with me," he continues. "I want as many of you to survive as—":<TAP>
LID_a02090_2150g_00300_02090_1: \n\nWho interrupts, other than the black-haired boy? The one who acts of his own accord; the one who has caused the young man no end of grief.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2160g_00100_02090_1: "I didn't stick with you all this time to survive," says the boy. "I did it for revenge.":
LID_a02090_2160g_00200_02090_1: \n\nWhen he speaks, the rest nod in determination before raising their voices in support of the plan.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2160g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAnd though the young man has nowhere left to turn, he at least has his comrades.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2170g_00100_02090_1: Dawn breaks. Faint light flickers in through rural foliage.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2170g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe silver-haired young man and black-haired boy patrol the area around the ruins in which they hide.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2170g_00300_02090_1: \n\nSuddenly, the boy comes to a halt, staring up at the vanishing stars.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2170g_00400_02090_1: \nThe gruff air he typically carries has faded into the shadows.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2180g_00100_02090_1: "If we fail, we'll die," he murmurs.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2180g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe boy levels his gaze on the young man.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2180g_00500_02090_1: \n\n"I've always wondered that: How am I supposed to live once I have my revenge?":<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2190g_00100_02090_1: The young man has no answer.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2190g_00200_02090_1: \n\nAt first, he lived to exact revenge on the foreign soldier who killed his parents, only to learn the man was actually his real father.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2190g_00300_02090_1: \n\nSince that day, he has lived for revenge on those who kidnapped him as a part of the Infant Abduction Strategy. That thought alone carries him through the endless days of fighting.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2190g_00400_02090_1: \n\nNow that he thinks about it, vengeance has been his entire reason for living.:
LID_a02090_2190g_00500_02090_1: \nHe has forgotten what it is like to live without it.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2200g_00100_02090_1: "We'll figure it out once it's over," says the young man finally. "Until then, we just need to survive.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_2200g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe black-haired boy gives a sad smile unlike his typical brusque self.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2210g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe young man returns from patrol and falls into his bunk. When he wakes up, he finds the boy gone.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2220g_00100_02090_1: All that remains are his belongings.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2220g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThey search his bag and find a single piece of paper. Written on it is the day's temperature and weather, as well as a description of the townsfolk.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2220g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe boy's comrades tilt their head at the nonsensical letter. Why has he left this?:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2230g_00100_02090_1: It is terribly similar to one the military uses, which means they cannot decipher it without a matching decoder.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2230g_00200_02090_1: \n\nBut the question the young man had is now solved.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2230g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe army had known exactly what to expect when they attacked, and that was most certainly due to...:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_2240g_00100_02090_1: The young man decides to accept his betrayal.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2240g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHe remembers how sad the boy's smile was at dawn.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_2240g_00400_02090_1: \nThe image is seared into his mind. He will never forget it.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3010g_00100_02090_1: The young man wades through waist-deep water along with a dozen or so of his compatriots.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3010g_00200_02090_1: \n\nIn the dead of night, they are making their way through a sewer.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3010g_00300_02090_1: \nIt connects to a canal that surrounds the military facility, and is the optimal path for sneaking in while avoiding detection.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3020g_00100_02090_1: Their destination is the facility's control room.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3020g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe man responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy—the program that took them from their homelands and ruined their lives—should be waiting there.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3020g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThey will kill him, and in doing so have their revenge.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3030g_00100_02090_1: The sewers are silent, save for the occasional ripple of disturbed water.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3030g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe enemy does not seem to know they are there.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3030g_00300_02090_1: \nBut they all know that is likely not the case, and so proceed with the utmost caution.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3040g_00100_02090_1: The black-haired boy always acted on his own accord.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3040g_00200_02090_1: \n\nHe left proof he had been working with the enemy before vanishing from the group.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3040g_00300_02090_1: \n\nBut before he did so, they informed him of their plan to infiltrate the facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3040g_00400_02090_1: \nThough the young man changed the date, time, and route of the operation, it is likely the black-haired boy told the army enough for them to be on alert.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3040g_00500_02090_1: \n\nThis will doubtless be the most difficult of fights.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3050g_00100_02090_1: At last, they arrive at a ladder leading to the surface.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3050g_00200_02090_1: \nThe young man turns to his allies and speaks in a heavy tone.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3050g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHe tells them there is one thing he has to do before killing the person responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3050g_00400_02090_1: \n\nHe must find the boy who vanished after leaving proof of his betrayal and ask him why.:
LID_a02090_3060g_00200_02090_1: \n"If he really was communicating with the enemy, he wouldn’t have left proof for us to find.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_3060g_00300_02090_1: \n\n"I saw in his eyes how much he hated our enemy. None of that was false.":<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3070g_00100_02090_1: Even now, he trusts the black-haired boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3070g_00200_02090_1: \nFor he is just as reckless as the young man used to be.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3070g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe young man knows his request to find the boy is selfish; they don't even know if he is in the facility at all.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3070g_00400_02090_1: \n\n"Anyway, I won't ask any of you come with me," concludes the young man as he casts his gaze downward.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3080g_00100_02090_1: The rest of his group chuckles.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3080g_00200_02090_1: \n"We've always known how selfish you are, yet we chose to stick by your side.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3080g_00300_02090_1: \n\nWe burn with the same need for revenge as you, yet we also know the boy wouldn't betray us without some reason.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_3090g_00100_02090_1: While the need for revenge may be the warped strand that keeps their group together, they also have a firm bond of trust.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3090g_00300_02090_1: \n\nTogether, they climb the ladder and move into the base.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3100g_00100_02090_1: The group had steeled themselves for a battle against uncountable enemy soldiers, but security is unnaturally lax.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3100g_00200_02090_1: \n\n"They'll be here any second! Send out the patrols and ready for a counterattack!":<TAP>
LID_a02090_3100g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHearing enemy soldiers yelling orders, the group freezes in place and attempts to get a better idea of what is happening. But...:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3100g_00500_02090_1: \n\nThe guard's voice suddenly cuts off of amidst a burst of gunfire.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3100g_00600_02090_1: \nThe group has no idea what is happening, which makes the situation all the more dangerous. Yet they have no choice but to take advantage of the chaos and act.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3100g_00700_02090_1: \n\nThey carve a path with blade and bullet, proceeding through the base in search of the black-haired boy.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3110g_00100_02090_1: Their destination is the control room, where the young man feels certain he will be found.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3110g_00200_02090_1: \n\nHis trust in the boy has not wavered; not even when presented with proof of his betrayal.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3110g_00300_02090_1: \nHis heart is bound not by logic, but by faith, and it now tells him where to go.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3120g_00200_02090_1: \nAs the group nears the control room, their eyes widen at the terrible sight before them.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3120g_00300_02090_1: \n\nBodies of dead soldiers lie scattered across the quiet hallway. Bullet holes scar the walls around them.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3120g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe young man has an awful feeling in his gut. His heart pounds in his ears.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3120g_00500_02090_1: \nHe takes a moment to calm his breathing, then begins to follow the trail of blood.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3130g_00200_02090_1: \nNot a single guard stands watch outside the control room—the place where the man responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy should be.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3130g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAt a wordless signal from the young man, his companions batter down the door.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3140g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe room is silent. There is no sign of the enemy leader they are looking for.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3140g_00300_02090_1: \n\nInstead, there is someone else lying on the floor.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3140g_00400_02090_1: \n\nHis black hair is matted with blood. Breath rattles in his chest as life slowly abandons him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3150g_00200_02090_1: \n\nAs one, the group breaks into a dash and rushes over to the boy.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3160g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe corner of the boy's mouth, thick with blood, quirks upward in a half-smile.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3160g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe young man crouches down and tells him not to speak. As he inspects his wounds, his mind whirls, wondering if there is a way to save him.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3160g_00400_02090_1: \nBut his body is riddled with bullets; everyone can see his time is nearly gone.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3160g_00500_02090_1: \n\nThe boy croaks out a hoarse voice, apologizing for his actions before attempting to explain.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3170g_00100_02090_1: The enemy had approached him, offering to put him in contact with his real parents if he turned traitor.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3170g_00200_02090_1: \n\nBut when the army invaded the destitute district and began slaughtering people indiscriminately, he immediately regretted his decision.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3170g_00300_02090_1: \n\nSo he turned his coat again, using his position as their mole to infiltrate the facility and kill the man responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy. It...did not go well.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3180g_00100_02090_1: As the young man listens to this tale of regret, a thought comes to him::<TAP>
LID_a02090_3180g_00200_02090_1: \n\nPerhaps they should not forgive the boy for divulging information to the enemy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3180g_00400_02090_1: \n\nWould he have done differently in his place? The young man is not so sure.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3180g_00500_02090_1: \n\nCan he blame the boy for being led astray because of a desire to find happiness with his family?:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3190g_00100_02090_1: "It's fine," says the young man. "Don't worry. I'll finish the job.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_3190g_00300_02090_1: \n\nA melancholy smile spreads across the black-haired boy's face.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3190g_00400_02090_1: \n\n"You can tell me what comes after revenge...":<PAGE>
LID_a02090_3200g_00100_02090_1: His words stop. He lies still.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3200g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe young man watches as his life ends, then quietly gets to his feet.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3200g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThey must keep going. Vengeance will not wait.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_3200g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe boy has killed the guards and plunged the facility into chaos.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4010g_00100_02090_1: The black-haired boy infiltrated the military facility as a mole.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4010g_00200_02090_1: \nBut after pretending to serve them, he bore his fangs and killed countless guards, causing chaos to descend upon the facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4010g_00400_02090_1: \nHis compatriots and allies followed the path he carved and successfully reached the core of the facility.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4020g_00100_02090_1: Now, they continue searching for the man responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4020g_00200_02090_1: \n\nAn inhumane project wherein the country kidnaps children from neighboring lands to raise as either soldiers or laborers.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4020g_00300_02090_1: \nThe boy and his companions are victims of this operation, and their goal is to kill this man and get their revenge.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4030g_00200_02090_1: \n\nAt the gate behind the facility, several shadowy figures mill about in the dark.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4030g_00300_02090_1: \n\n"Why aren't the damned reinforcements here yet!?":<TAP>
LID_a02090_4030g_00400_02090_1: \n\nThe man who cursed wears a uniform decorated with several medals.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4030g_00500_02090_1: \nHe is the person responsible for the Infant Abduction Strategy, and he now runs a nervous hand through his long beard.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4040g_00100_02090_1: Unable to hide his irritation in the face of his guards' failure, he is resorting to chewing out his subordinates.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4040g_00200_02090_1: \n\n"The reinforcements will be here in less than ten minutes, sir," one of his personal retinue tells him.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4040g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHe gestures to a waiting car, inviting the man inside.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4040g_00400_02090_1: \nThey will ferry him away to a safe place until the commotion dies down.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4050g_00200_02090_1: \nBullets pierce the guards' heads, sending blood flying.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4050g_00300_02090_1: \n\nThe man realizes what is going on, but by the time he attempts to make his escape, it is far too late.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4050g_00400_02090_1: \nThe thin blade of a rapier suddenly pierces his neck from behind, its steel shimmering in the pale light of night.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4060g_00100_02090_1: The man feels cold spreading across his body, as well as fear of his upcoming demise.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4060g_00200_02090_1: \nSuddenly, the voice of a young man whispers low in his ear::<TAP>
LID_a02090_4060g_00300_02090_1: \n\n"You have no right to mourn your death; my friends all faced more gruesome ends because of you.":<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4070g_00100_02090_1: He then begins to speak of all of the lives he's seen ruined because of the Infant Abduction Strategy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4070g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe children who grew into soldiers, forever ignorant of their pasts.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4070g_00300_02090_1: \nThose children locked in dark, cramped rooms and forced to labor until their last breath.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4070g_00400_02090_1: \nAnd those who learned of the top-secret operation and met their ends as a result.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4080g_00100_02090_1: As the boy quakes with fury, the man attempts to articulate an apology.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4080g_00300_02090_1: \n"Not to me. Apologize to the dead.":<TAP>
LID_a02090_4080g_00400_02090_1: \n\nAnd with that, the man's light goes out forever.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4090g_00100_02090_1: The young man has found his revenge, but in so doing has lost his path home.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4090g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThe rest of his allies had volunteered to hold off the enemy and catch up later, granting the young man a path to vengeance.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4090g_00300_02090_1: \n\nBut none of them have arrived. Instead, all that follows the young man as he flees are reinforcements sent by the military.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4100g_00100_02090_1: Several hours have passed since he escaped the facility. The sky lightens, the sun gradually starting to show its face.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4100g_00200_02090_1: \n\nThough the young man hid every time he encountered the enemy, he has taken numerous bullets, and his body now nears its end.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4110g_00100_02090_1: He rests on his knees, alone in the shade of a building. The blood that flees his body reddens the ground as it greets the dawn.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4110g_00200_02090_1: \n\nAs the young man sits beneath the rising sun, he feels his consciousness fade.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4110g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAnd yet, he does not mind such an end.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4140g_00100_02090_1: There comes a voice from the darkness.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4140g_00200_02090_1: \nIt is an old voice, one he heard many times in the past, and one that comes with many memories.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4140g_00400_02090_1: \nThough he cannot move and his vision is clouding, he still lives.:
LID_a02090_4150g_00100_02090_1: Off in the distance, he sees a small light.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4150g_00400_02090_1: \n\nHis parents: the ones who raised him, despite being part of a plot.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4150g_00500_02090_1: \nHis real father: the one he killed with his own hands.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4150g_00600_02090_1: \nHis real mother: the one who brought him into this world.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4150g_00700_02090_1: \nHis squadmates: the ones for whom he caused so much trouble, yet who forgave him all the same.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4150g_00800_02090_1: \nHis compatriots: the ones who believed in him and led him to this point.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4160g_00100_02090_1: It is then that he remembers.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4160g_00300_02090_1: \n\nHis allies had risked their lives to ensure his survival.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4160g_00500_02090_1: \nThey have entrusted so much to his care, and he has somehow survived this long.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4170g_00100_02090_1: Maybe one day, you can tell me what comes after revenge...:
LID_a02090_4170g_00200_02090_1: \n\nHe must fulfill his promise to the black-haired boy.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4200g_00100_02090_1: Earlier this summer, fifteen boys launched a revolt against a military facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4200g_00200_02090_1: \n\nTheir objective was to kill the man behind the Infant Abduction Strategy.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4200g_00300_02090_1: \nAnd while they accomplished their objective, reports claim they paid for it with their lives.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4210g_00100_02090_1: The Infant Abduction Strategy was the military's best-kept secret—its existence unknown to all but a few in power—and they attempted to clean it up in secret.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4210g_00200_02090_1: \n\nHowever, one soldier blew the whistle on the inhumane methods of the operation, and was quickly labeled a hero.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4210g_00300_02090_1: \n\nAs a result, the vice-like grip the military once held over the government is now in decline.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4220g_00200_02090_1: \n\nA lonely young man walks atop an abandoned railroad, flanked on either side by rows of sunflowers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4230g_00100_02090_1: His body is scarred with signs of battle; he had once been so consumed by vengeance that he became a soldier.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4230g_00200_02090_1: \nHe is the one who led the revolt.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4230g_00300_02090_1: \n\nReports claim all the children involved in the incident had perished.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4230g_00400_02090_1: \nBut he alone had been saved by a hero. He alone survived.:<PAGE>
LID_a02090_4240g_00100_02090_1: He walks along the old railroad.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4240g_00200_02090_1: \nHe walks by himself, no blade or pistol at his hip, in search of what comes after revenge.:<TAP>
LID_a02090_4240g_00500_02090_1: \nA cool breeze dances among the flowers.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1010g_00100_02100_1: A desolate landscape stretches in all directions.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1010g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe poppies that covered the field only a few days ago were all burnt to ash, and the butterflies that extolled the beauty of spring are now dead.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1010g_00300_02100_1: \nThe flowers are dead. The butterflies are dead. The only survivors are soldiers and rats, but they, too, are slowly dying.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1020g_00100_02100_1: The young man's squad is completely surrounded. Neither retreat nor surrender are permissible in this situation.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1020g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThis prolonged war has exhausted the army. They knew from the start that the enemy had the overwhelming advantage in terms of resources.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1020g_00300_02100_1: \n\nDespite it all, the man has maintained battle lines, but it seems he's reached a limit from which there is no escape.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1020g_00400_02100_1: \n\nArtillery bursts in the air. The nighttime battlefield is awash in light.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1020g_00500_02100_1: \nGouges dot the earth. Mud, guns and swords, blood and bones, and screaming soldiers...:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1030g_00100_02100_1: The battlefield exists between the boundaries of life and death. Bullets whiz overhead. The young man hides behind a barricade as he takes aim at his enemy, his finger resting on the trigger, focusing.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1030g_00200_02100_1: \n\nHow can he overcome the disparity in resources and win this fight? Ultimately, as captain, how can he protect his squad?:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1030g_00300_02100_1: \n\nBut the nightmares that constantly replay in his mind hinder his thinking.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1040g_00100_02100_1: They are memories of when he first joined the army. His own selfish actions in battle led to the death of his entire squad.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1040g_00200_02100_1: \n\nHe recalls walking among the bodies of his compatriots, crying. He recalls the smell of burning flesh, the sensation of entrails sticking to his soles.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1040g_00300_02100_1: \n\nTo this day, he thinks of that hell every time he loses a soldier.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1050g_00100_02100_1: At this rate, isn't everyone's death inevitable? Just like it was back then?:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1050g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe worst-case scenario plays in his mind. He shakes his head. He cannot let the past drag him down, not right now.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1050g_00300_02100_1: \nHe digs his nails into his temples. The pain forces the guilt and fear to leave his body.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1050g_00400_02100_1: \nHe must do this. Otherwise, he very well may lose his mind.:
LID_a02100_1060g_00100_02100_1: \n\nThe battle grows ever more intense, and still, he cannot find an effective way forward.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1060g_00200_02100_1: It's then that a man wearing an eyepatch appears before him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1060g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe man with the eyepatch grins widely and points his gun at the young man's chest. But before the young man can react, the other man has already pulled the trigger.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1070g_00200_02100_1: \nA red flower made of cloth bursts from the gun's barrel.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1070g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe young man's eyes go wide. The eyepatch man gives a light chuckle.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1070g_00400_02100_1: \n\nYou look like hell. Ain't every day I see you like that.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1070g_00500_02100_1: \n\nThe young man heaves a sigh of both exasperation and relief.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1070g_00510_02100_1: \n\nThe easygoing eyepatch man is an ally in the same army. Much like the young man, he commands his own squad.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1080g_00100_02100_1: That he's here means he's finally met with the reinforcements.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1080g_00200_02100_1: \n\nDon't you worry. Now that we're together, we'll make it outta here alive.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1080g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe young man nods at his encouraging words. And to himself, he makes a vow.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1080g_00400_02100_1: \nHe will not allow his compatriots to die. Not like last time.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1090g_00100_02100_1: The eyepatch man commands his squad to move to the front. Timing a precise opportunity for them, he orders a hail of gunfire.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1090g_00200_02100_1: \nLike a magic trick, smoke and flame bloom to hide him and his allies. The young man takes advantage of the situation to command his own squad to press forward and eliminate the enemy.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1090g_00300_02100_1: \n\nDespite the strife of the battlefield, the eyepatch man remains calm and easygoing. Though his countenance is more akin to a court jester than a soldier, the young man trusts him all the same.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1100g_00100_02100_1: He boldly cuts his way into the enemy camp, but his eye focuses more on his own squad than on his enemies.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1100g_00200_02100_1: \n\nHe rallies the frightened soldiers, keeping tabs on the situation and avoiding any unnecessarily harsh orders. Now and then, he volunteers to venture into danger personally.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1100g_00300_02100_1: \n\nNo matter how brutal the battle, he never forgets the care he holds for his soldiers. In that regard, he's quite similar to the young man.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1110g_00100_02100_1: \nThe two captains press forward with squads in tow.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1110g_00200_02100_1: But the enemy has an overwhelming material advantage.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1110g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThey attack from behind, attempting to occupy the rear.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1120g_00100_02100_1: One can scarcely hear over the raging battle's deafening crescendo. Their lines of communication fall, and the squad descends into chaos.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1120g_00200_02100_1: \nStill, the young man and his soldiers fight back in the face of certain death.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1120g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThey shoot, stab, and pummel every enemy that comes into view. Stopping is not an option. They must get through this and send everyone home alive. They must reorganize their strategy, no matter what it takes.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_1130g_00100_02100_1: Night approaches. A flare overhead shines like a firework.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1130g_00200_02100_1: \nIn the red light that bathes the field, the young man spots an artillery shell headed directly for them.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_1130g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe nightmares of battle, the fear of killing enemies, the guilt of dying allies—it all heralds the end.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2010g_00100_02100_1: Red sky. Bloody footprints. A hellish battlefield.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2010g_00200_02100_1: \nThe young man huddles on the ground, arms covering his head, his dead compatriots standing around him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2010g_00300_02100_1: \n\nIt's the recurring nightmare that slowly consumes him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2020g_00100_02100_1: Some of the dead are squadmates who perished due to his selfish actions long ago. Others are soldiers who die due to his powerless now.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2020g_00150_02100_1: \nWith glares of hatred, they point their guns at him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2020g_00300_02100_1: \nWe'd have been better off without you.:
LID_a02100_2020g_00400_02100_1: \n\nThey batter him with curses, and in unison, they pull their triggers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2040g_00100_02100_1: Along with the bullets that riddle his body in the dream comes a sweet sensation...and then he awakens.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2040g_00200_02100_1: \nThe peculiar ecstasy mixes with the discomfort of his soaked clothes.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2040g_00400_02100_1: \n\nHe suppresses his urge to vomit as he sits up in his hard bed.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2050g_00100_02100_1: It's barely dawn. The room is dim. He can hear the pitter-patter of rats scurrying about the room.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2050g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe enemy's detention house is dark. He and his soldiers are prisoners—they sleep on a row of beds, a dozen or so.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2050g_00400_02100_1: \nThe young man sits atop the bed in a corner.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2060g_00100_02100_1: A few days prior, he and his squad found themselves between a rock and a hard place. The eyepatch man and his squad arrived as reinforcements.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2060g_00200_02100_1: \n\nTogether, their strategy afforded them a brief advantage. But once enemy reinforcements arrived, the battle became a deadlock.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2060g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAs the carnage grew, the chain of command began to collapse. Amidst the concentrated fire, the young man lost consciousness.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2060g_00400_02100_1: \nIn spite of the looming death, his wounds were not serious. And in spite of everything, when he awoke, he found himself a prisoner in this detention camp.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2070g_00100_02100_1: That must've been one hell of a dream.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2070g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThere came a voice from the bed beside him. The eyepatch man smiles as he regards the young man.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2070g_00300_02100_1: \n\nHe and several of his own soldiers have been captured as well.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2070g_00400_02100_1: \n\nBut the young man does not know what transpired on the battlefield nor the status of his soldiers.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2070g_00500_02100_1: \nAnd, of course, there's no guarantee anyone will leave this terrible place alive.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2080g_00100_02100_1: The thought of his fellows dying sends a shiver down the young man's spine.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2080g_00200_02100_1: \n\nHe digs his nails into his skin—the sensation of pain may be the only thing that allows him to maintain his sanity.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2080g_00300_02100_1: \n\nBut the eyepatch man grasps the young man by the arm to stop him. He sits beside him and peers into his face.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2090g_00100_02100_1: C'mon, buddy. I'm asking you what's the matter.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2090g_00200_02100_1: \n\nHis voice inspired his soldiers countless times in that catastrophic battle. Hearing it for himself, the young man feels a bit calmer.:<TAP>
