LID_a02100_2090g_00300_02100_1: \n\nIn my dream, my soldiers killed me.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2090g_00500_02100_1: \nHis voice is hoarse, and quiet so he doesn't wake the other soldiers. Quiet so only the eyepatch man hears him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2090g_00600_02100_1: Long ago, my actions led to my entire squad dying. Ever since, I struggle to keep myself composed when I lose a soldier...:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2100g_00100_02100_1: \n\nHe wanted to take his terrible past to the grave. But considering how the eyepatch man seemed to care genuinely about the lives of his soldiers, perhaps he would understand.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2100g_00200_02100_1: \nThe young man feels as though he has nothing to lose.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2100g_00300_02100_1: Believe me, I know the feeling.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2100g_00400_02100_1: \n\nHis one bright blue eye sparkling, he tells the young man his story. He, too, lost most of his comrades in battle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2110g_00100_02100_1: He's heard their voices ever since.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2110g_00200_02100_1: \nTheir voices as they burned in the fires of battle.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2110g_00300_02100_1: \nHe had promised that they'd survive together, but before he knew it, he stood alone amidst their corpses.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2110g_00400_02100_1: \nThere's loathing in his voice for how carefree he lives now.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2110g_00500_02100_1: \nBe it the past, the present, or the future, no matter where he goes, that's all there is.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2120g_00100_02100_1: Despite his grim words, the smile on his face is as cheerful as ever.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2120g_00200_02100_1: \nBut the young man realizes that the eyepatch is every bit as stained by guilt as he is.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2120g_00300_02100_1: \n\nSilence settles between them for a time.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2120g_00400_02100_1: \nEvery now and then, airplanes pass overhead like distant thunder, rattling the windows. Shells whistle through the air like burnt-out stars, and the glow of fire illuminates the room.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2130g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAt length, the eyepatch man speaks. The shocked young man turns to him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2130g_00400_02100_1: \nThe corners of his mouth turn upward slightly, and he pats the young man's shoulder. "Kidding, of course.":<TAP>
LID_a02100_2130g_00500_02100_1: \n\nWe'll survive and get everyone outta here. You don't wanna lose any more soldiers, right?:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2140g_00100_02100_1: Right, the young man tells himself.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2140g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThey're without rations or doctors in this filthy, inhumane place where they make even the injured and sick work. To sit here idly would be tantamount to killing his own soldiers.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2140g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThey must put together a plan of escape, and soon.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2150g_00100_02100_1: The first light of dawn glows beyond the window.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2150g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe eyepatch man gazes at the distant gunfire and begins to him. It's a song that everyone from their country knows.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2150g_00400_02100_1: \nThough not all belong to the same squad, they all share a home.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_2150g_00500_02100_1: \n\nOne by one, they join in the humming, and before long, everyone in the room is singing.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_2160g_00100_02100_1: The guards shout as they rush in to stop them, but prisoners continue to sing. The eyepatch man sings even louder in encouragement.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3010g_00100_02100_1: The young man was trapped in a bombardment. Along with the eyepatch man, who serves as a captain as well, and a dozen or so of their soldiers, he was detained in a camp.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3010g_00200_02100_1: \n\nIt's difficult to retain one's humanity in an environment like this. The young man's spirit wavers, but the eyepatch man inspires him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3010g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe young man, his soldiers, and all the others still hold fast to the hope that they will see home again.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3020g_00100_02100_1: Beside the detention camp is a barracks, demarcated with barbed wire.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3020g_00200_02100_1: \nThe soldiers stationed there occasionally come to the camp when they have free time.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3020g_00300_02100_1: \n\nWhat they come to do is, essentially, trade with the captives. In exchange for stale bread, they receive things from the starving prisoners they might deem useful.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3020g_00400_02100_1: \nThe prisoners have very little, but a handful of them possess things that are worth more than bread to the soldiers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3030g_00100_02100_1: Today, a soldier visits the detention camp.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3030g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe blond young man and the eyepatch man hand over their pocket watches and demand more bread than usual—their sickly fellows need all the nutrients they can get.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3030g_00300_02100_1: \n\nTheir earnest gazes grieve for their comrades. Taking pity on them, the soldier accepts the watches and brings them bread, as promised.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3040g_00100_02100_1: The two men give their gratitude for the soldier's kindness. And then, the three of them begin walking around the facility and engaging in idle chatter.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3040g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe soldier speaks with the unarmed, starving prisoners. He regards them with caution at first.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3040g_00300_02100_1: \n\nBut he finds the eyepatch man particularly fascinating, and before he realizes it, he's let his guard down.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3040g_00400_02100_1: \nHe's been led down an empty corridor, a blind spot in the guards' watch.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3050g_00100_02100_1: The young man whirls to punch the soldier.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3050g_00200_02100_1: \nThe sudden attack sends the soldier to the ground. He reaches to pull a knife from his boot, but the young man straddles him, depriving him of movement.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3050g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe soldier attempts to yell for help, but hands quickly clamp around his throat. The young man then grabs the knife and stabs him repeatedly until his life is extinguished.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3070g_00100_02100_1: I've done a terrible thing, the young man thinks as he looks over the soldier's corpse.:
LID_a02100_3070g_00200_02100_1: \nAn enemy though he was, the last thing the young man wanted was to take a life outside of the battlefield.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3070g_00300_02100_1: \n\nBut this is the day they've been waiting for—when the enemy soldier with the storehouse key visits the camp.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3070g_00400_02100_1: All of their confiscated items are being held in storage, including their weapons, according to one prisoner.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3070g_00500_02100_1: \nThey will arm themselves there. They must.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3070g_00600_02100_1: \n\nThe young man searches the soldier's clothes for the key and finds it. He exchanges glances with the eyepatch man, and they nod in confirmation.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3080g_00100_02100_1: If they remain here like they're supposed to, they'll never be able to send their soldiers home alive.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3080g_00200_02100_1: \nThat is the conclusion they came to. And so, they have opted to take action.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3080g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe young man has his soldiers, and several other P.O.W.s have been interned here before them.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3080g_00400_02100_1: \n\nIf they all work together, they might just make it out. The two captains take their chances, putting everything on the line.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3090g_00100_02100_1: The young man takes the keys and a gun from the soldier. The bullets tear through the guards who watch the storehouse.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3090g_00200_02100_1: \nAnd on the eyepatch man's signal, their fellow soldiers rush into the armory.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3090g_00300_02100_1: \nThey take their guns and begin readying themselves for an uprising.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3090g_00400_02100_1: \n\nBut the guards respond to the commotion much faster than the young man anticipated.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3100g_00100_02100_1: A hail of bullets flies toward the storehouse. They duck for cover with little opportunity to poke their heads out.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3100g_00400_02100_1: \n\nThe eyepatch man asks the young man, who nods in response.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3100g_00500_02100_1: \nThe two step forward, pistols at the ready.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3110g_00100_02100_1: They pay little heed to the bullets that graze their skin and dig holes into the earth beside them.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3110g_00200_02100_1: \nThey pull their triggers and kill their enemies, risking their lives to save their allies.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3110g_00300_02100_1: \n\nIf they can't manage that much, they have no right to live.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3110g_00400_02100_1: \n\nThe eyepatch man has made the same resolve, the young man believes. He, too, lost many of his squadmates in battle. Theirs is a shared past.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3120g_00100_02100_1: His deadly bullets tear through the enemy's heads, faces, necks, hearts. He shoots their hands carrying their guns, their fleeing legs, their sobbing eyes, their screaming mouths.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3130g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThe eyepatch man asks the young man.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3130g_00300_02100_1: \nThere's no way I'm smiling, he thinks to himself, but curiosity gets the better of him, and he brings his hand to his face.:
LID_a02100_3130g_00400_02100_1: \nAnd for the first time, he realizes he is indeed smiling.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3140g_00100_02100_1: It's nothing to worry about, the eyepatch man says.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3140g_00200_02100_1: \nYou killed the enemy to save your soldiers. That's every reason to smile, he says.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3140g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAnd so he, too, does the same—shoots an enemy soldier, then smiles. Their smiles look much the same, both hiding the fear that they may lose one of their own.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3150g_00100_02100_1: Then, they hurl grenades at the enemy and rush them.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3150g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThey pull their triggers without mercy, quickly turning the soldiers on the opposite side into corpses. The two captains' silhouettes flicker in the hellfire.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3150g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe men who were mere prisoners only moments ago are now raging demons in the eyes of the enemy soldiers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3160g_00100_02100_1: They make their escape from the storehouse. From there, prisoners from other countries join in the uprising.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3160g_00200_02100_1: \nThey foresee victory in the young man's actions and declare their cooperation.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3160g_00300_02100_1: \n\nPressing forward, they take weapons from the dead soldiers.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3160g_00350_02100_1: \nAnd at the end of the prolonged firefight, they manage to take control of the armory in the barracks.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3170g_00200_02100_1: \nAll that remains in the silent battlefield are the charred remains of the barracks and the detention camp. The only survivors: the young man and his allies.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3170g_00300_02100_1: \n\nTogether, they cheer and share in their joy, but the young man cautions them—they should leave before pursuers arrive.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3180g_00100_02100_1: But when he realizes all of his squad has survived, the tension in his body melts away.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3180g_00200_02100_1: \nPain previously suppressed by adrenaline now bubbles to the surface. Only now does he realize he's suffered a gunshot wound to his leg.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3190g_00100_02100_1: He is but a breath from collapse, but the eyepatch man keeps him up.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3190g_00200_02100_1: \nThe young man gives his thanks and the older man murmurs.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3190g_00300_02100_1: \n\nMaybe our nightmares are a thing of the past now...:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_3200g_00100_02100_1: The young man gives a nod.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3200g_00200_02100_1: \nWith the battle won, he gets to hear the laughter of his soldiers—a sweeter sound he cannot imagine.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_3200g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAnd so, they set off on the road to home.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4010g_00100_02100_1: After getting caught up in a bombardment on the battlefield, the soldiers were captured and taken to a detention camp.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4010g_00200_02100_1: \nBut under the command of the two captains—the blond young man and the man with the eyepatch—they rose to action and made a successful escape.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4010g_00300_02100_1: \nThey celebrated their survival and safely returned to their home country.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4010g_00400_02100_1: \n\nThis all took place in late summer.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4020g_00100_02100_1: The young man reunites with the squadmates he parted ways with on the battlefield. They survived the brutal fight and returned home alive.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4020g_00200_02100_1: \n\nTheir survival is like a dream come true to the young man, and his relief is immeasurable.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4020g_00300_02100_1: \nHe had once led his entire squad to annihilation. But not this time.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4030g_00100_02100_1: Together with the eyepatch man, he receives a medal of honor and a promotion.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4030g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThey successfully carried out an operation that made up for the overwhelming resource disadvantage of the previous battle and freed the prisoners of war—successes held in high esteem.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4030g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThese are accolades completely unlike the ones he bitterly received in the past after the deaths of his squadmates. Rather, these were things he earned as a result of protecting his soldiers.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4040g_00100_02100_1: The two captains are showered with praise at the medal ceremony.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4050g_00100_02100_1: Bright rays of summer light beam through the windows of the lavish ceremony venue.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4050g_00200_02100_1: \nThis beautiful morning blesses their honor and the miracle operation. In his ceremonial garb, the admiration of onlookers is palpable to the young man.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4050g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAfter the ceremony, he leaves—there's somewhere he needs to go.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4060g_00100_02100_1: Somewhere that lies beyond the dark forest in the far corner of the city.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4060g_00200_02100_1: \nA place he's been so many times he can practically find his way there with his eyes closed.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4060g_00300_02100_1: \n\nIt's the military graveyard, the place where his fallen squadmates slumber.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4060g_00400_02100_1: \n\nStep by step, he makes his way toward the graves as if drawn by something.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4070g_00200_02100_1: \n\nA voice comes from behind him—the very same voice that soothed and inspired him time and again in the detention center.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4070g_00300_02100_1: \n\nHe turns around, and there he finds the eyepatch man, his friend in arms.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4070g_00400_02100_1: \nHis one eye, blue as the summer sky, stares straight at him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4080g_00200_02100_1: \n\nAnswer... The young man meditates on the word.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4090g_00200_02100_1: \n\nThey both lost so many squadmates due to their mistakes.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4090g_00300_02100_1: \nThey both vowed not to commit the same sin again. And so they proceeded to kill their enemies to protect their own.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4090g_00500_02100_1: \nEvery soldier they commanded in the previous battle returned home safely. Every ally held in the detention center successfully escaped.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4100g_00400_02100_1: \nThey now stand atop the path they dreamed to walk.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4110g_00100_02100_1: Reflected in the young man's eyes is not only the eyepatch man before him but the countless ghosts of his fallen men.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4110g_00200_02100_1: \n\nHe still hears them. He still hears their curses. He still hears them dragging him to the depths of hell.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4120g_00200_02100_1: \n\nNo matter how much they look after their allies, no matter how they risk their lives for them, the damage has already been done.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4120g_00300_02100_1: \nThe nightmares will never end. They have no destination.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4130g_00100_02100_1: Everything boils down to regret. Penitence. Guilt. Despair.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4130g_00200_02100_1: \nWhether they stand on a battlefield or in the light, that is all they have.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4130g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThe notion occurred to him the moment he was called a hero in the ceremony.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4140g_00100_02100_1: But you know how to escape this hell, don't you?:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4140g_00300_02100_1: \nHe steps toward the young man, his eye examining him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4140g_00400_02100_1: \n\nWhat you know, I know. And what I know, you know.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4150g_00100_02100_1: The young man stares silently back.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4150g_00200_02100_1: \nThe affection he has for the other man drains from him at once.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4150g_00300_02100_1: \n\nThis is a man who has saved him in battle countless times. They both risked their lives to save their allies.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4150g_00400_02100_1: \nThe warmth he felt in those moments is now completely absent.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4160g_00100_02100_1: But that, too, is a given, he realizes.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4160g_00200_02100_1: \n\nMuch in the way he cannot love himself, he bears no love for a man with the same sins as him.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4170g_00100_02100_1: But he is a special compatriot.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4170g_00200_02100_1: \nPerhaps he can grant him this wish just once.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4170g_00400_02100_1: \nThe young man knows exactly what he wants.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4180g_00100_02100_1: \nHe presses the barrel of his gun to the man's chest.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4180g_00200_02100_1: \nAnd without a moment's hesitation, he pulls the trigger.:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4190g_00100_02100_1: The summer sun bathes the man's corpse, lying among the blue flowers in golden light.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4190g_00200_02100_1: \nHis face glows. He slumbers like an innocent boy.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4190g_00300_02100_1: \n\nAs the young man looks down at him, he smiles in defeat.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4190g_00400_02100_1: \n\nDeath truly is their only salvation, isn't it?:<PAGE>
LID_a02100_4200g_00100_02100_1: He then brings his gun to his temple.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4200g_00200_02100_1: \nA sweet numbness coats the skin where the warm barrel presses against him.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4200g_00420_02100_1: \nA gentle breeze puffs over the horizon.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4200g_00430_02100_1: \nAnd in the distance, his squadmates laugh.:<TAP>
LID_a02100_4200g_00500_02100_1: \n\nThe young man bids farewell to a flickering past.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1010g_00200_02110_1: \n\nMy sister's voice is ever present in the depths of my mind.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1010g_00300_02110_1: \n\nHer voice is always there, no matter how hard the rain falls, no matter how much the waves crash or the wind howls.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1020g_00200_02110_1: \n\nA small shed stands in a small garden. A precious place where my elder sister once passed her time.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1020g_00400_02110_1: \n\nAnd so I go. That is her wish.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1030g_00100_02110_1: She cursed the world in her despair and departed this life.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1030g_00200_02110_1: \n\nI make this journey so that her wish may come true.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1050g_00200_02110_1: \n\nA motorcycle shines with a bright blue light. Like a shooting star, it soars across a road suspended over a desolate canyon.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1050g_00300_02110_1: \n\nIts rider is a girl with white hair. Her slender frame deftly steers the heavy vehicle as she tears across the landscape.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1060g_00100_02110_1: Dust from the headwind batters her eyes, yet she does not blink.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1060g_00300_02110_1: \n\nHumanity on this planet is extinct. All that roams the land is wildlife and puppets that take the form of humans.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1070g_00100_02110_1: Her gaze suddenly falls to her hands on the handlebars. Her emotionless eyes become clouded.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1070g_00300_02110_1: \n\nAre these hands truly under her control?:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1080g_00100_02110_1: Ever since she awoke at the research facility several months prior, her body has sometimes acted of its own volition, as if someone else was piloting her.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1080g_00200_02110_1: \n\nAt first, it only happened during her slumber, like an onset of sleepwalking.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1080g_00300_02110_1: \n\nBut gradually, even while awake, this phenomenon began encroaching on her consciousness.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1090g_00100_02110_1: She briefly returned to the facility to research her anomalies but ultimately found no effective remedies.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1090g_00200_02110_1: \n\nHer yield was not entirely fruitless, however.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1090g_00300_02110_1: \n\nIt was there in the underground hangar where she found the motorcycle, allowing her significantly faster travel.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1100g_00300_02110_1: \n\nA gunshot rings out. A bullet shatters the ground beside the front wheel of her motorcycle.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1100g_00400_02110_1: \nShe immediately accelerates. The bike's front wheel lifts upward, putting distance between her and where she believes the foe is hiding.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1110g_00100_02110_1: Her right hand lets go of the handle, and she draws the spear from her back just in time for several figures to leap from her blind spot.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1110g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThe assailants wear white battle uniforms, and all bear the same face with mechanical expressions.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1110g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThey are defense androids, released to protect the secrets of the facility where the girl was created.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1120g_00100_02110_1: When she returned to the facility to look into her anomaly, the androids suddenly activated.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1120g_00200_02110_1: \n\nTheir main purpose: to prevent research subjects from escaping the facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1120g_00300_02110_1: \n\nAll research subjects outside of the facility were disposed of without question. The straightforward programming of the androids was analogous to vengefulness.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1120g_00400_02110_1: \nThey would pursue the girl to the ends of the earth and annihilate her.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1130g_00100_02110_1: But no matter the obstacles she encountered, she would never falter.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1130g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThe girl and her sisters were created as living weapons. The first unit of their kind killed her sisters after losing control. She was their subject zero. Their original.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1130g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThe girl herself brought her down, yet the elder sister longed for the place in her memories.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1130g_00400_02110_1: \n\nShe is almost there. And she cannot stop until her journey is complete.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1140g_00100_02110_1: The androids run as swiftly as bullets, quickly closing in on the motorcycle. Her eyes dart left and right as she brandishes her spear in a one-handed feint.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1140g_00200_02110_1: \n\nShe monitors the situation. There are more than ten enemies, but escape is not an option.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1140g_00300_02110_1: \nThe elevated highway stretches into the horizon. Below her is a dark ravine.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1140g_00500_02110_1: \n\nShe has no choice but to fight.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1150g_00100_02110_1: The furious roar of the engine reverberates all around her. The wheels make sparks fly as they skid against the pavement. The scenery becomes a blur.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1150g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThe androids keep pace, brandishing their large machetes.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1150g_00300_02110_1: \nShe forcefully cants the bike to the side, stabbing back with her spear as though in a dance.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1160g_00100_02110_1: That's when her greatest fear becomes realized.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1160g_00200_02110_1: \n\nAs though no longer her own, her body stops listening to her commands.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1160g_00400_02110_1: \n\nIt's a phenomenon she knows far too well.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1160g_00500_02110_1: \nUnable to control her body, she clings to the handlebars with what little focus she has left.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1170g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThey blow out the front tire with a long-range shot, causing the bike to spin out of control.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1170g_00300_02110_1: \n\nShe will surely fall into the depths unless she intervenes, but she is powerless to steer.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1180g_00100_02110_1: The bike plows through the highway railing. She lets go of the handlebars and sails over the edge.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1180g_00200_02110_1: \n\nGirl and motorcycle both disappear into the bottom of the ravine.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1200g_00100_02110_1: The fall feels like an eternity. The girl's consciousness falters. Darkness surrounds her, and she can no longer discern dream from reality.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1210g_00100_02110_1: If only this were like the dreams I always have.:
LID_a02110_1210g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThen I'd use my wings and fly.:
LID_a02110_1210g_00300_02110_1: \n\nI'd never fall to the bottom of a ravine.:
LID_a02110_1220g_00200_02110_1: \n\nA gentle voice tickles her ear. It is a familiar voice—one omnipresent in the back of her mind.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1220g_00300_02110_1: \nIt is the voice she has been chasing the entire time.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1230g_00200_02110_1: \n\nWith voiceless words, she calls out. But she receives no answer.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1240g_00200_02110_1: \n\nA soft laugh, but tinged with darkness. In a trembling, fragile tone, it says to the girl,:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1250g_00100_02110_1: You know... You should destroy this world.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1260g_00100_02110_1: An impulse wells from within her—the sweet temptation of rampage and destruction.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1260g_00200_02110_1: \n\nShe feels her veins, her flesh, her bones melting away...:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1260g_00300_02110_1: \n\nIt's not unlike the process of a pupa she once witnessed transforming within a cocoon.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1280g_00100_02110_1: A low rumble thrums through the air. A gale whirls up from the depths of the ravine as though piercing the very heavens.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1280g_00200_02110_1: \n\nA white aberration appears from the swirling dust.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1280g_00300_02110_1: \n\nWings spread from its arms, and it bears a tail akin to that of a white snake.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1280g_00400_02110_1: \nIt is at once a thing of menace and awe, its towering body more than 60 feet tall.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1290g_00100_02110_1: In the face of the aberration whose brilliant glow rivals that of the stars above, the androids falter.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1290g_00200_02110_1: \n\nBewilderment colors their mechanical eyes. The life signature of the aberration in the air perfectly matches that of the girl's.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1290g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThough no longer resembling her slender form, this alien figure is undoubtedly the girl.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1300g_00100_02110_1: It glares down at the androids with red eyes. Briefly withdrawing into the night sky, it soars directly toward its enemies.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1300g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThe androids ready their weapons, but having been caught off-guard, they can do little to stop the behemoth's ferocity.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1310g_00100_02110_1: The snaps and clatters of androids being ripped to shreds echo through the night air.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1310g_00200_02110_1: \n\nAll that remains on the asphalt are pools of red and inorganic corpses.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_1310g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThe aberration howls. The earth trembles in response.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_1320g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThe pale aberration acts on its inner voice, shrieking and running wild, destroying all in its path.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2010g_00300_02110_1: \n\nShe clutches her white spear in her right hand, standing still on the suspended road. The mercilessly shredded corpses of the androids surround her.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2010g_00400_02110_1: \n\nShe is dumbstruck. She has no idea what occurred. She had lost consciousness at some point.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2020g_00100_02110_1: She sifts through her memories to make sense of the situation.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2020g_00200_02110_1: \n\nShe was riding her motorcycle on her journey to the place her sister remembered. Her sister, a living weapon just like her.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2020g_00300_02110_1: \n\nBut she was assailed by at least a dozen defense androids from the research facility where she herself awoke.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2030g_00100_02110_1: She drew her spear to fight back, but suddenly lost control of her body.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2030g_00200_02110_1: \n\nThis phenomenon was familiar to her—it was as though some other force was taking over.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2030g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThe androids exploited the situation, sending her plummeting to the bottom of the canyon.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2030g_00400_02110_1: \nHer memory of the event ends there.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2040g_00100_02110_1: And yet, here she stands above the canyon, unscathed.:
LID_a02110_2040g_00200_02110_1: \n\nHer body sometimes moves of its own accord when she sleeps, of this she is fully aware.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2040g_00300_02110_1: \nBut could she truly have clawed her way back up without so much as a scratch?:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2050g_00100_02110_1: To say nothing of the android corpses scattered to and fro. Could she have stood a chance against that many attackers?:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2050g_00200_02110_1: \n\nWhat happened, exactly? She tilts her head and gives a little hum.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2060g_00200_02110_1: \n\nNor does she remember the sweet, enticing voice she heard when she lost consciousness.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2060g_00300_02110_1: \nNor transforming into a pale, winged aberration.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2060g_00400_02110_1: \nNor laying waste to everything before her.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2070g_00100_02110_1: She approaches the broken railing along the road.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2070g_00200_02110_1: \n\nShe peers into the ravine below, where she and her bike should have fallen.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2070g_00300_02110_1: \n\nIt is black as pitch, a darkness so profound that no ordinary eyes could ever hope to see what lies beneath.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2070g_00400_02110_1: \nBut her eyes are far from ordinary.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2070g_00500_02110_1: \nShe can see the twisted remains of her motorcycle.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2080g_00100_02110_1: She senses something behind her. She swiftly spins her spear, whirling around to protect herself.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2080g_00300_02110_1: \nA defense android in white battle armor.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2080g_00400_02110_1: \nIts head drooped, it regards the bodies of its companions, which litter the road like detritus.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2080g_00500_02110_1: \n\nIts expressionless face is impossible to read.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2080g_00600_02110_1: \nIt stares at the mechanical corpses in an eerie, prolonged silence.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2090g_00100_02110_1: At last, it slowly lifts its head.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2090g_00200_02110_1: \nIts artificial eyes lock with the girl's.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2100g_00100_02110_1: At once, the two leap forward, engaging in melee combat.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_2100g_00200_02110_1: \nA living weapon versus an android. One wields a great spear, the other a menacing machete.:<TAP>

LID_a02110_2110g_00200_02110_1: \n\nAfter some time, her body grows heavy, and she begins losing control. Perhaps she is still recovering from the effects of her sleepwalking.:<PAGE>

LID_a02110_2140g_00200_02110_1: \n\nNo matter her tenacity and will, her consciousness sinks into darkness.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_2150g_00200_02110_1: \n\nHer last words as all goes black.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3010g_00100_02110_1: In a research facility far, far away, a living weapon in the form of a girl was born.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3010g_00200_02110_1: \nAs the weapons were mass-produced, more and more of these sisters came into the world.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3010g_00300_02110_1: \n\nThe sisters spent their days fighting monsters and lived out their lives within the facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3010g_00600_02110_1: \nThe very first sister, the original, lost control of herself and destroyed the facility. The interior was reduced to ruins.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3020g_00100_02110_1: Some time passed, and a lone girl awoke in the facility.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3020g_00200_02110_1: \n\nWhere was she? Who was she? She did not know. But a voice reached out to her.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3030g_00100_02110_1: I want to go back to that place.:<TAP>

LID_a02110_3030g_00300_02110_1: \nAnd so the girl left on a journey for this place in her sister's memories, to fulfill her sister's wish.:<PAGE>

LID_a02110_3040g_00200_02110_1: \n\nHer hair sways. Her body floats. It's like the empty ocean floor—the world she could see from the windows of her birthplace.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3050g_00200_02110_1: \n\nShe remembers doing battle with a pursuing android on the way to her destination and losing consciousness.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3060g_00300_02110_1: \nSuddenly, a girl with black hair stands before her. Though her hair and skin are different, she greatly resembles the girl herself.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3060g_00400_02110_1: \n\nIndeed, this is the original of the living weapons. The older sister herself.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3070g_00200_02110_1: \n\nWhen she lost control, she became an alabaster abomination. It was the girl herself who brought her down.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3070g_00300_02110_1: \nBut here she stands in human form.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3080g_00100_02110_1: We are inside your mind. I am a memory that lives on within you, she explains.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3080g_00300_02110_1: \n\nI have an idea—why don't you give me your body?:<PAGE>

LID_a02110_3090g_00200_02110_1: \n\nIt was induced by what little memory of the original remained within her.:<PAGE>

LID_a02110_3100g_00200_02110_1: \n\nNow, however... She can no longer look away.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3110g_00100_02110_1: What would you have me do?:<TAP>

LID_a02110_3130g_00100_02110_1: It must be desTROyed. That place, the WORld—all of it. We must destROY it all.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3130g_00200_02110_1: \n\nHer sister's voice changes in tone. She moves closer.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3140g_00100_02110_1: YOu are my vessel. Give me yOUr BODy. WOULd ouu, please?:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3140g_00200_02110_1: \n\nAs though swimming through this azure world, she approaches the girl.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3140g_00300_02110_1: \nThe moment they join hands, the girl's vision wavers.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3140g_00400_02110_1: \n\nA torrent of the sister's emotions course through her, drowning out the girl's consciousness.:<PAGE>
LID_a02110_3160g_00100_02110_1: I always thought I wanted to go back.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3160g_00200_02110_1: \nTo the warm garden. To the little shed where I sat. The place in my memories.:<TAP>
LID_a02110_3160g_00400_02110_1: \nI am a weapon created in a facility. Why do I have these memories?:<PAGE>

LID_a02110_3220g_00400_02110_1: \nAll so I may bid this world farewell.:<PAGE>

LID_a02110_3300g_00100_02110_1: You have always, always wanted to return there. You mustn't say such things.:
LID_a02110_3300g_00300_02110_1: \n\nIn her agitation, she grabs at the girl. But the girl calmly shakes her head.:<PAGE>

VID_025010_2010g_00400_01010_1: \nAs it does, it recalls an old saying::<PAGE>

VID_028010_1010g_00200_01010_1: \nIts streets flourish with trade; its markets overflow with every good imaginable.:<PAGE>
VID_028010_1010g_00300_01010_1: Succulent fruits. Fragrant perfumes. Glossy textiles. Exquisite furniture. And more. And more. And more.:

VID_028010_3010g_02200_01010_1: \n\nThe merchant cares not a whit if the girl's parents lament her loss and are disappointed in her. Such means nothing to him.:<PAGE>

VID_028010_3010g_02400_01010_1: \n\nHearing a metallic clanking approach, he looks up to find himself surrounded by a pack of armed soldiers.:<PAGE>

VID_029010_1010g_00100_01010_1: Clouds hang heavy over the rural village.:<TAP>
VID_029010_1010g_00200_01010_1: \nThe boys wear grim expressions, clenching sharpened tools in their hands as they make rounds through the withered paths of the fields.:<PAGE>

VID_029010_1010g_01700_01010_1: \nAt the last moment, the truck swerves out of the way, dodging the pillar of fire with an almost eerie grace.:<PAGE>

VID_029010_4010g_01500_01010_1: \n\nWith that, he turns and leaves, a trail of red footprints in his wake.:<PAGE>

VID_029010_4010g_01700_01010_1: \n\nOne day, as he minds the fields as he always does, he spots a familiar man in uniform emerging from the factory with a thoughtful expression on his face.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_01800_01010_1: \n\nThe nauseating, crimson nightmare of the previous year suddenly plays again in the boy's mind.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_01900_01010_1: \nBut there is also curiosity, and so the boy lays down his tool and makes for the factory.:<PAGE>
VID_029010_4010g_02000_01010_1: Traces of fear remain inside: a reminder of the slaughter.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02100_01010_1: \nThe boy ventures deeper, afraid of the silence.:<PAGE>
VID_029010_4010g_02200_01010_1: When he finally comes to the space that was once an ocean of red, he finds it covered in flowers.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02300_01010_1: \n\nPerhaps it was the officer who offered them.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02400_01010_1: \nThe multitude of colors bloom in mourning. In remorse. In compassion. In nightmare. In repentance.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02500_01010_1: \nThe boy feels as though he has been given the slightest glimpse into the depths of the man's heart.:<PAGE>
VID_029010_4010g_02600_01010_1: Despite how he smiled as he killed the bandits without mercy.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02700_01010_1: \nAnd though so much time has passed, he still comes to this place to offer them flowers.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02800_01010_1: \n\nThe boy does not know the man's true face; a day will never come in which he does.:<TAP>
VID_029010_4010g_02900_01010_1: \n\nYet as the scent of the blossoms chokes him, he offers up a prayer.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_00100_01010_1: This is a vast space known as The Cage.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_00200_01010_1: \nClad in a white sheet, an adorable creature floats beside the record of a particular individual.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_00300_01010_1: \n\nFrom her position high in the sky, she gazes down at the earth.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_1010g_00400_01010_1: There, she sees a great swarm of the black birds that damage the records.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_00500_01010_1: \n\nA spreading, all-consuming darkness which devours the original stories, warping them.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nHer job is to protect such records from the black birds.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_1010g_00700_01010_1: But there are so many, and their numbers cause a tired sigh to slip from her mouth.:
VID_030010_1010g_00800_01010_1: \n\n"No matter how many we dispose of, more always come.":<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_00900_01010_1: \n\nThey appear wherever there are people, multiplying without pause. They are foul, unpleasant things.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_01100_01010_1: If she lets her guard down, the savage birds will peck at the hem of her sheet. Tug at her body.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nAnd yet, there seems to be no end to the battle with the black birds. If anything, it is only getting worse.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_1010g_01600_01010_1: \n\nShe senses they are appearing with even greater frequency.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_01700_01010_1: \n\nIt is a terrible feeling—one so sinister that it sends terrible waves of unease shuddering through her.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_01800_01010_1: \n\nPerhaps change will inevitably come to The Cage. Perhaps it will do so through factors of which even she is unaware.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_1010g_01900_01010_1: But all she can do now is dispatch the black birds as she always does, and thereby safeguard her precious records.:<TAP>
VID_030010_1010g_02100_01010_1: \n\nWith those words, she urges herself forward and resumes her duty.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_2010g_00100_01010_1: Through her devoted efforts and service, the sky finally clears.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_00200_01010_1: \n\nThough it took time, she has at last eliminated all the black birds in the area.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_2010g_00300_01010_1: She wonders vaguely if the records have returned to their proper form.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_00400_01010_1: \n\nShe soars into the air to check.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_00500_01010_1: \n\nNothing seems to be out of the ordinary; the area around them is calm.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nPleased with this result, she decides to rest.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_2010g_00700_01010_1: She takes out a neatly folded picnic blanket and unfurls it.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_00800_01010_1: \n\nShe then pours tea from her trusty canteen into a favorite mug and takes a sip.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_00900_01010_1: \n\nThis is her after-work ritual. Her teatime.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01100_01010_1: But the time for relaxation is painfully short.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01200_01010_1: \n\nFor she must attend not just to this place, but a host of others.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01300_01010_1: \n\nYet though difficult, the work is worthwhile.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01500_01010_1: Once suitably refreshed, she carefully packs away her tea set.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01600_01010_1: \n\nHer busy job in The Cage—her endless battle with the black birds—now begins anew.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01700_01010_1: \n\nAnd once she completes the next job, she will happily take her tea again.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_01800_01010_1: \n\n...Or that was the plan, at least.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_2010g_01900_01010_1: But right now, she has no idea.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_02000_01010_1: \n\nNo idea that this record has sustained major damage.:<TAP>
VID_030010_2010g_02100_01010_1: \n\nAnd no idea that her fate has been corrupted.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_3010g_00100_01010_1: She glides through The Cage, preparing to guard the next record.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_00200_01010_1: \n\nWork is going smoothly today...or so she thinks.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_00400_01010_1: \n\nShe realizes The Cage is slightly different today.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_3010g_00500_01010_1: For some reason, the warping apparatus is active.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nThe lever that opens the door, though usually raised, has been set to its lowered position.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_00700_01010_1: \n\nShe pauses, racking her brain to figure out why things feel so off.:
VID_030010_3010g_01000_01010_1: \n\nSomeone else has invaded The Cage—someone who is moving freely about for reasons unknown.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_3010g_01100_01010_1: However, she does not know the identity of this intruder.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_01200_01010_1: \n\nThey have slipped her watchful eye, proceeding with enough caution so as not to leave a trail.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_01300_01010_1: \n\nBut they cannot escape her pursuit forever.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_01350_01010_1: \nIt's time for the detective to find the intruder, she thinks.:
VID_030010_3010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nBut in that moment, she hears a loud cry in the distance.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_3010g_01500_01010_1: "...You lied to me! This isn't right!":<PAGE>
VID_030010_3010g_01900_01010_1: \n\nA pair are now engaged in an intense argument.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_3010g_02000_01010_1: Perhaps one of them is the enemy.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_02100_01010_1: \n\nRegardless, it means there is a presence in The Cage more cunning—and far more cruel—than she had anticipated.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_02200_01010_1: \n\nIn the face of this alarming situation, she sets aside her speculation and hurries to the scene.:<TAP>
VID_030010_3010g_02300_01010_1: \n\n"Goodness, I hope this doesn't get out of hand...":<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_00100_01010_1: By the time she reaches the scene, it is over.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_00300_01010_1: She was delayed in noticing a disturbance in The Cage, and there have been casualties as a result.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_00400_01010_1: \n\nThe terribly warped record spread seeds of trouble throughout The Cage, and those seeds are now taking root.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nOne who must become the center of the tale.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_00700_01010_1: It is a young girl clad in black.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_00900_01010_1: \n\nShe has lost her will. Her emotions. Her speech. She is bewildered above all else.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_01000_01010_1: \n\nThe one draped in the white sheet floats closer to the girl.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_01100_01010_1: Her journey will likely be a grievous one.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_01200_01010_1: \n\nHer battle will be long, and filled with pain.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_01300_01010_1: \n\nYet it is worth it to restore the warped, broken records to the way they are meant to be.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nTo protect the peace of The Cage.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_01500_01010_1: \n\nThis is the precious mission she has been given.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_01600_01010_1: The girl clad in black senses her resolve. Her devotion to the work.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_01700_01010_1: And so she staggers to her feet.:<TAP>
VID_030010_4010g_01800_01010_1: \n\nThe figure in the white sheet speaks in a calm, gentle tone, seeking to ease the girl's worries.:<PAGE>
VID_030010_4010g_02000_01010_1: \n\nThus begins the tale of the girl in black, and her quest to reclaim her... No. To reclaim their broken memories.:
VID_031020_1010g_00100_01010_1: Sisters face each other in a garden, watched over by beautiful flowers.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_00200_01010_1: \nThe younger girl holds a long wooden sword. The elder sister holds a sheathed knife.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_00300_01010_1: \n\nThe elder sister's age and martial experience more than make up for her disadvantage.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_00500_01010_1: \nThe girl shouts, raising her wooden sword over her head. The elder sister watches with narrowed eyes, then lowers her stance and dashes forward.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nThe distance between them closes in an instant. The girl desperately tries to parry the attack, but her weapon is easily swiped away.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_00700_01010_1: The knife plunges toward the wide opening at the girl's chest.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_00800_01010_1: \nShe leaps away at the last moment, thrusting out her sword, but the elder sister dodges the futile attack.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_00900_01010_1: \n\nThen, mid-jump, her sword is knocked away into the sky, and she soon finds herself landing hard on her rear.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_01000_01010_1: A long wooden sword versus a sheathed knife. The girl thought she at least had a chance.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_01100_01010_1: \nBut she lost in a spectacular fashion.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_01200_01010_1: She struggles to keep up with training and is often the object of her sister's whims. And yet, for her, it's all part of the allure.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_01300_01010_1: \n\nShe always wanted to be like her sister.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_01400_01010_1: \nShe always wanted to fight gallantly in the army.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_01500_01010_1: The elder sister flashes a smile as brilliant as the sun, extending a hand to her fallen sibling.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_01600_01010_1: \n\nBut it's the other hand the girl is concerned with. The one with the knife.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_01800_01010_1: \nThe knife is like a badge to her—in her eyes, it's a gleaming key to victory.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_01900_01010_1: The elder sister suddenly laughs, gently brushing her thumb over the handle.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_02000_01010_1: \n\n"This knife is for protecting my allies—I won't give it up so easily.":<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_02100_01010_1: \n\nHer expression is at once reserved and proud.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_02200_01010_1: \nThese joyous days with her sister are seared into the girl's soul.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_02300_01010_1: Time passes, and the girl inherits the knife.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_02400_01010_1: \nShe takes her sister's stead, who met a glorious end in battle.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_1010g_02500_01010_1: Years have passed since her sister's death.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_02600_01010_1: \nIn the garden where she once trained, the girl stares at her sister's memento—the knife.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_02700_01010_1: \n\nShe cannot heal the gaping wound in her chest alone.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_03000_01010_1: \n\nA young man once part of her sister's unit steps in with a serene smile.:<TAP>
VID_031020_1010g_03200_01010_1: \nHe looked after the girl when her sister died, and she looked up to him as an older brother in turn.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_00100_01010_1: The girl's soldier sister fell in battle.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00200_01010_1: \nA young man who once fought alongside her supports the girl now.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00300_01010_1: \n\nShe pours him a cup of tea whenever he visits the house.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00400_01010_1: \nHer sister is the subject of all their conversations.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00500_01010_1: \n\nWhenever the girl hears tales of her sister's radiance, compassion, and hard work, she cannot help but long for her.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00600_01010_1: \nBut all the while, she believes her death was an unfair one.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_00700_01010_1: And today, she opens the fire in her heart to the man.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00800_01010_1: \nHe's like a brother to her. Of course he'll understand.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_00900_01010_1: \n\n"I'm joining the military to avenge my sister.":<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_01000_01010_1: But the man's expression grows tense.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_01100_01010_1: \n\nThe girl assumed he might protest her decision.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_01200_01010_1: \nBut she knows full well her resolve will never waver. She readies herself to assert as much, but...:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_01400_01010_1: \n\n"I selfishly acted alone during a mission. In essence, I killed her.":<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_01500_01010_1: And so he offered to help those she left behind.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_01600_01010_1: \nWanting to avoid harming the bright and earnest girl, he let the opportunity to tell her pass.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_01700_01010_1: \n\nHis words are frank, if not rather sanctimonious.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_01800_01010_1: The girl cannot accept his words at face value.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_01900_01010_1: \n\nShe feels as though the wind was knocked out of her, and the words echo and swirl in her head.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_02100_01010_1: \nThe spilled tea reflects the bewilderment on her face.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_02200_01010_1: \n\nWithout paying the man a single glance, she says in a commanding voice, "Leave.":<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_02300_01010_1: Training tools and wooden dummies line the dim room. The girl built this room to become a soldier like her sister so she may avenge her. It welcomes her empty heart.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_02400_01010_1: \n\nThat she ever sat and listened to stories of her sister from the one responsible for her death fills her with anger.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_02600_01010_1: \nThe gleaming blade of the knife reflects the twisted hatred of her expression.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_02700_01010_1: \n\nWhy did her sister have to die?:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_02800_01010_1: \nHe was responsible for all of this.:
VID_031020_2010g_02900_01010_1: \nStanding before the tools and wooden dummies, the objects that aided her in her strenuous training, none come close to her memento—the knife.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_2010g_03000_01010_1: She stabs the silent blade into a wooden dummy.:<TAP>
VID_031020_2010g_03200_01010_1: \n\nHer hatred will never subside. She lends it to the knife, wishing death upon another.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_00100_01010_1: Her sister died because the man in her unit selfishly acted outside of orders.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_00400_01010_1: \nThe humble yet valiant parade grants courage to those they protect.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_00500_01010_1: \n\nThe people look on with adoration as the soldiers boldly march.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_00600_01010_1: \nThe young man in the back row proudly walks through the streets with his subordinates.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_00700_01010_1: But it seems there's an intruder.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_00800_01010_1: \nGuards stationed near the side street grow agitated.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_00900_01010_1: \n\nA large crowd has gathered to support the parade.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_01000_01010_1: \nBursting out among them is none other than the girl.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_01100_01010_1: She knocks away the guards' guns with her sheathed knife, using her heel to stop them from drawing their swords. Though they have power in numbers, she is unstoppable.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_01200_01010_1: \n\nDodging her way through a sea of outstretched arms, with the lightest bearing, she lunges toward the young man.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_01300_01010_1: Before the unit can assume an interception formation, the girl draws the gleaming knife.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_01500_01010_1: \nShe thrusts her furious blade at him.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_01700_01010_1: \nHis eyes, still as the surface of a lake, stare back at her.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_01800_01010_1: \n\nIt's as though he accepts the beautiful blade.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_01900_01010_1: The girl's fingers, and the handle in her hands, tremble.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_02000_01010_1: \nThe tip of the knife stops just short of the man's body. She can no longer move her hands.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_02100_01010_1: \n\nThe man looks down at the knife, his brow furrowed.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_02200_01010_1: \n\n"Time and again, this knife protected me. I...":<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_02300_01010_1: Her sister's words come back to her.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_02400_01010_1: \n"This knife is for protecting my allies.":<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_02600_01010_1: \n\nWho was it her sister wanted to protect?:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_02700_01010_1: The girl is quickly pulled from her recollections.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_02800_01010_1: \n\nUnsteady on her feet, guards grab her by the shoulders and attempt to drag her away. However—:<PAGE>
VID_031020_3010g_03000_01010_1: \n\nHe reaches out to place a hand on the bewildered girl's small frame.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_03100_01010_1: \nHe leads her out of the parade to somewhere more quiet.:<TAP>
VID_031020_3010g_03300_01010_1: \n\nHis voice is every bit as compassionate as it used to be.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_4010g_00100_01010_1: A girl attacked a soldier in the middle of the parade. Rumors of a passionate fan getting a little too close and personal are quickly forgotten.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_00300_01010_1: Torrential rain batters the streets and rooftops.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_00400_01010_1: \nThe induction ceremony takes place under poor weather.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_00500_01010_1: \n\nThe young man—the captain—reads out the names of fresh recruits. They each respond with a hearty "Sir!" over the deafening downpour.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_00700_01010_1: \nHer gaze is intense. The young man closes his eyes as though steeling himself.:<PAGE>
VID_031020_4010g_00800_01010_1: Even after the ceremony, the rain does not abate.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_00900_01010_1: \nThe young man gazes outside, recalling days past.:<TAP>

VID_031020_4010g_01300_01010_1: \nBut she has something to tell him.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nShe looked into him during her time at military school.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_01500_01010_1: \nDespite his rank, he is widely known as a spineless leader who has issued more retreat orders than any other, earning him the nickname "Captain Craven.":<TAP>

VID_031020_4010g_01700_01010_1: \nMany a soldier willingly ventures into battle with him.:<TAP>

VID_031020_4010g_02500_01010_1: \nNo matter the warm times they shared...:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_02600_01010_1: \n\nCould she ever forgive the man who let her radiant, compassionate sister die?:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_02700_01010_1: \n\nWill the day ever come when the girl's sadness recedes?:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_02800_01010_1: \nWill there ever be an end to the torrential rain?:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_03000_01010_1: The knife she holds is heavy, too big for her small hands.:<TAP>
VID_031020_4010g_03100_01010_1: \nBut if she ever sullies it—this weapon meant to protect her sister's allies—with the blood of her hatred, she knows she'll never forgive herself.:<TAP>

VID_036010_1010g_01000_01010_1: \n\nHe stepped back from the front lines due to his age and acted as an instructor to the younger knights. Though he hasn't seen combat in some time, his skills far eclipsed those of your average knight.:<PAGE>

VID_036010_1010g_01500_01010_1: \n\nIn such situations, a clockwork soldier would have used their high-precision sensors to make decisions.:<TAP>
VID_036010_1010g_01600_01010_1: \nThe commander relied instead on instincts that clockwork soldiers lacked, breaking through an overwhelming situation that a clockwork soldier could never calculate on its own.:<PAGE>

VID_036010_1010g_01900_01010_1: \nEach of his other parameters rivaled those of the latest clockwork soldier model.:<TAP>
VID_036010_1010g_02000_01010_1: \n\nThe source of his combat sense, in the attendant's eyes, was the man's soul.:<PAGE>
VID_036010_1010g_02100_01010_1: There was one thing in particular he would often say to the attendant.:<TAP>

VID_036010_1010g_02400_01010_1: "He's come to kill me at last...":<TAP>
VID_036010_1010g_02500_01010_1: \n\nThe boy is inconsolable when he sees the commander.:<PAGE>

VID_037010_3010g_01500_01010_1: \n\nThe boy must hurry and restore the memory, but he doesn't want to hurt the girl's feelings.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_01800_01010_1: \n\nThey chased one another around and played hide and seek.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_01810_01010_1: \nThe boy was born weak, but in this world, he can run around as much as he likes.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_01900_01010_1: The young girl then grabs the boy's hand and takes him to a field full of blooming wildflowers.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02000_01010_1: \n\nHe weaves a flower crown for them. They cheer with joy when they see his deft skill.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_02100_01010_1: The sight is one of peace, the sort of world the boy once wished for.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02200_01010_1: \n\nThe younger girl has completely taken with the boy. She asks his name.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02400_01010_1: But when the sisters hear it, they go pale.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02500_01010_1: \n\nThe younger's voice trembles as she speaks.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02600_01010_1: \n\n"Isn't that...the name of an evil king? The king with gray eyes who wages wars?":<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02700_01010_1: \n\nWhat is the meaning of this? The boy is at a loss for words and falls silent.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_02800_01010_1: "We have to go now... Thank you for playing with us," says the elder sister.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_02900_01010_1: \n\nShe takes her sister's hand and quickly leaves.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_03000_01010_1: \n\nThe woven flower crown falls from the boy's hands.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_03100_01010_1: His gray eyes watch as the frightened sisters leave him.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_03200_01010_1: \n\nTo him, it is a sign of unbearable cruelty.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_03400_01010_1: Perhaps it's because he rejected the world, but the next thing he knows, he's returned to outside the scarecrow.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_03700_01010_1: \nThey discuss what they learned about the scarecrow.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_03800_01010_1: The memories within did not belong to the boy.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_03810_01010_1: \n\nThey are the memories of another who lived in his world.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_03900_01010_1: \n\nThe enemy warped the world, leading the boy to become a king who led his country into countless wars.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_04000_01010_1: Those memories should not exist. The enemy has corrupted the story, and the story has lost its true form.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_04100_01010_1: \n\nNo matter how cruel it may be, he cannot look away. Broken memories must be repaired to their proper state.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_04200_01010_1: \n\nThe boy restrains himself and curls his hand into a fist.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_04300_01010_1: Mama tells him that she observed another reaction in the scarecrow.:<TAP>
VID_037010_3010g_04400_01010_1: \n\nWith hope in their hearts, they press forward once more.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_3010g_04600_01010_1: \n\nThe countdown clock ticks forward one notch again.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_00200_01010_1: \n\nThe clock shows the countdown until the destruction of The Cage.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_00400_01010_1: \n\nThe boy continues his journey with Mama so that he may restore the memories of his own story.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nThis scarecrow is a broken, crumpled heap on the ground.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_00700_01010_1: \nTheir last hope has shattered into tiny, brilliant pieces.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_00800_01010_1: They follow the reading Mama had picked up and arrive at the throne room.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_00900_01010_1: \n\nThis place was always going to be out of the boy's reach, whether he liked it or not.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_00910_01010_1: \n\nHis father's room is steeped in gloomy shadows and filled with silence.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_01000_01010_1: This scarecrow holds the boy's memories, without a doubt. The boy knows this well.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_01110_01010_1: \n\nThe scarecrow, washed in light from the stained glass window, vanishes as though the darkness is being swept away.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_01300_01010_1: \n\nThe dream he had for his journey's end will never come true.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_01400_01010_1: "There might still be a way," Mama says.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_01510_01010_1: \nHe knows that her words are little more than empty comfort. He knows that all hope has been shattered.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_01600_01010_1: \n\nThe proof is in her clock, which already signals the end.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_01700_01010_1: If anything, he'd rather cherish the miracles he has now than chase ones that will never come to pass.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_01900_01010_1: \n\nSlowly, he sits down upon the throne from which his father once led their people and caused them great suffering.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_02000_01010_1: He gestures for Mama to approach, and he cradles her on his lap.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02100_01010_1: \nHe thinks back on his journey thus far.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02200_01010_1: \n\nAll the fun time he spent with Mama.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02300_01010_1: \nHe has a feeling that it's similar to the time he spent traveling with his attendant.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02400_01010_1: \n\nAs the memories come back to him, his lips curl into a smile.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_02500_01010_1: "Mama... Thank you for leading me here.":<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02600_01010_1: \n\nHe has been given the time to think back on those precious to him.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02800_01010_1: \n\nAnd that, to him, is a miracle in itself.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_02900_01010_1: Even though his path was filled with many failures. And even if he is to lose all his memories.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_02910_01010_1: \n\nHe knows that the truly precious things will never vanish.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_03110_01010_1: \nAfter all this time, there is still one wish he simply cannot let go of.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_03300_01010_1: \n\n"I wish I could've seen him again.":<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_03400_01010_1: \n\nEven if it was in a world of memories, he wanted to see him.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_03500_01010_1: \nHis lone attendant. The one who walked with him.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_03600_01010_1: All he can hear are the gears of the clock turning.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_03700_01010_1: \n\nHand rests upon hand. A light rushes toward the boy's gray eyes.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_03800_01010_1: His dreams that never came true. The journey he walked with his attendant.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_03910_01010_1: <align=center>Vanish in the light of the end.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_04000_01010_1: The Cage's destruction has been confirmed.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_04100_01010_1: \n\nWe could not stop the enemy's attacks in this branch.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_04200_01010_1: \n\nBut I have no doubt we will destroy the enemy in the branch you observe.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_04400_01010_1: \n\nYou will encounter so many memories from here on out...:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_04410_01010_1: \nAnd I'm sure everyone will find a way to overcome any hardship.:<PAGE>
VID_037010_4010g_04600_01010_1: \nI put him through so much pain.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_04610_01010_1: \nBut...I'll carry forward the torch of his will.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_04700_01010_1: \n\nSo, please. I'd like you to help as well.:<TAP>
VID_037010_4010g_04800_01010_1: \n\nIn your branch, I want you to make sure he gets to see the one so dear to him.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_1010g_00100_01010_1: A woman and a dragon, both covered in wounds,\ntrudge across a beach.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_00300_01010_1: \nShe is a powerful swordswoman with a flower\nwhere her right eye should be.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_00500_01010_1: \nHe is a young, white dragon with the power of speech.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_00600_01010_1: \n\nBoth of them stand on the doorstep of death.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_1010g_00700_01010_1: Blood flows freely from their wounds.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_00800_01010_1: \nIt leaves a snaking trail of red along the coast.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_1010g_00900_01010_1: The army that has been following this trail now closes in on them.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_01100_01010_1: This is the end. They can run no further.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_01200_01010_1: \n\nThe woman grips her sword, steeling her resolve.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_01300_01010_1: \nThe dragon lets fly with a howl in response.:<TAP>
vid_004021_1010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nIt cannot end here. They must live.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_2010g_00100_01010_1: The soldiers rush at them like waves from the sea.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_00200_01010_1: \nThe swordswoman fights back, blood spraying from her wounds.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_00400_01010_1: \nsomething appears in the corner of her reddened vision.\nShe sees the dragon collapse.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_00500_01010_1: \n\nCountless blades stick out from his white flesh.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_00600_01010_1: \nAs the dragon lies in the sand, he ekes out a meager cry.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_2010g_00700_01010_1: The woman's hair rises in anger, and she immediately cleaves\nthe soldier before her in twain.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_00800_01010_1: \nSand flies as she rushes to the dragon's side.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_01000_01010_1: \n\nThe woman stands in front of the dragon to shield him.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_2010g_01200_01010_1: \n\nThe next thing she knows, an arrow is embedded deep into her chest.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_01300_01010_1: \nAs she reaches up to pull it out, another follows.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_01400_01010_1: \nShe lifts her head and stares at her enemy.:<TAP>
vid_004021_2010g_01500_01010_1: \nBut a third arrow finds its mark in her eye, as though they had been\naiming for that very spot.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_2010g_01600_01010_1: Her sword slowly falls from her bloody fingers.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_3010g_00100_01010_1: The woman's beating heart slows...slows...and then stops.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_00400_01010_1: \n\nWith only the dragon left, the soldiers move in to finish it off.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_00500_01010_1: \nBut then, the woman's corpse begins to scream.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_3010g_00600_01010_1: As if responding to the scream,:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_00700_01010_1: \nthe flower in her eye glows red.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_00900_01010_1: \nit swells up to an incredible size.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_3010g_01000_01010_1: \nSuddenly, another human spills from the flower, covered in blood.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_01200_01010_1: \nShe is a demon with the strength of the flower on her side.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_3010g_01300_01010_1: "This cannot be the end. This cannot...end.":<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nThe revived woman attacks the soldiers with empty hands.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_01500_01010_1: \nShe strikes down one after another with sheer brute force.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_01700_01010_1: \nSwords penetrate her body, one after the next.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_3010g_01800_01010_1: She screams again. And again. And again.:
vid_004021_3010g_01900_01010_1: \nYet each time, she is reborn from the flower.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_02000_01010_1: \n\nHer limbs are severed. Her skull is shattered. Her heart is pierced.:<TAP>
vid_004021_3010g_02100_01010_1: \nYet she comes back each time and falls upon her foe with\nrenewed fury.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_00100_01010_1: Finally, the woman collapses in the sand.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_00200_01010_1: \nHer sharp, ragged breaths slowly take on a sense of normalcy.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_00400_01010_1: \nThe only sound is that of the waves enveloping the crimson beach.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_4010g_00500_01010_1: Soon, the dragon's eyes flutter open.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_00600_01010_1: \nHe looks over the mountains of dead soldiers, then back to the woman.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_00800_01010_1: \nHis voice is that of an innocent child—a terrible mismatch for its\nmassive size.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_00900_01010_1: \n\n"I only did what anyone should," the woman replies.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_01000_01010_1: \nThe woman knows one absolute in her life: She must protect him.:<PAGE>
vid_004021_4010g_01100_01010_1: A flower blooms in her right eye.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_01200_01010_1: \nIt is a cursed, loathsome power that would destroy the world.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_01300_01010_1: \n\nAnd only a dragon can extinguish it.:<TAP>
vid_004021_4010g_01400_01010_1: \n\nOnce you grow up and become stronger...:
vid_004021_4010g_01500_01010_1: \nI will have to tell you of my final wish.:
vid_004021_4010g_01700_01010_1: \nI will protect you. No matter how many of my lives it may cost.:
